byKey.6707d13e4e617ec94f0e5631 Description: This thumb drive can be used to set up a remote connection to the TerraGroup local servers for Mechanic.
byKey.6709133fa532466d5403fb7c Description: A 20-round 12-gauge drum magazine for the Auto Assault-12 shotgun.
byKey.670fced86a7e274b1a0964e8 Description: A 457mm barrel for the Auto Assault-12 12-gauge shotgun.
byKey.670fd03dc424cf758f006946 Description: A 342mm threaded barrel for the Auto Assault-12 12-gauge shotgun.
byKey.670fd0a8d8d4eae4790c8187 Description: A 417mm threaded barrel for the Auto Assault-12 12-gauge shotgun.
byKey.670fd0eed8d4eae4790c818a Description: A barrel thread protector for the Auto Assault-12 12ga shotgun.
byKey.670fd1cc95c92bfc8e0bea39 Description: A special muzzle device for the Auto Assault-12 shotgun.
byKey.670fd23798663bc4b10e911a Description: A standard-issue stock assembly for the Auto Assault-12 shotgun. Flat Dark Earth version.
byKey.6710cea62bb09af72f0e6bf8 Name: Leapers UTG Universal Shotgun Barrel Mount
byKey.6710cea62bb09af72f0e6bf8 Description: The UTG Universal Shotgun Barrel Mount is designed for mounting on tubular magazines and barrels with a diameter of 20-25 millimeters. Features 3 rails for attaching additional equipment. Manufactured by Leapers Inc.
byKey.6711039f9e648049e50b3307 Description: A keycard to the residential unit in the containment block of TerraGroup Labs.
byKey.67110d06723c2733410161e8 Description: A polymer adjustable buttstock for the G36 assault rifle, manufactured by Heckler & Koch.
byKey.67110d5ed1758189fc0bd221 Description: An extended convex buttpad designed for installation on IDZ stocks for the G36 assault rifle. Manufactured by Heckler & Koch.
byKey.67110d6fa71d1f123d021cd3 Description: A concave buttpad designed for installation on IDZ stocks for the G36 assault rifle. Manufactured by Heckler & Koch.
byKey.67110d8d388bded67304ceb4 Description: A low-profile receiver with built-in tactical equipment rail for AUG A3. Manufactured by Vltor.
byKey.67110dd41ad01bb88705347b Name: Steyr AUG A3 Corvus Defensio Receiver Rail MOI 30 Slots
byKey.67110dd41ad01bb88705347b Description: A low-profile sight mount for AUG A3. Manufactured by Corvus Defensio.
byKey.6711107e1ad01bb88705347e Name: Steyr AUG Corvus Defensio KeyMod Forward Accessory Rail
byKey.6711107e1ad01bb88705347e Description: A KeyMod interface mount that replaces the standard front grip and allows installation of various accessories, designed for the AUG assault rifle. Manufactured by Corvus Defensio.
byKey.67111094d1758189fc0bd223 Name: Corvus Defensio KeyMod 1.8 inch rail section
byKey.67111094d1758189fc0bd223 Description: The Corvus Defensio 1.8 inch KeyMod rail allows installation of additional equipment on the handguards equipped with a standard KeyMod interface.
byKey.6711109e723c2733410161eb Name: Corvus Defensio KeyMod 6.8 inch rail section
byKey.6711109e723c2733410161eb Description: The Corvus Defensio 6.8 inch KeyMod rail allows installation of additional equipment on the handguards equipped with a standard KeyMod interface.
byKey.67112695fe5c8bf33f02476d Name: Odin Works K-Pod KeyMod bipod adapter
byKey.67112695fe5c8bf33f02476d Description: A KeyMod interface mount that allows installation of bipods. Manufactured by Odin Works.
byKey.671126a210d67adb5b08e925 Name: AI AXMC KeySlot Harris bipod mount
byKey.671126a210d67adb5b08e925 Description: A KeySlot interface adapter that allows installation of Harris bipods to the AXMC precision rifle. Manufactured by Accuracy International.
byKey.671126b049e181972e0681fa Description: A mount allows installation of bipods on handguards equipped with a standard M-LOK interface. Manufactured by Magpul.
byKey.67124dcfa3541f2a1f0e788b Name: MPS Auto Assault-12 Gen 2 12ga automatic shotgun
byKey.67124dcfa3541f2a1f0e788b Description: The AA-12 (Auto Assault-12) is a reliable full-auto 12-gauge shotgun. The second generation features a mount for installing optics. This shotgun is distinguished by its recoil pulse accumulation, which makes the recoil feel smooth without sacrificing fire rate and stopping power. The AA-12 is designed for military and police units. Manufactured by Military Police Systems.
byKey.6718817435e3cfd9550d2c27 Description: Steyr AUG A3 is a 5.56x45 bullpup assault rifle, developed by the Austrian company Steyr-Daimler-Puch. AUG is known for good ergonomics, decent accuracy, low recoil and sufficient reliability. The rifle also stands out for its futuristic design. The A3 version features a bolt-catch button. Black version.
byKey.671883292e2eeb98d406f3b8 Description: A vertical foregrip for the Steyr AUG assault rifle. Black version.
byKey.6719023b612cc94b9008e78c Description: A standard-issue stock assembly for the Auto Assault-12 shotgun. TerraGroup version.
byKey.673cab3e03c6a20581028bc1 Description: The TRG M10 is a precision bolt-action sniper rifle chambered for the .338 Lapua Magnum cartridge. The TRG M10 is an extremely versatile platform: it easily converts from a proper long-range rifle to a more compact weapon. The rifle is designed to be used by army, police and various special forces of several countries. Manufactured by Sako, which is part of Beretta Defense Technologies holding company.
byKey.673cb212e695740be0047a46 Description: Standard chassis with a folding stock for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, manufactured by Sako.
byKey.673cb4054ff4aa8f86076f4a Description: A .338 Lapua Magnum bolt assembly for the Sako TRG M10 sniper rifle.
byKey.673cb491280680de5e02ff36 Description: A standard .338 Lapua Magnum receiver for the TRG M10 sniper rifle. Manufactured by Sako.
byKey.673cb51e093e0ea7fd0b8746 Description: A universal rail for mounting various sights on the TRG M10 sniper rifle. Manufactured by Sako.
byKey.673cb551093e0ea7fd0b874a Name: Sako TRG M10 .338 LM 23.5 inch barrel
byKey.673cb551093e0ea7fd0b874a Description: A 23.5 inch (597mm) .338 Lapua Magnum barrel for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, manufactured by Sako.
byKey.673cb5d1280680de5e02ff3b Name: Sako TRG M10 15 inch handguard assembly
byKey.673cb5d1280680de5e02ff3b Description: A 15 inch long handguard assembly for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, equipped with a Finnish interface for mounting additional equipment. Manufactured by Sako.
byKey.673cb81f5b1511adb10cd326 Description: A standard-issue padded grip for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, manufactured by Sako. Comes with a hex and torx key set for quick access.
byKey.673cbdfad0453ba50c0f76d6 Description: An 8-round .338 Lapua Magnum magazine for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, manufactured by Sako.
byKey.673dd5f73f92dc7e120d20a9 Description: A short length handguard rail for installing additional equipment on the TRG series sniper rifles. Manufactured by Sako.
byKey.673dd617912f68467c0615b6 Description: A medium length handguard rail for installing additional equipment on the TRG series sniper rifles. Manufactured by Sako.
byKey.673ddbb567c759b3c90e5f76 Description: A rail cover for the TRG M10 sniper rifle buttstock. Manufactured by Sako.
byKey.673f0a38259f5945d70e43a6 Name: Ase Utra SL7i-BL BoreLock .338 LM sound suppressor
byKey.673f0a38259f5945d70e43a6 Description: The SL7i-BL sound suppressor, installed on compatible BoreLock muzzle brakes. Manufactured by Ase Utra.
byKey.673f0a9370a3ddcf0d0ee0b8 Description: A sound suppressor manufactured by PGM Precision, designed to fit .338 Lapua Magnum weapons.
byKey.673f0b36536d64240f01acd6 Name: CGS Hekate DT .338 LM sound suppressor
byKey.673f0b36536d64240f01acd6 Description: The Hekate DT .338 LM suppressor boasts great noise and flash reduction for large caliber rifles. Manufactured by CGS Group.
byKey.673f3ef1259f5945d70e43a8 Name: Ase Utra BoreLock .338 LM muzzle brake
byKey.673f3ef1259f5945d70e43a8 Description: A muzzle brake manufactured by Ase Utra for .338 LM (8.6x70). Reduces recoil and counters the muzzle rise. The brake is threaded and compatible with BoreLock-type sound suppressors.
byKey.673f3f2f40aeca974e0b5c66 Description: A threading protection cap for Ase Utra BoreLock muzzle brakes.
byKey.673f3f5eef7545280c00f026 Description: A threading protection cap for the Sako TRG .338 LM rifle barrel.
byKey.673f3f9840aeca974e0b5c68 Name: Sako TRG Coretac CoreBrake .338 LM muzzle brake
byKey.673f3f9840aeca974e0b5c68 Description: A .338 LM muzzle brake for the TRG sniper rifle. Manufactured by Coretac Solutions.
byKey.673f4046259f5945d70e43ab Description: A TRG .338 LM sniper rifle muzzle brake, manufactured by Sako.
byKey.67405d760098dcb5940ea1a6 Name: Sako TRG M10 .338 LM 20 inch barrel
byKey.67405d760098dcb5940ea1a6 Description: A 20 inch (508mm) .338 Lapua Magnum barrel for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, manufactured by Sako.
byKey.67405e3b83ac5c69ae025406 Description: A 27 inch (685mm) .338 Lapua Magnum barrel for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, manufactured by Sako.
byKey.67405ef125beb509e8070276 Name: Sako TRG M10 11 inch handguard assembly
byKey.67405ef125beb509e8070276 Description: An 11 inch long handguard assembly for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, equipped with a Finnish interface for mounting additional equipment. Manufactured by Sako.
byKey.67405fd0812f476fb2020066 Description: A 15 inch long handguard assembly for the TRG M10 sniper rifle, equipped with an M-LOK interface for mounting additional equipment. Manufactured by Sako.
byKey.674078c4a9c9adf0450d59f9 Description: This case contains several sealed boxes.
byKey.67408903268737ef6908d432 Description: A box containing contraband cargo from Peacekeeper. Opening it might not be a good idea.
byKey.67409848d0b2f8eb9b034db9 Description: The box is sealed to protect its contents. A multitool is required to open it.
byKey.674098588466ebb03408b210 Description: This box can't hold much, but now you can see what's inside.
byKey.6740987b89d5e1ddc603f4f0 Description: The contents are unknown, but you'll need a key to open it.
byKey.67446fdd752be02c220f27b3 Description: A 72.5mm thermobaric assault rocket for the RShG-2 rocket launcher.
byKey.67449b6c89d5e1ddc603f504 Description: A key suitable for opening most standard cases.
byKey.67458730df3c1da90b0b052b Description: A tactical backpack with a complex modular system. The arrangement of internal compartments and side straps makes the RUSH 100 a highly versatile backpack that can be adapted to any combat situation.
byKey.67458794e21e5d724e066976 Description: A medium-size 3-day backpack designed for both military and tourist use. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading. MultiCam Alpine version.
byKey.6745895717824b1ec20570a6 Description: 6B47 is an aramid helmet of Russian origin. As part of the Ratnik program, it is the new standard-issue helmet for most of the Russian Armed Forces. The 6B47 is similar to previous generation helmets such as the 6B7-1M and 6B27. It has equal protection but weighs slightly less, floats in water, and has mounting equipment for lights and night vision devices. The helmet can be fitted with a variety of covers for different environments. Equipped with an arctic EMR camouflage cover.
byKey.674589d98dd67746010329e6 Name: Spiritus Systems Bank Robber chest rig (MultiCam Alpine)
byKey.674589d98dd67746010329e6 Description: An ultra-compact and lightweight chest rig for mobility and comfort. Manufactured by Spiritus Systems. MultiCam Alpine camouflage version, for all your winter LARP needs.
byKey.6749c40822a2740bb408d066 Description: A PP-19-01 Vityaz 9x19 drum magazine with a 50-round capacity. Manufactured by F5 MFG.
byKey.674d5e287075e056160e0176 Description: A polymer handguard for the Velociraptor assault rifle. A modified version of the Tapco AK handguard based on the Galil AR handguard, designed to be installed over the suppressor shroud, preventing possible injury to the shooter's hands during firing.
byKey.674d6121c09f69dfb201a888 Name: Aklys Defense Velociraptor .300 Blackout assault rifle
byKey.674d6121c09f69dfb201a888 Description: A special modification based on the AK assault rifle chambered in .300 Blackout caliber, manufactured by Aklys Defense. It replaces the standard barrel assembly with a modified integrally suppressed barrel, which allowed to achieve a significantly reduced sound signature.
byKey.674d90b55704568fe60bc8f5 Description: As dangerous as the fish it's named after.
byKey.674d91ce6e862d5a95059ed6 Description: To celebrate Christmas and the New Year, Killa redesigned his body armor. The armor is now more noticeable, but Killa has never been one for cautious reconnaissance.
byKey.674da107c512807d1a0e7436 Description: A comfortable and spacious backpack for its volume, it remained popular even in wartime. Judging by the attached antlers, this backpack used to belong to a hunter.
byKey.674da9cf0cb4bcde7103c07b Description: Someone has decorated the standard Terraframe model for Christmas. The weight hasn't changed much, but going into a raid has become somehow... more cheerful?
byKey.674fe57721a9aa6be6045b96 Name: SOK-12 Chaos Titan Quad Rail handguard
byKey.674fe57721a9aa6be6045b96 Description: A lightweight handguard from the Titan Quad Rail System for Saiga shotguns. Manufactured by Chaos.
byKey.674fe89a4472d471fb0f07d8 Name: SOK-12 Chaos Titan Quad Rail handguard top cover
byKey.674fe89a4472d471fb0f07d8 Description: A handguard top rail for the Titan Quad Rail System, manufactured by Chaos.
byKey.674fe8b9362ea1f88b0e278d Name: SOK-12 Chaos Titan receiver top rail
byKey.674fe8b9362ea1f88b0e278d Description: A receiver top rail for the Titan Quad Rail System, manufactured by Chaos.
byKey.674fe8cf4472d471fb0f07df Description: A rear sight modeled after the popular Heckler & Koch iron sights, manufactured by Chaos.
byKey.674fe8dd362ea1f88b0e2792 Description: A front sight modeled after the popular Heckler & Koch iron sights, manufactured by Chaos.
byKey.674fe8f6f34d761ab8020cc8 Description: The MD Arms 20-shell drum magazine for SOK-12 and compatible weapons, intended for use with 12/76 or 12/70 shells.
byKey.674fe9a75e51f1c47c04ec23 Description: A modification of the Saiga-12K smoothbore shotgun, enabling fully automatic fire. Hell of a beast.
byKey.67506ca81f18589016006aa6 Description: Despite the fact that this model was manufactured in the 80s, the Soviet quality is still evident. The picture might not be as good as gen 2 or gen 3 night vision, but it's definitely worth its price.
byKey.675307301f7c19a9780f2668 Name: AR-15 Magpul B.A.D. Lever bolt release
byKey.675307301f7c19a9780f2668 Description: The Battery Assist Device Lever for the AR-15 platform and compatibles. Allows to release the bolt into battery from the right side of the rifle, making it easier to operate the weapon for left-handed shooters. Manufactured by Magpul.
byKey.67586af7036d7f3da60c3612 Description: The jar has been sealed either a few months or a few years ago. There's hardly anyone left in the city who would waste time making fresh pickles.
byKey.67586b7e49c2fa592e0d8ed9 Description: Even during a military conflict, experienced warriors strive to celebrate the holiday. Olivier salad is the mainstay of the New Year's Eve table.
byKey.67586bee39b1b82b0d0f9d06 Description: Even gasoline can fail in extreme cold. That is why you have to use something stronger outdoors.
byKey.67586c61a0c49554ed0bb4a8 Description: A special product designed for preserving the cut Christmas trees.
byKey.675956062f6ddfe8ff0e2806 Description: A version of the MTEK STRIKE helmet with extended modularity. MultiCam Alpine version.
byKey.6759655674aa5e0825040d62 Description: A version of the MTEK STRIKE helmet with extended modularity. Olive Drab version.
byKey.67597ceea35600b4c10cea86 Description: A lightweight ergonomic helmet manufactured by MTEK. Coyote version.
byKey.67597d241d5a44f2f605df06 Description: A lightweight ergonomic helmet manufactured by MTEK. Coyote/MultiCam Arid version.
byKey.6759af0f9c8a538dd70bfae6 Description: The Maska-1 bulletproof protective helmet appeared in service in 1991 as a replacement for the "Sphere" helmet, designed for use by the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation armed forces. The Maska-1SCh ("Mask-1 Shield") modification features a bulletproof steel faceshield to ensure maximum protection of the user's face. Looks like Killa loves to celebrate Christmas and New Year.
byKey.6759bb94b8913ff13e049669 Description: A rare What You Seek poster. Only the most hardcore USEC operators can get it.
byKey.6759e07e4ff23436160d7fed Description: A rare I Bear Loot poster. Very few BEAR operators can get one of these.
byKey.6759e19a8367ee2b0c0f4b92 Description: A simple poster of a girl. Perfect for a rest area.
byKey.6759e61067c8eb5cd10352f1 Description: A simple poster of a girl. A little weathered in some spots, but still pleasing to the eye.
byKey.6759e6c39422e1708e0e9b81 Description: A simple poster of a girl. So simple that every man in Tarkov had probably seen it at least once.
byKey.6759e7a44ff23436160d7ff5 Description: A simple poster of a girl. Not perfect condition, but it's doubtful you could find a better one.
byKey.6759e8b1c3102563bd01c985 Description: A rare poster of a girl. It is said that someone pawned five gold teeth for one of these. Who they used to belong to is not stated.
byKey.6759e91d8367ee2b0c0f4b94 Description: A poster that has truly become legendary. Only a few people have one of these.
byKey.675a0288c3102563bd01c9c3 Description: A blatant advertisement for making money in the Arena. Many Tarkov citizens were tempted by the quick money, despite risking death.
byKey.675a046b8f547d6cae01922e Description: A poster advertising making money in the Arena. Sure, you can make some quick cash, but you will most definitely die even quicker.
byKey.675a04c01474133a0d0bb212 Description: A poster from the Arena. It depicts the at the time legendary gladiators. So many Scavs came to see them fight that there weren't enough seats in the stands. Nowadays, nobody even remembers who won.
byKey.675a04fdb8913ff13e0496bb Description: A poster with Killa and Tagila as anime girls. If only they were real.
byKey.675a06b84ff23436160d802f Description: A poster of the avant-garde composer Alex Green. His music is multifaceted and unique, so much so that the world's leading media wrote about him. People used to pay huge sums of money to visit his concerts.
byKey.675a081c1474133a0d0bb214 Description: A rare poster of the movie which was never released. Director N. Tankovsky said in an interview that the story would be about a young security guard who began to notice mystical strange things going on in Tarkov.
byKey.675a0a91af26c56ee1090728 Description: At one point, the whole Tarkov was flooded with advertisements like this. But for some reason this particular poster is subtly different.
byKey.675a0b8d4ff23436160d8031 Description: A rare poster. The concert was held overseas. Why were these posters put up all over Tarkov? No one knows to this day, but conspiracy theories are rampant.
byKey.675a0d2d57dd12f0260c4a31 Description: A regular poster of yet another movie from the director A. Bambetov.
byKey.675a0eacf905bde03d0f8253 Description: A regular poster for the unreleased movie Den of Wolves. Nothing special, just a wolf.
byKey.675a0fbbb98bf391510bafcd Description: An unknown artist tried to envision what a highway will look like in 2028. What is it: a flight of fancy or a subtle warning?
byKey.675a125caf26c56ee109072a Description: A poster for the movie Hell or Highwater. The big screens never ran it, but Tarkov still has enough of these posters left to use as decoration.
byKey.675a191f67c8eb5cd1035305 Description: A poster for the action thriller Gunfight from the studio Battle Star. Years ago, cinemas used to have massive waiting lines for movie. Now all that's left are the posters. It's a nice reminder of the old days.
byKey.675a1a244ff23436160d8033 Description: The thriller Last Flight did not win any awards, but the box office collected a decent amount of cash. The director of the movie, Yulin Kontorsky, must have been overjoyed.
byKey.675a1af21474133a0d0bb216 Description: The studio Bubble Step did a pretty good job on their debut horror film Spooky Movie. Too bad they didn't have enough imagination for the title.
byKey.675a1c129422e1708e0e9baa Description: The movie Vasily from the legendary director Nikita Bayanov. It held the box office lead for 28 weeks, owing in no small part to its deep and unusual plot.
byKey.675a1e502eac6c76e104ea1e Description: The poster is not wordy, but straightforward. It'll look great at the front door. Or the exit door?
byKey.675a1f5c1474133a0d0bb218 Description: The movie Sharpshooter never came out. A real shame. The poster's kinda stylish.
byKey.675a202b6aaafea7210915fd Description: A poster of the movie The Ambush. Although, in the end, the audience didn't see anything other than posters.
byKey.675a20c83fb2de89670113b4 Description: A poster for the unreleased movie The Hunted. Something about this style reminds of... A sequel to another unreleased project?
byKey.675a213ff905bde03d0f8255 Description: A poster of the unreleased movie USEC. It seems that this is how they wanted to fill the ranks of PMC operatives.
byKey.675aaa003107dac10006332f Description: Someone had sketched a hand-drawn diagram of the perimeter of the Federal Reserve military base in its northwestern part. According to the notes, there is a gap in the minefield that could be used for a safe exfil.
byKey.675aaa8f7f3c962069072b27 Description: Someone was preparing to assault the water treatment plant and had marked out the optimal routes to bypass the minefields. One of the routes goes toward the bay. Looks like there's a safe exfil route from the coast.
byKey.675aaa9a3107dac100063331 Description: Someone has hand-drawn a diagram of the minefield next to the railroad in the nature reserve area. Apparently, you can safely exfil from Priozersk near the railroad bridge.
byKey.675aaab74bca0b001d02f356 Description: It seems that "Voron" is some kind of cipher or code. If someone has manipulated the exfils from Customs, they must have left access only for their own. The question is, where are these exits?
byKey.675aaae1dcf102478202c537 Description: “Onyx”. If it's not a random scribble, then it's some kind of code. Perhaps one of the Scavs has found a new exfil route out of the city, but only allows access to their own. In a densely built environment, a reliable escape route must be underground.
byKey.675aaae75a3ab8372d0b02a7 Description: There's only one word on the note: “Adaptation”. Looks like a code word. If someone found a new exfil route out of the TerraGroup HQ area, they must have placed their men nearby to keep anyone from the outside from getting to the new exit. In that case, the code would help distinguish friend from foe.
byKey.675aaaf674a7619a5304c233 Description: The word “Ark” hardly needs to be taken literally. It's more like a code word. There are quite a few locked doors under the Polikhim Factory, leading deeper into the catacombs. Perhaps someone will open the door for you if you know the code word.
byKey.675aab0d6b6addc02a08f097 Description: Someone wrote the word “Heartbeat” on a torn piece of paper. Sounds like one of Sanitar's weird pranks. Or perhaps a code word? If his men have their own exfil routes off Shoreline, they must be using a system of key phrases or signals. Maybe this note will make you look like one of their own.
byKey.675aadf3003bb2e826030996 Description: Usually these hats ring loudly with each head movement. Looks like someone got all the bells out of it beforehand.
byKey.675aae1c26dc64e17800fee6 Description: A Christmas hat with deer antlers. It won't protect you from gunshots, but it can distract your opponent for a split second. Sometimes that's all that matters.
byKey.675ac888803644528007b3f6 Description: In normal conditions, this balaclava would be too visible. But in winter it becomes essential, especially in rough terrain.
byKey.675dc9d37ae1a8792107ca96 Description: A special army dogtag with rubber sides serving the purpose of quickly identifying the wounded and deceased in combat. An indicator of the PMC operative's status.
byKey.675dcb0545b1a2d108011b2b Description: A special stainless steel army dogtag serving the purpose of quickly identifying the wounded and deceased in combat. Available only to the most experienced PMC operatives.
byKey.675ea3d6312c0a5c4e04e317 Description: RSP-30 is a reactive signal cartridge for commanding and maintaining squad interaction. Multi-star rocket cartridges are used as flares.
byKey.676008db84e242067d0dc4c9 Description: A secret TerraGroup invention that has fallen into the hands of the cultists.
byKey.67600929bd0a0549d70993f6 Description: A spacious case for storing ballistic plates.
byKey.676009ddb623f3b8ba079419 Name: .50 AE Copper Solid ammo pack (20 pcs)
byKey.676009ddb623f3b8ba079419 Description: A pack of .50 AE Copper Solid ammo, 20 rounds.
byKey.676009ed8f1fee08740f9479 Description: A pack of .50 AE FMJ ammo, 20 rounds.
byKey.676009fe8f1fee08740f947c Description: A pack of .50 AE JHP ammo, 20 rounds.
byKey.67600a0e84e242067d0dc4cd Name: .50 AE Hawk JSP ammo pack (20 pcs)
byKey.67600a0e84e242067d0dc4cd Description: A pack of .50 AE Hawk JSP ammo, 20 rounds.
byKey.67600a42b32eb5d23e0eb459 Description: A box of 6.8x51mm SIG FMJ cartridges, 20 pieces.
byKey.67600a516f01341c9106ab4c Description: A box of 6.8x51mm SIG Hybrid cartridges, 20 pieces.
byKey.676017fe8cfeeba9f707c8d6 Name: SOK-12 Kiba Arms Zombie Custom dust cover
byKey.676017fe8cfeeba9f707c8d6 Description: A receiver dust cover for the SOK-12 shotgun, modernized by Kiba Arms.
byKey.676029a6bdead929d40bc368 Description: A children's mask stylized as a rooster. In the realities of Tarkov, it probably looks intimidating. Or not. As if there weren't enough mercs with cringy plastic skull masks already.
byKey.676029ca2749de558a0b7e67 Description: It looks like this mask was taken from a warehouse with props for a play based on a G. Rodari story.
byKey.676029e22749de558a0b7e69 Description: A mask depicting one of the best doctors of all time.
byKey.676029f997f19b78f00a0197 Description: These kinds of masks are often seen at kids' parties. But this one also fits an adult.
byKey.67602a0f97f19b78f00a0199 Description: A mask of someone who hates Christmas.
byKey.67602a23c8e72a73250de737 Description: A common hare mask. It is unclear just who and why made a copy of this mask to fit an adult.
byKey.67602a39c8e72a73250de739 Description: A stargazer mask with a cap worn by astronomers from children's fairy tales.
byKey.6761492dc53ebe8c0f0a5efe Description: An ambidextrous charging handle with two latches for the second generation of the MPX SMG. Manufactured by SIG Sauer.

Flat Dark Earth version.

byKey.676176d362e0497044079f4c Description: The FN SCAR-H (Special Operations Forces Combat Assault Rifle - Heavy) assault rifle chambered in 7.62x51 NATO rounds, was adopted by the US SOCOM as the Mk 17. Features a side-folding polymer stock and a free-floating, cold hammer-forged Mil-Spec barrel with hardchromed bore. Fully-ambidextrous operating controls instantly adapt the SCAR to any user or any shooting position. The receiver-integrated optical rail plus three accessory rails enable mounting of a wide variety of scopes, electronic sights, tactical lights and lasers. The X-17 lower receiver allows the installation of AR-10 magazines. Manufactured by Fabrique Nationale Herstal and X Products.

byKey.676177591f08ed5e8800b7a9 Description: A 3 inch quad rail mount for the RFB rifle, allowing the installation of additional tactical equipment. Manufactured by Kel-Tec.
byKey.6761777a1f08ed5e8800b7ac Name: AR-15 DoubleStar ACE ARFX Skeleton Stock
byKey.6761777a1f08ed5e8800b7ac Description: The lightweight ACE ARFX Skeleton Stock provides comfort, balance and aesthetics. Fits both the Mil-Spec and civilian M/AR platform. Manufactured by DoubleStar.
byKey.6761779c48fa5c377e06fc3f Description: A new polymer buttstock for the modern AK platform folding weapons. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Concern.
byKey.676177b09cfcc4c25b027446 Description: The Tactical Barrel Clamp is designed for mounting on tubular magazines and barrels with a diameter of 20-27 millimeters. Features a rail for attaching additional equipment. Manufactured by Toni System.

byKey.676177df1f08ed5e8800b7ae Description: A combined kit consisting of a handguard and a milled gas tube designed to improve the performance of the PP-19-01 Vityaz and the Saiga-9 civilian carbine. The handguard is equipped with an M-LOK interface for installing additional equipment, and the gas tube has a picatinny rail for mounting sights and tactical units. Manufactured by Sureshot Armament Group.
byKey.6761a6ccd9bbb27ad703c48a Description: A key to one of the rooms in an old house somewhere on the edge of the Priozersk forest. It is said that a person nicknamed Ogryzok used to trade in these parts. He used to sell rare goods including even a steady supply of tank batteries. Yet nothing had long been heard of Ogryzok, and no one knows where he had disappeared to.

byKey.678f84bb9e85556ca60f0362 Description: Judging by this mask, the Labyrinth had severely affected Tagilla's mental state, making him even more unhinged and bloodthirsty. Who thought he could be any more crazy?
byKey.678fa929819ddc4c350c0317 Description: A massive handwheel removed from some kind of valve. It must have been used to regulate the water or gas supply in the Knossos underground facilities.
byKey.679b944d597ba2ed120c3d3c Description: There's no escape from the Minotaur's grasp. The only thing left to do is to take the last deep breath and hold on as long as possible.
byKey.679b946f90622daf9708da6d Description: Looking at this poster, you realize the sheer terror that the Minotaur's victims felt before they died.
byKey.679b94734e9ca6b3d80586a7 Description: This poster embodies the nature of the Minotaur. Brutality, thirst for murder, and blood. Rivers of blood.
byKey.679b9477708cfcb2060b9ade Description: This poster shows the Minotaur being slain by a warrior from the Labyrinth. Very few people have witnessed such a scene with their own eyes.
byKey.679b9716597ba2ed120c3d3f Description: A worn office door key marked "Knossos LLC". Probably used to open utility rooms or other premises belonging to Knossos.
byKey.679b9819a2f2dd4da9023512 Description: A keycard to one of Knossos facilities. The design references the Minotaur mythos, but it's somewhat strange there are no Minotaur theme parks in Tarkov.
byKey.679b992329acd1f2f60985a5 Description: The documents are encrypted, but appear to contain research notes on some kind of technology or weapon. The records mention the name “Item 1156”.
byKey.679b9cce4e4ed4b3b40ae5c5 Description: A limited edition Tarko figurine. What's more strange: the pale skin or the nails stuck in his head? It looks like this poor guy has experienced the full spectrum of human pain.
byKey.679b9d43597ba2ed120c3d44 Description: A limited edition Tarko figurine. A creepy dude with a disfigured face and blades on his arm. Doing Obdolbos would give you nightmares.
byKey.679b9d4b3374fb14f40efe6d Description: A limited edition Tarko figurine. Count Bloodsucker wouldn't have lasted more than a couple days in Tarkov. Sucking blood is cool and all, but does it work against flashbangs and .308?
byKey.679b9d55708cfcb2060b9ae3 Description: A limited edition Tarko figurine. Looks like a monster with a disproportionately elongated head and a double mouth. Totally "Alien" (good one) to the Tarko universe.
byKey.679b9d6390622daf9708da76 Description: A limited edition Tarko figurine. This funny little character is wearing something like a pyramid on his head. A character like this could only exist in a fictional world, along with zombies and other monsters.
byKey.679ba90d269ddfea47012159 Description: A two-handed axe made out of a sewer hatch... With that weight, a single blow is enough to split a skull, whether the blade is sharp or not.
byKey.679baa2c61f588ae2b062a24 Description: An old key, the markings are unreadable. Could be useful for surviving the Labyrinth.
byKey.679baa4f59b8961f370dd683 Description: This key probably opens some kind of an old lock. The number engraving has been practically scratched off. Could be useful for surviving the Labyrinth.
byKey.679baa5a59b8961f370dd685 Description: The number engraving is barely recognizable on the weathered metal. Could be useful for surviving the Labyrinth.
byKey.679baa9091966fe40408f149 Description: The engraving on this key is barely readable: it's either the number 4 or the Russian letter Ч. Could be useful for surviving the Labyrinth.
byKey.679baace4e9ca6b3d80586b2 Description: A key that opens one of the personnel workstation rooms in the Labyrinth. That room may have something to do with the research that took place in the Labyrinth.
byKey.679baae891966fe40408f14c Description: An old key that would be more suitable for a shabby lock on a grate or fence than a modern door.
byKey.679bab714e9ca6b3d80586b4 Description: An old key that has a strong odor of death. Probably opens a morgue or a room where bodies were kept.
byKey.679bac1d61f588ae2b062a26 Description: A key that opens a certain room in the Labyrinth. There's no telling what might be inside.

byKey.67a5c5b6dfdf568c9009af66 Description: Atomic Defense's CQCM ballistic mask provides protection against short-range weapons including pistols, shotguns and knives. Could this writing on it be considered a cry for help?

This reinforced mask covers the wearer's face completely. It's unclear who had the idea to paint a target on it, but that sure is pretty ironic.
byKey.67a5c6068fcd9fb73f0752cf Description: Atomic Defense's CQCM ballistic mask provides protection against short-range weapons including pistols, shotguns and knives. Some say the skull is a universal symbol that inspires fear and respect in opponents.

byKey.67a5c657782ce4655104db16 Description: Atomic Defense's CQCM ballistic mask provides protection against short-range weapons including pistols, shotguns and knives. The drawing is applied with a durable paint for true fans of El Día de Muertos, the Day of the Dead.

byKey.67a9cd18f05be177170bcd7a Description: The embroidered scratches on this balaclava refer to the worst fight of your life. Or trying to pet a fussy cat.
byKey.67a9cd28cade15e0f00123b6 Description: With the embroidery on this balaclava, everyone will know your creed.

byKey.67a9ea004fb4a4a8a00d2828 Description: Express yourself and intimidate your enemies (or make them cringe) with a yet another skull mask.

byKey.67ab2eecfe82855dcc0f2af6 Description: A plate carrier by Hexatac. A minimalistic version designed to be used with chest rigs. MultiCam version.
byKey.67ab2f28dafe3b22670c9116 Description: The "Kirasa N" body armor is designed for the army and police special forces of the Russian Federation. The bulletproof vest provides circular protection of the human torso. Elements of the damper provide ventilation of the under armor space and reduce the blunt damage. Green version.
byKey.67ab2f5adafe3b22670c911f Description: “Redut-M” is a modified version of the well-proven Redut body armor, which is in service of special units of the FSB. The vest is based on advanced technologies in the field of individual armor. Due to the optimized form of armor elements and the outer cover with a special damping-ventilation system, the Redut M armored vest has excellent functional qualities, which facilitates active actions, including those associated with the use of vehicles and in confined spaces. SK Woodland version.
byKey.67ab2f94dafe3b22670c912c Description: A plate armor vest by HighCom, popular among USEC PMCs. Coyote version.
byKey.67ab3d4b83869afd170fdd3f Description: A portable torch with a limited gas supply. This bad boy is unlikely to burn a hole in the wall, but will do the job on a small metal target.
byKey.67ab3ea96d7ece17bf0096f6 Description: "Alpha" is a high-quality chest rig that fully meets the military standards for reliability and functionality. The combination of integrated pouches and MOLLE straps provides the means of carrying a large number of necessary equipment. The vest is designed as a classic chest rig. In this type of vest, all the gear is located in the front and side parts, while the back part is comprised of adjustment belts and straps. Manufactured by ANA Tactical. MultiCam camouflage version.
byKey.67ab3f146d7ece17bf0096ff Description: A custom-made chest rig for wearing on top of body armor in urban operations. Sturdy and versatile, it features both MOLLE and ALICE attachment systems. Khaki version.
byKey.67ab49aab9c7a1e18c095686 Description: The Crye Precision AVS plate carrier equipped with Groin Protector and pouches in assault configuration. MultiCam camouflage version.
byKey.67ab4b2d6f7ae4aa550bbcf6 Description: A plate carrier with a set of pouches for use with assault rifles. Manufactured by 5.11 Tactical. Storm color version.
byKey.67af41dd1eb308667602db4a Description: Modern sunglasses, made in a sporty style. Great for a stylish shootout at the gas station.
byKey.67af425c2676ade5750b50e6 Description: Legendary mercenary glasses around the world. Wear them if you want to be cool, like Vovan from the hood.
byKey.67af42942676ade5750b50e8 Name: Oakley SI M Frame safety glasses (Orange lenses)
byKey.67af42942676ade5750b50e8 Description: Ballistic glasses with impact-resistant polycarbonate lenses.
byKey.67af42b38d9ef5c57e0d5126 Description: Sunglasses with a round-shaped frame. Cool and stylish!
byKey.67b49e7335dec48e3e05e057 Description: The F-1 hand grenade (GRAU Index 57-G-721) is an anti-personnel fragmentation grenade, designed for neutralizing enemy personnel in defensive combat. This version is personally modified by Partisan and has a shortened fuze, intended for explosive tripwires.
byKey.67bdea8667098e658f064695 Description: A personalized RFID card with a strict design. Grants access to the TerraGroup evacuation point reserved for trusted personnel.
byKey.67bdf04d66ca1d79a2024637 Description: A personalized RFID card with a strict design. Now that it is activated, you can try to slip into the port.
byKey.67bdf0e67c1ef7a648043531 Description: A keycard found in Kruglov's safe.
byKey.67c031b79320f644db06f456 Description: A blank access keycard template. It doesn’t open anything, at least not yet.
byKey.67c033fd0610e91bea056998 Name: Reprogrammed RFID keycard with Mr. Kerman's hash codes
byKey.67c033fd0610e91bea056998 Description: An RFID keycard reprogrammed using hash codes from Mr. Kerman. Grants access to the port Terminal. At least, it should.
byKey.67c0345b354fca26a0008036 Name: Flash drive with Mr. Kerman's hash codes
byKey.67c0345b354fca26a0008036 Description: A flash drive containing updated hash codes for RFID cards. Handed over by a trusted associate of Mr. Kerman.
byKey.67c04a6f9152fbdfa306cc66 Name: Reprogrammed RFID keycard with Prapor's hash codes
byKey.67c04a6f9152fbdfa306cc66 Description: An RFID keycard reprogrammed using hash codes from Prapor. Grants access to the port Terminal. At least, it should.

byKey.67c04a9bd98287be7b0923d8 Description: A flash drive containing updated hash codes for RFID cards. Handed over by Prapor for a small favor.

byKey.68bfea10befab555234f24e7: A.P.: Friends! Who’s still out there? Dmitry Sergeevich, come in and close the door, please. Thank you. Are all departments represented? I see they are. Let us begin, then.
byKey.68bfea81ace495db5dd420fe: A.P.: By now, everyone’s noticed that communications have been down since this morning and many divisions are in lockdown. I’d like to say this is just another drill, but this time it’s very serious.
byKey.68bfead59f35304935f45ccf: A.P.: We received an order from New York today. We’re evacuating.
byKey.68c004eb1f214220734a84b8: A.P.: Quiet, colleagues! I understand your concern, but we have to stay focused. I initiated the protocol a few hours ago. The specialists are already working on data destruction and sealing the premises.
byKey.68c004e2955985870577e03c: A.P.: All projects in Tarkov are being shut down, including affiliated enterprises. From now on, contact with them will be handled only through… hmm… Gennady Viktorovich, I don’t see you, raise your hand, please. There, that’s the man you’ll need.
byKey.68c00568392d494177787911: A.P.: I believe there shouldn’t be any issues. Those drills we ran weren’t for nothing…
byKey.68ebc08101d0cb0643451519: Question from the audience: Half of my samples aren’t ready yet. What’s going to happen to them?
byKey.68c0059893024df9cf45f900: A.P.: Pyotr Alekseevich, please, hold your questions…
byKey.68ebc18858ac9a665a44a76c: Question from the audience: Excuse me, what about the large equipment?
byKey.68ebc19744c2d00ba9333242: A.P.: The centrifuge has already been disassembled, literally an hour ago. Enough! Time is precious right now!
byKey.68c005e22151a721182c6134: A.P.: You’ll be able to ask your questions at the end, but for now, let’s stay on topic. Key personnel will be evacuated to the Health Resort — many of you have already vacationed there before.
byKey.68c00612c87d44e373310e11: A.P.: It’s now being used as an interim evacuation site. Logistics, escort, and security are handled by United Security personnel.
byKey.68c00644a8cf72f81458aed6: A.P.: But be careful! Our cooperation with them ends immediately after arrival at the Health Resort!
byKey.68c006621e64ef2cfcc8a6fe: A.P.: After that point, a new contractor will make contact, and management strongly advises against approaching USEC operatives.

byKey.68ea4b335d7b2a17b80d864b: Cult Victim: Tape #1. Time is… time is 14:09.
byKey.68ea4b401a05b785a47dcba0: Cult Victim: My name’s Igor. I feel like some secret agent doing this.
byKey.68ea4bd8c8f2d309335f4ced: Cult Victim: I even had to switch to analog recordings. You know, with a tape recorder. At least that way any of those freaks can’t hack it.
byKey.68ea4c07aab1ea429a1a615b: Cult Victim: Yesterday someone slipped a book under my door. Creepy as hell, covered in those same symbols that started showing up around the city…
byKey.68ea4c2e41e7c0ed05e50a19: Cult Victim: At first I thought it was some prank. Like, you know, that old TV show, Naked and Funny. That one sure is an oldie…
byKey.68ea4c592b91da8e908eea0e: Cult Victim: Anyway, the book! I read it. Spent the whole evening on it. And it’s full of… of some serious weirdness.
byKey.68ea4c6b46290038d27a7c60: Cult Victim: Not nonsense, no. More like… I don’t know, like someone knows things they really shouldn’t know.
byKey.68ea4c9e8889510bfb233747: Cult Victim: Well, our Cobalt is connected to TerraGroup, and over the years I’ve learned a few things.
byKey.68ea4caf785ce98c0aab45d9: Cult Victim: So these… these "Gifts" mentioned in the book sound an awful lot like some of TerraGroup’s projects. The secret type.
byKey.68ea4cf2b96a40eec8a7dfd2: Cult Victim: I’m sure they tried to recruit me. Like, into some cult. Only these guys are way more sophisticated than your average Peoples Temple types.
byKey.68ea4d048525e273c034c70b: Cult Victim: They think I have access to some "Eye of the World". That’s why they need me. And they’re not gonna stop at just sending a book.
byKey.68ea4d316b4c67d2ace3954b: Cult Victim: I have to run. Yes… yes, I need to disappear. Lay low, maybe even in Bruges.
byKey.68ea4d5bc7d5d070e9de9603: Cult Victim: They’ve been watching me. This whole time. And I thought it was just paranoia. Even talked about it with my therapist, for fuck’s sake!
byKey.68ea4d635981f09c3094eba7: Cult Victim: I should’ve trusted my gut. Maybe I wouldn’t have to drop everything and run now. I…
byKey.6811e9119b009e592c07a59e Description: An audio tape from the apartment of the cult victim. The recording mentions something called the Eye of the World.

Its reverse-cone shape makes it highly effective at reducing muzzle flash, and it also slightly lessens the concussive effect when firing indoors. Compatible with any caliber from 5.45 to 7.62 on the AK-74 platform, or with the appropriate adapter on AKM or AK-12 assault rifles.
byKey.686665484c6f39163e076c3d Description: A piece of a map found on a Scav. Will it lead to trouble or great riches? Time will tell.
byKey.6866665cdf54e1190902df55 Description:
A perfect duplicate of the programmer's diary. How Mechanic achieved such resemblance and why is a mystery.

The first page has a table of contents:
• Update
• Notes 
• Highlights
• Encrypt
• Agenda 
• Ruminates
• Drafts
byKey.686666db646d47fec3018925 Description: The most ordinary-looking disk. The only thing that catches your eye is the “Ⅰ” written on top. If this is a first disk, then there must be a second one somewhere?
byKey.68666887df54e1190902df57 Description: A folder with decrypted data from the military flash drives. Someone out there would give millions for one of these.
byKey.6866ad3853330f9b83064cf9 Description: It seems the Black Division operatives have somehow prepared a working access keycard. It should also work on doors at the seaport.
byKey.6866adbe09b973bf45094339 Description: This key should fit the door that blocks access to the pier leading to the evacuation zone.
byKey.6871284e9a353bb50606f3ed Description: AS VAL MOD.4 is the fourth special modification of the integrally suppressed assault rifle, intended for Russian special operations units and task groups. The MOD.4 features improved controls: an enlarged magazine release button, additional safety selector lever, and an integrated custom charging handle. Developed by members of the BEAR Norvinsk brigade.
byKey.687128c4505fed5f370b1625 Description: A custom handguard designed for the AS VAL MOD.4. Features rails for mounting optics, tactical accessories, and foregrips.
byKey.68712a7d505fed5f370b1633 Description: A flared magazine well for the AS VAL MOD.4. Enables faster and more precise magazine insertion.
byKey.68712b57a1be89347f0d8179 Description: A 3.5 inch rail for the AS VAL MOD.4 handguard. Allows installation of tactical equipment.
byKey.68712bd4251b8d4c6c04ec19 Description: A custom mount for the AS VAL MOD.4. Allows installation of optics.
byKey.68712cafa1be89347f0d817c Description: A muzzle cap for the AS VAL MOD.4 sound suppressor.
byKey.68712ce2251b8d4c6c04ec1f Description: An integral barrel-suppressor module for the AS VAL MOD.4.
byKey.68750378555049ec270cdab7 Description: A simple disk with a handwritten note that this is the second version, the final one. Finally you can go through the whole game all the way to the end. Gotta write a review later!
byKey.6877c2dcda2a05d0cb04f983 Description: A handwritten note left in the open workspace of the TerraGroup laboratory.
byKey.6877c834b52f568d4b0ea5a5 Name: Note on preparations for the Arrival
byKey.6877c834b52f568d4b0ea5a5 Description: A torn notebook page detailing preparations for the Arrival.
byKey.6877c866ae5d3a06a30d7f3f Description: A paint-smeared document containing an order from TerraGroup's main office.
byKey.6877c87dd66d08f590036126 Name: Note with ramblings about the Purification
byKey.6877c87dd66d08f590036126 Description: A blank TerraGroup sheet with a rough scribble. Doesn't resemble the handwriting of office staff.
byKey.6878c143254146e6fd043756 Description: A custom muzzle brake for the AS VAL MOD.4.
byKey.6878c1c723c3173d7f06d926 Description: A custom muzzle device for the AS VAL MOD.4, installed on the MOD.4 handguard.
byKey.6878cc5bd0c26d57bf0aa37a Description: A custom Zenit pistol grip for the AS VAL. Replaces the standard pistol grip.
byKey.6878ccf4181ac8a5b5077236 Description: An adapter for installing aftermarket buttstocks on the AS VAL.
byKey.68ea5b6bcc7c899f90fa5168: A.P.: I understand your concerns! I don’t have all the information myself, but I’m confident that our new partners will be just as reliable as USEC personnel.
byKey.68ea5b6e2bff0736c56a09f2: A.P.: TerraGroup has always prioritized security and will entrust our evacuation only to true professionals.
byKey.68ea5b71a0dfaf2f689331f9: A.P.: Speaking of the evacuation… In 13 hours and 47 minutes, all TerraGroup facilities must be vacated. Yes, this is the first time we’re working under such a rush, but there’s no other way.
byKey.68ea5b739da8063244c3c72c: A.P.: I’ve received the codes, "Braun" and "Chernigov" included… Also from Lisbon. So by the time the timer runs out, no one should be left here!
byKey.68ea5b73a7a41ecce08c4f6e: A.P.: I’ll be evacuating last. Well, not just me. Korneev, are you here?
byKey.68ebc308a4c32e2d12d4fefa: A.P.: Good. Once everything is sealed, we’ll head to the Health Resort.
byKey.68ea5b74ea2509d99a698972: A.P.: I understand, colleagues. It’s hard to realize that all production must be shut down. We won’t be able to take microbiology at all, just the data and parameters…
byKey.68ebc32be4c53dcc9bd8b22d: Shout from the audience: How are we supposed to leave all this? We spent a year setting up the lab!
byKey.68ebc33fca247ad6cc115f20: A.P.: Galina Petrovna, calm down! Everything will be fine at the new location.
byKey.68ea5b76d221e86990817609: A.P.: Alright, one more thing, this is important! Ahem, excuse me, I have to take this…
byKey.68ea5b7666c1da892bdcfc33: A.P.: Hello? Yes, "Schliss 14"… Already… Yes… Wait, right now? Understood… Give me two minutes, I’ll find a spot.
byKey.68ea5b778aa1929224c560fd: A.P.: Friends! It's an extremely urgent call, I need to step away. My apologies. I’ll be back soon.
byKey.68889263ea36baf84d085540 Description: A tape from the lecture hall recording one of the TerraGroup meetings.
byKey.68b6da4fa4c6b15d3a5aa856: Cult Victim: The last tape ran out. I didn’t think it would happen this fast. Alright, I’ll make this quick.
byKey.68b6da643eac094f2a6db325: Cult Victim: Anyway, those guys… those guys in hoods… They’re watching me. I just found a note stuck in my door.
byKey.68b6da89958758ab3bdd1f10: Cult Victim: You know, between the door and the frame—whatever! It said something about the "Eye of the World", that I look through it and it looks back at me… The Priests called me the chosen one!
byKey.68b6dac1931001229ba59040: Cult Victim: I need to run. I’m recording this on my way to the train station. I have to get out of here, doesn’t matter where or how anymore!
byKey.688893c5a030f9346505e6d5 Description: An audio tape found among the personal belongings of the victim in the cultists' torture chamber. It seems the owner was chosen deliberately.
byKey.68bfe3ea49ce213ef5bbe91d: Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.
byKey.68bfe485ab69c3165dbe2666: Courier: This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909.
byKey.68bfe4b2f6c2fbe0b6f830c1: Courier: I was supposed to deliver urgent mail to Norvinsk, but the roads are fu- busy, so I’m going to be delayed.
byKey.68889451ad1e91bfa40db8fd Description: One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the first call from May 11.
byKey.68bfe54cea9d42e405c48978: Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.
byKey.68bfe58e6ee688ea3231200c: Courier: This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909.
byKey.68bfe5a2a4df6e8c4d32f43f: Courier: Things are way worse than I thought. Half the roads are blocked. I have no idea if I’ll make it out of Tarkov today.
byKey.68bfe5c79ed44eab76e9691c: Courier: Let the recipient know not to hang up on the call center.
byKey.688894da0bc983c31509f32a Description: One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the second call from May 11.
byKey.68bfe8209001207c19920342: Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.
byKey.68bfe82fea18902e3dbb117a: Courier: This is a complete clusterfuck! They're stopping everyone at the checkpoint, the line's already kilometers long.
byKey.68bfe85b2a0d3361aff78d80: Courier: The truck driver in front of me started arguing with them, and they fucking shot him! Are you fucking hearing this?!
byKey.68bfe87b6da55cc254d91668: Courier: A stray bullet hit my car! I almost fucking died! You know what, I don't get paid for this. I’m getting outta here on foot to my family.
byKey.68bfe8a843ed244d2dbfef97: Courier: I’m leaving the car, all the parcels are inside. Life’s more important. If you send someone - the key… the key is under the wheel.
byKey.68889504f6192726ac07c66c Description: One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the third call from May 11.
byKey.68ea496b680155845750f646: Priest: The new masters of the world are already here, and the process has begun… The New World has started to take shape, and the Wardens have already been chosen.
byKey.68ea4982dbbc029cd8cba974: Priest: Know that the Eye of the World has been watching you for a long time, and all… all your deeds are imprinted in the memory that the Wardens will carry from the old world into the new. Soon, it will be the only thing of value.
byKey.68ea49bc10d60054c4314ba6: Priest: I knew you would come here. It was all foretold. We awaited the Blind One who would help us prepare everything for the Riders of the Arrival. And in you… we found him.
byKey.68ea49e3857888888b31a46b: Priest: Behold the power of The Unheard before it is too late…
byKey.688895322f6b5b76380e6af5 Description: An audio tape that somehow ended up in the safe at station 14-4 KORD. Either someone slipped it in unnoticed when the server room’s cooling system was activated, or they already knew what would happen.
byKey.6888954ba66a069e0405a9aa Name: SVT-40 Addley Precision Smith-less Scope Mount
byKey.6888954ba66a069e0405a9aa Description: A scope mount designed for the SVT-40. Manufactured by Addley Precision.
byKey.68ea5cf776c0ede0d9c5a817: Voevoda: To the commander of the Gnezdo base. Reporting. After the combat task was completed, someone detonated an explosive.
byKey.68ea5d024573d2106c48247b: Voevoda: We have casualties among USEC operators and civilians. One of ours is critically wounded, the rest have light injuries. Assistance required. I repeat, assistance required!
byKey.6888958794cca0a80b070ae9 Description: An audio tape recording the conversations between the Gnezdo outpost fighters and the Bogatyr squad.
byKey.68ea5d7dc9d0d9a159b983b7: Voevoda: Ahem… I never kept a diary. Thought it was a stupid idea. But now I feel like I should share my thoughts with someone.
byKey.68ea5d80f539fdd7d8da5714: Voevoda: The Bogatyr squad got into a bad mess. Some of my boys are dead, others wounded. Maybe that is why I keep thinking this is not an accident.
byKey.68ea5d893da1b5dc69d7c4f8: Voevoda: This is not only happening here. Tarkov, conflicts in the Middle East, hunger, poverty, global warming…
byKey.68ea5d89efd6a99ffab2bfe2: Voevoda: People seem to be going mad! But strangely, it’s very sudden. A decent family man turns and shoots his little girls.
byKey.68ea5d8bdb4e6054df0aa670: Voevoda: It's the same here. Tarkov used to be a prosperous city. People came here on purpose. Then… the sore burst and it spilled out…
byKey.68ea5d905c698056dbe453c0: Voevoda: What if it’s the Earth itself trying to rid itself of the filth, this humanity virus? People only harm this planet. Maybe this is the end for all of us?
byKey.68ea5d97c0a7439dc36ee052: Voevoda: I do not know. But those thoughts just keep coming. End transmission.
byKey.6888965ac122cae7a20765fa Description: This recording seems to capture one of Voevoda’s reflections on the causes of the Tarkov conflict.
byKey.68ea3f2c338b34173ffabfcd: TerraGroup Scientist: This is Nikolay Voronenko speaking. The Labyrinth is the worst technically equipped TerraGroup facility, we have already lost contact with headquarters. Perhaps one of the test subjects cut the cable…
byKey.68ea3f4de3134607b894de76: TerraGroup Scientist: The facility was stormed by BEAR mercenaries. To defend the Labyrinth I had to release the test subjects from groups 3 and 12.
byKey.68ea3fadc9a693d7baf38672: TerraGroup Scientist: Judging by the sounds, only the test subjects are left outside now, I can’t hear any of the BEARs.
byKey.68ea3fee8e6687c4bb654b12: TerraGroup Scientist: The experiments carried out in the Labyrinth are too important and too dangerous to lose the results. So I gathered all the facility documentation into a folder and threw it into the drain.
byKey.68ea400f95d9f79ba8156536: TerraGroup Scientist: I don’t know if I’ll make it to the evacuation point… but during the chase I managed to grab a pistol from one of the BEARs. It will be a last resort.
byKey.688897992f6b5b76380e6af9 Description: The final recording of a TerraGroup scientist who locked himself in the Labyrinth observation room.
byKey.68ea6839c23ff215e422b819: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: …so. There are no exact dates yet. We think everything will start in about… three months. You and your, um, team should move in right after our signal.
byKey.68ea68bdc7be47262d193787: Chepyga: And the cops? I’m not sending my boys to their deaths for nothing.
byKey.68ea68c0a9ada0a918d84778: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: The mayor is aware and will take care of it. The pay is good, considering all your risks. Sponsors pay in foreign currency, just the way we like it.
byKey.68ea68d872f730061c4681e4: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: Only this time you'll be able to take control of the whole city. Once the dust settles, obviously.
byKey.68ea68d82ea1b09e812f9154: Chepyga: Shit's getting serious. There'll be a lots of bodies.
byKey.68ea68d949c007685b23bdd5: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: There will be a lot of blood spilled, but not yours and not ours, assuming we act together.
byKey.68ea68dad6cd9377c08aa7a9: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: Equipment, weapons, medical supplies — everything will be provided. Your tasks are tough, we won’t leave you without support.
byKey.68ea68e9b219ba434c5e2b53: Chepyga: We’ll need more people. And waste a couple of local big shots beforehand so they don’t start nosing around. It’ll be harder if we don't do it soon enough.
byKey.68ea68ec6dd81f45f0f880f1: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: If you handle it cleanly, I’ll help cover it up. After things heat up, we won’t have trouble finding volunteers.
byKey.68ea68edb4edf66d6749b6ff: Chepyga: Aight. When do we get the guns?
byKey.68ea68ee3c16c4ccfedd5926: Chepyga: Hey you! The fuck you doing here?! Come here!
byKey.688897e094cca0a80b070aed Description: An audio tape prepared by Kozlov for Anastasia. According to Kozlov’s letters, it contains irrefutable proof of the city administration’s ties to the local criminal underworld.
byKey.691343ce4ded41ee2bea97ff: Squad Leader: The explosion knocked out all our electronics.
byKey.69134497768350d6a4cedbc4: Squad Leader: I repeat. Our comms are out!
byKey.68b6dc8e96312975395afe50: Squad Leader: Operation is canceled! Fall back to the evacuation points on your own!
byKey.68889a2f94cca0a80b070af1 Name: BEAR commander's audio tape labeled "For the BEARs"
byKey.68889a2f94cca0a80b070af1 Description: An audio tape containing important instructions left by our squad’s commander.
byKey.69133e6503f523df53ea3baf: Squad Leader: To all USEC... To all USEC units! Blast killed all...
byKey.68b6dc376444a29985459601: Squad Leader: Blast killed all our electronics — no comm with HQ.
byKey.68b6dc38871052ba31637157: Squad Leader: We have lost control of the facility. Evacuate through Exfil Three towards the port... Exfil Three!
byKey.68ea5149598a79eedb06884c: Squad Leader: Expect enemy contact, proceed with caution. Any non-USEC individuals are to be considered hostile!
byKey.691340c1bb5c24fdd4327cc7: Squad Leader: Defend yourselves. Use sound judgment.
byKey.68889aab3fcaf13e48003ba7 Name: USEC commander's audio tape labeled "For the USEC"
byKey.68889aab3fcaf13e48003ba7 Description: An audio tape containing important instructions left by our squad’s commander.
byKey.68b6dbf69a46a09a1c755f05: USEC Operative: Commander! How much... How much longer do you reckon we'll be stuck here?
byKey.68b6dbfac7e0a00e1b02ec36: USEC Squad Leader: For as long as they tell us to. TerraGroup still has a fuckload of unclosed facilities in Tarkov.
byKey.68b6dbfa3a0b2378a39c6f71: USEC Operative: You think they’ll manage to pull everything out on time? Even with their resources, it sounds impossible.
byKey.68b6dbfa028de235e5884fe8: USEC Squad Leader: Let them set their priorities themselves. We’ve already got our hands full babysitting HVIs and hauling out TerraGroup’s docs.
byKey.68b6dbfae852a369ef69cff3: USEC Operative: But still, even if everything is moved out, there will be hundreds of digital drives left behind… There’s no way to evacuate something like that in war conditions.
byKey.68b6dbfc0a786dba6c327834: USEC Squad Leader: They're not gonna extract everything, okay? I heard TerraGroup has some kind of weapon that wipes data from the systems. All of it.
byKey.68b6dbfcc931094cdde643ca: USEC Operative: Like an EMP? Surely they’re gonna give us a heads-up, right? It would screw all our coordination.
byKey.68ea55505b158349b62f392b: USEC Squad Leader: Why would they hide this from us? Even if they do end up using this thing, it'll only be after we're evacuated.
byKey.68ea55514f5e2232e04de6e5: USEC Squad Leader: Without our PMC support, they wouldn't last long — they have no one but us.
byKey.68ea5552705a83548ab21c35: USEC Operative: What about those “contractors” we transferred the HVIs to? They looked quite serious. No, shady too. No insignias, no patches… Who are they anyway?
byKey.68ea5554bb3c96a1b0486d78: USEC Squad Leader: There is no info on them from the HQ, so clearly we shouldn't get involved in that shit. They might be linked to that specialist guy over at the lighthouse.
byKey.68ea55540998610ed57006a4: USEC Squad Leader: Or perhaps they're just an escort crew from outside the border — our guys are stretched thin here. Either way, we can't trust them.
byKey.68ea55554c65adb6ac6ff1cd: USEC Operative: Makes you wonder how fast TerraGroup would’ve been screwed up without us involved…
byKey.68ea5556764900cda357fdac: USEC Operative: Especially now, when even some of our own commanders are straying away from their orders…
byKey.68ea555862ec9eed52f766f8: USEC Squad Leader: Listen, watch your mouth! Any other situation, and I'd have you deployed somewhere far worse!
byKey.69134af1579037fde7cd1e14: USEC Squad Leader: So shut up. SHUT UP!
byKey.68889aca77aeb067290816f1 Description: A personal audio tape on which a USEC operative recorded a conversation with their commander during a rest stop.
byKey.68889c930b29b8032504f369 Name: SVT-40 Addley Precision Steel Scope Mount
byKey.68889c930b29b8032504f369 Description: A scope mount designed for the SVT-40. Manufactured by Addley Precision.
byKey.6888ac0f5978b35e90010b49 Description: A wood stock for the SVT-40/AVT-40 rifles styled after the SVD sniper rifle.
byKey.6889e4cd3ff7e9cfbc0c507c Description: An unassuming thumb drive. Contains classified military data which was not taken out of the city in time. It's best to gather as many of these as you can. Just in case.
byKey.6889f1c4f7a5d7de7b089550 Description: A 30-round 5.7x28 magazine for the FN Five-seveN pistol. Manufactured by ProMag.
byKey.688a0b38467521f9080693a3 Description: A fiber optic red dot sight manufactured by MeproLight. Installed on a proprietary mount.
byKey.688a0bf28cdd409ce60911ce Description: A Picatinny/Weaver quick-detach mount base for Mepro series red dot sights. Manufactured by MeproLight.
byKey.688b2dba67bf6fa26c07e918 Description: An ordinary toolbox with an unordinary color. Most of the stickers on it are inexistent in Tarkov. Someone has paid a hefty price to smuggle it from outside the cordon.
byKey.688b2e574172ca83e70cf868 Description: A unique armband for the most sociable operators.
byKey.688b3bfa1ed594eccd0c45ee Description: A unique face mask with an unusual paint job. Guess someone should check their DMs.
byKey.688b44cb28bf8d85cd0ff108 Description: The SRO (Specialized Reflex Optic) is a rugged, compact reflex sight. It can be used as a primary or backup optic. Requires a compatible base to mount on Weaver-style rails. Manufactured by Trijicon.
byKey.688b4bd81cef2a61d0052738 Description: The SRO (Specialized Reflex Optic) is a rugged, compact reflex sight. It can be used as a primary or backup optic. Requires a compatible base to mount on Weaver-style rails. Manufactured by Trijicon. Flat Dark Earth version.
byKey.688b54a11cef2a61d005273b Name: Elcan SpecterDR Mounting Plate for Trijicon
byKey.688b54a11cef2a61d005273b Description: A mount base for installation of RMR-type reflex sights on the Elcan SpecterDR scope.
byKey.688b79b5eb234c75d900e050 Description: A 9A-91 handguard with a bottom rail for installation of foregrips. Manufactured by TTS System.
byKey.688b7b0d934c59b7bf0af0b7 Description: A compact lightweight rail for the TTS System handguard, designed for installation of small optics or tactical devices. Manufactured by TTS System.
byKey.688b7c1b0e99e554a90c0fb7 Description: A 2.5 inch rail that allows installation of additional equipment on the TTS System handguard. Manufactured by TTS System.
byKey.688c86420e99e554a90c0fd6 Description: A custom handguard for the SR-3M assault rifle made on order from one of the well-known local operatives. Made out of aircraft-grade aluminum alloy and fitted with Zenit rails for installation of additional tactical equipment.
byKey.688c9df121038434840a1e06 Description: An adapter for installing 1913 Picatinny buttstocks, designed for AK-style assault rifles with 5.5mm pin folding stocks. Manufactured by JMac Customs.
byKey.688cbdc341e2a57a8f0c1c6c Name: AK Samson Rear Trunnion Folding Stock Adapter
byKey.688cbdc341e2a57a8f0c1c6c Description: A 1913 stock adapter, designed for installation on AK-series assault rifles. Manufactured by Samson Manufacturing.
byKey.689166b6c2d6fa42e7044756 Description: A variant of the Kalashnikov assault rifle designed for export to countries whose armies continue to use the 7.62x51 NATO (.308 Win) cartridge as their standard infantry small arms ammunition. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Group.
byKey.689166debd91cc17c109c753 Description: A standard-issue handguard for the AK-308 assault rifle. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Group.
byKey.68916701bd91cc17c109c758 Description: A 20-round 7.62x51 NATO magazine for the AK-308 assault rifle. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Group.
byKey.689167248f19dbc8190728ed Description: A standard receiver dust cover with an integrated Picatinny rail for AK-308 assault rifles. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Group.
byKey.68916765fa628c6b9f0ed6f6 Description: A standard-issue removable rear sight base mount for the AK-308 assault rifle. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Group.
byKey.689167d79f03ec70cb0ea066 Description: A standard-issue 7.62x51 NATO flash hider for the AK-308 assault rifle. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Group.
byKey.6891bb203bbad2a6230f9be8 Description: A note in which someone scolds a USEC operative for poor weapon maintenance.
byKey.6891bb67f674f551000a38d3 Name: Escape route map from the TerraGroup office area
byKey.6891bb67f674f551000a38d3 Description: A map showing USEC retreat points from the TerraGroup office area. Judging by the tags, it was intercepted by the BEARs after the EMP blast.
byKey.6891bb83d7502d512502d160 Description: A newspaper issue featuring an article on the escalating conflict in Tarkov.
byKey.6891bb9f81d0bf37b10249f4 Description: A mysterious note mentioning the EMP blast that occurred over the TerraGroup office.
byKey.68935269af943a06e8038c58 Description: A 24-round polymer magazine for the Saiga-308 carbine and AK-308 assault rifle. Manufactured by ProMag.
byKey.689479a4a733b1602007e2eb Name: Spiritus Systems LV-119 Plate Carrier (Black Division V1)
byKey.689479a4a733b1602007e2eb Description: A highly customizable modular plate carrier by Spiritus Systems, built for maximum comfort in combat. Wolf Grey version. This setup allows full freedom of movement while providing an ergonomic layout for ammunition and essential gear.
byKey.689479cb47e5acd1e10be986 Name: Ferro Concepts FCPC V5 Plate Carrier (Black Division)
byKey.689479cb47e5acd1e10be986 Description: The fifth-generation FCPC plate carrier continues Ferro Concepts’ focus on lightweight, adaptable gear. In this version, the plate bags and carrier contour have been redesigned for improved comfort and mobility. Coyote Brown version. Equipped with two radios for communicating with both the assigned squad and HQ.
byKey.689479eb30cc5ba7be00f5ff Name: Spiritus Systems LV-119 Plate Carrier (Black Division V2)
byKey.689479eb30cc5ba7be00f5ff Description: A highly customizable modular plate carrier by Spiritus Systems, built for maximum comfort in combat. Black version. This setup is equipped with breaching charges and multiple GP pouches for maximum equipment flexibility.
byKey.68947a4be4bf255d1b0ca746 Name: First Spear Siege-R Optimized M.A.S.S. Plate Carrier (Black Division)
byKey.68947a4be4bf255d1b0ca746 Description: A Siege-R Optimized plate carrier equipped with the M.A.S.S. Shoulder System. Provides reliable all-around protection while offering ample workspace for equipment placement. Black version.
byKey.68947a8ce4bf255d1b0ca759 Name: Tasmanian Tiger Modular Pack 45 Plus (MultiCam Black)
byKey.68947a8ce4bf255d1b0ca759 Description: The TT Modular Pack 45 is a system that can be customized to suit the user’s needs. The top flap can be raised to increase capacity or removed entirely if required. External straps allow attachment of bulky gear or equipment that needs to remain easily accessible. MultiCam Black version.
byKey.68947ab5a733b1602007e2fe Description: This Mystery Ranch backpack is designed for short missions of up to two days. Its compact size is offset by excellent ergonomics. External straps provide convenient attachment points for tools and gear you might need on the go.
byKey.68947ad3e4bf255d1b0ca75c Name: Mystery Ranch NICE Frame Load Sling
byKey.68947ad3e4bf255d1b0ca75c Description: The Load Sling by Mystery Ranch allows to carry heavy, irregularly shaped cargo. Its strap system secures items safely and reliably, while the external MOLLE straps provide versatile attachment points for smaller gear. This particular model is equipped with a spacious case offering extra protection.
byKey.68948a95d8f2b85fb705e2a6 Description: The 6B45 body armor, designed to protect personnel from shrapnel and small arms fire. Part of the Ratnik equipment system and has been in production since the 2010s as a replacement for the 6B43 model.
byKey.68948ad72c87773b9f06d73f Description: A full plate carrier setup built on the 6B45 vest. This setup gives the user a compact yet versatile space for carrying essential gear. EMR camouflage version.
byKey.68948aebd8f2b85fb705e2b0 Description: A full plate carrier setup built on the 6B45 vest. This setup allows for convenient placement of essential combat medical supplies and communication equipment. EMR camouflage version.
byKey.68948b118c57a8a52301d7ae Description: A full plate carrier setup built on the 6B45 vest. This setup provides maximum space for carrying magazines and grenades. EMR camouflage version.

byKey.6895bb82c4519957df062f82 Description: Radian Model 1 Full Auto, an AR-15 platform assault rifle chambered for 5.56x45 NATO. The rifle is positioned as a reliable, high-quality, and accurate system for professional and sporting use. Manufactured by Radian Weapons.

byKey.6895becad55f0ebf6a0c0311 Description: A precision CNC machined upper receiver for the AR-15 platform. Manufactured by Radian Weapons.

byKey.6895bf08e2d16810ba0bf43e Description: An ambidextrous charging handle for the AR-15 platform. Manufactured by Radian Weapons.

White Phosphor tubes version.

byKey.68a639748e1fe612970728e9 Description: An American-made 5.56x45mm assault rifle developed by Colt in the late 1960s as an improved variant of the original AR-15/M16 design. The M16A1 became the standard service rifle of the US military during the Vietnam War, featuring a forward assist and other refinements for reliability in harsh conditions. Though considered outdated by modern standards, it remains a durable and accurate weapon prized by collectors and shooters alike.
byKey.68a6399922b1e0bd360afe56 Description: A later evolution of the M16 platform, the M16A2 introduced a burst-fire mechanism, improved iron sights, handguard and buttstock for greater control and durability. Chambered for 5.56x45mm NATO ammunition, it served as the primary service rifle for the U.S. military throughout the 1980s and 1990s. Known for its precision and dependability, the M16A2 remains a benchmark for modern assault rifle design.
byKey.68a63a9522b1e0bd360afe5f Description: An early type charging handle for AR-15 and compatible systems, manufactured by Colt.
byKey.68a63ac58e1fe612970728f2 Description: A 20 inch (508mm) barrel for AR-15 platform weapons for 5.56x45 NATO ammo. Corresponds with standard service M16A2 barrel.
byKey.68a63b03e1fb670852024656 Description: A three-prong flash hider for the AR-15 series rifles, manufactured by Colt. The classic earlier A1 variant made in the 60s, which was later replaced by the more famous Bird Cage type.
byKey.68a63b73c92ee33ffa01bf57 Description: A classic 20-round 5.56x45 magazine for AR-15. Manufactured by Colt.
byKey.68a63b90e1fb670852024659 Description: An upper receiver for the M16A1E1 assault rifle manufactured by Colt. An early prototype variant between the M16A1 and M16A2, which also served as the basis for the Canadian C7. During the 1980s it was widely fitted to various special carbines produced by Colt.

byKey.68a63bc422b1e0bd360afe61 Description: A standard-issue buttstock for the early-issue M16A1 assault rifles, compatible with AR-15 and AR-10 platforms.
byKey.68a63c1fc92ee33ffa01bf5a Description: The A2 type buttstock for the AR-15. Standard-issue for M16A2 assault rifles. Manufactured by Colt.
byKey.68a63c5ce1fb670852024661 Description: Colt Receiver Extension Buffer Tube, Mil-Spec diameter will fit any AR-15-based carbine or rifle.
byKey.68a63c7322b1e0bd360afe65 Description: A telescopic buttstock, second generation of the classic stock for CAR-15. Manufactured by Colt.

byKey.68a85ab8ef22d08bf401fa68 Description: Taking its name from an Old Norse Viking term for a lightning raid, Strandhögg was one of the first formalized battle tactics to use covert infiltrators in advance of an actual raiding operation. Strandhögg was a tactical game-changer in its time, just like the technological advances First Spear is bringing forward in this line of plate carriers. US Air Force ABU pattern camouflage version.
byKey.68a85ac615a5769d50029cd9 Name: ANA Tactical Alpha chest rig (A-TACS AU)
byKey.68a85ac615a5769d50029cd9 Description: "Alpha" is a high-quality chest rig that fully meets the military standards for reliability and functionality. The combination of integrated pouches and MOLLE straps provides the means of carrying a large number of necessary equipment. The vest is designed as a classic chest rig. In this type of vest, all the gear is located in the front and side parts, while the back part is comprised of adjustment belts and straps. Manufactured by ANA Tactical. A-TACS AU camouflage version.
byKey.68a86bd51d1284a8e20e39d5 Description: An 11.5 inch (292mm) barrel for AR-15 platform weapons for 5.56x45 NATO ammo.
byKey.68a89146212dbbeead0d5636 Description: A low-profile body armor manufactured by NFM. A version for those who really feel the Tarkov atmosphere.
byKey.68a89942431252e29a02dbf6 Description: The Interceptor vest consists of a fabric Outer Tactical Vest (OTV) with dorsal and thoracic pockets and two protective ceramic-composite SAPI or ESAPI inserts. The Outer Tactical Vest (OTV) is a basic vest equipped with aramid fabric pouches that protect against ammunition fragments and 9mm handgun bullets. Woodland camouflage version.
byKey.68a97093431252e29a02dc06 Description: The NPP KlASS Korund-VM heavy bulletproof vest, adopted by the units of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Russia. Kamysh camouflage version.
byKey.68a986615db8a4a66404ff9a Description: This chest rig platform is designed for placing equipment in the chest and abdomen areas, with an open back. Includes integrated pouches, designed for 8 magazines. Can be used both separately and on top of the armor vest. Manufactured by WARTECH. Moss camouflage version.
byKey.68a986ca5c0073fa2d0d8cb8 Description: The Vulkan-5 LShZ-5 high-level protection helmet is intended for use in a set of combat equipment with circular 5-class (Russian GOST) head protection from medium to heavy projectiles. Too big for pool.
byKey.68a98762609a5cb2120ebd26 Description: The Vulkan-5 LShZ-5 high-level protection helmet is intended for use in a set of combat equipment with circular 5-class (Russian GOST) head protection from medium to heavy projectiles. Would match well with a motorbike and leather jacket.
byKey.68a987a1609a5cb2120ebd2f Description: The Vulkan-5 LShZ-5 high-level protection helmet is intended for use in a set of combat equipment with circular 5-class (Russian GOST) head protection from medium to heavy projectiles. Your head is basically invisible with this camouflage.
byKey.68a99207aa809946e507c2f6 Description: An improved lightweight version of the standard plate carrier manufactured by Stich Profi. MARPAT Woodland camouflage version.

byKey.68a9a04373d52d47830759c7 Description: Atomic Defense's CQCM ballistic mask provides protection against wide variety of short-mid range weapons including shotguns and assault rifles. Draws eyes and makes the poor cry.
byKey.68a9a0b01696fb8c1e0ee9cc Description: Atomic Defense's CQCM ballistic mask provides protection against wide variety of short-mid range weapons including shotguns and assault rifles. A bright warning that the user is dangerous for the environment.

byKey.68a9a1223e1ee5a70504c126 Description: Atomic Defense's CQCM ballistic mask provides protection against wide variety of short-mid range weapons including shotguns and assault rifles. This mask has passed the test.
byKey.68a9a15d73d52d47830759c9 Name: Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Demonic Face)
byKey.68a9a15d73d52d47830759c9 Description: Atomic Defense's CQCM ballistic mask provides protection against wide variety of short-mid range weapons including shotguns and assault rifles. Has all the qualities of a top arena fighter – stylish, luxurious, and intimidating all at once.

Comes with an intimidating print.

Painted in green with red and black accents.
byKey.68a9acd9389d6cb1f90af562 Description: A balaclava for those who really want to stand out.
byKey.68a9adc2bc09b91c4f07dbe6 Description: A balaclava for very positive warriors.

byKey.68aee763130c00663d08aea8 Description: The TKPD (Tyazhelyy Karabin Podderzhki Dragunova - "Dragunov Heavy Support Carbine") is a modernized SVDK chambered in 9.3x64mm, commissioned by PMC BEAR. The weapon is noted for high accuracy and effectively suppresses targets at medium ranges. Manufactured by SniperArms Dynamics.
byKey.68aee8f8130c00663d08aeb3 Description: A receiver top cover for the TKPD assault carbine. Equipped with a Picatinny rail for installation of optics.
byKey.68aee9731ef0d507780a61c9 Description: A handguard mounting trunnion for the TKPD assault carbine.
byKey.68aee9b89df2c1144f0aaa46 Description: A 457mm barrel for the TKPD 9.3x64mm assault carbine.
byKey.68aee9e31ef0d507780a61cd Description: A standard gas tube for the TKPD assault carbine.
byKey.68aee9fe130c00663d08aeb6 Description: A standard handguard for the TKPD assault carbine. Allows installation of tactical equipment and a bipod. Black version.

byKey.68aeed8a8906b00bc800fdd6 Description: A 9.3x64mm Soft Point hunting cartridge loaded with a 17.4 gram semi-jacketed bullet.
