byKey.68b98415032fa71d2a000dab Description: A 360mm barrel for VPO-215 rifle chambered in .366TKM.
byKey.68b985da5133d696f7032d37 Description: A tactical threading protection cap for the VPO-215 .366TKM rifle barrel.
byKey.68bac6ca653ee6b1e406d978 Description: A civilian 9.3x64mm Full Metal Jacket cartridge loaded with a 17.5 gram fully jacketed bullet. The full metal jacket reduces deformation on impact. This cartridge is most commonly used for sport shooting, training, and zeroing, and is sometimes used for hunting when minimal damage to game is desired.
byKey.68bad8376cb22acf1107a586 Description: A military 9.3x64mm 7N33 cartridge loaded with a 17.4 gram armor-piercing bullet with a steel core. The 7N33 delivers high penetration thanks to its steel core and substantial muzzle energy. Used by Russian special operations forces.

byKey.68badf5030572e90770cd688 Description: A Weaver rail for the Mossberg 590 shotgun, installed on the receiver. Manufactured by Precision Reflex.

The frame design prevents binding and accidental release of the locking lever, while the standard-thickness rubber buttpad reduces slipping on armor or gear. Black version.
byKey.68bb2a3831ee03fbc00931e6 Description: A quick-detach buttstock for AR-15/M16 carbines with a mil-spec telescoping tube, manufactured by Magpul Original Equipment. The frame design prevents binding and accidental release of the locking lever, while the standard-thickness rubber buttpad reduces slipping on armor or gear. Flat Dark Earth version.

byKey.6932abeb5403890d0c09c926 Description: The SR-25 Precision Rifle is the latest evolution of the precision 7.62mm NATO semi-automatic rifle. An ambidextrous bolt release, selector, and magazine release offers the left-handed user the ergonomic advantages inherent to AR-15 based controls, as well as giving right-handed users alternate methods of manipulation to increase efficiency of movement. The Drop-In 2-Stage Trigger serves as an aid to long range precision marksmanship. The E2 bolt and gas system provides superior reliability in function whether suppressed or unsuppressed. Coated in cerakote Taupe color.

byKey.6936ff8734029a096c06f95a Description: Atomic Defense's CQCM ballistic mask provides protection against short-range weapons including pistols, shotguns and knives. The cracks are painted, don't worry.
byKey.6937ecc3dbdccab44605fcf0 Description: This case is meant to store dogtags of fighters with special distinctions. Don’t put ordinary mercs’ tags in it.
byKey.6937eccbfd921faceb0dfecd Description: A very rare wallet model from the famous brand. Suitable for truly valuable items: cash and rare keycards.
byKey.6937ecd37713b904480013ac Description: A promotional cooler bag made by Hot Rod for the "Juice Time" campaign. The fabric honeycomb inside keeps drinks upright but makes the bag unsuitable for storing food.
byKey.6937ecf8628ee476240c07cb Description: Sometimes nothing is more important than having a fracture splint within easy reach. The founder of Tigzresq knows this firsthand.
byKey.6937ed118715e9fd1b0f286d Description: Only a crate of tangerines could be better. But in Tarkov, few are likely to have one.
byKey.6937edb912d456a817083e82 Description: A dumbbell from the limited "Man-Machine" series by the renowned sports equipment manufacturer. They say this series was inspired by a famous athlete from Kazakhstan.
byKey.6937efd50543dcc2560a2c81 Description: A white ushanka from Ragman's reserves, opened for New Year. Warms not only the body but also the soul.
byKey.6937f02dfd6488bb27024839 Description: A ushanka with an emblem occasionally spotted on the streets of Tarkov. Domontovich used to take part in the urban battles himself — until he disappeared. Some say Lightkeeper had something to do with it.
byKey.69398e94ca94fd2877039504 Description: This balaclava seems to have a strange smell. Its previous owner apparently wore it without ever taking it off.
byKey.6939948dc2ceb9acd7082eb2 Description: A worn-out key to the outhouse in an old house somewhere on the edge of the Priozersk nature reserve. It feels like it's been used many times. Why the outhouse was locked and what treasures it might hide is a mystery.
byKey.693bb59250fafa102607aeb7 Description: The EARMOR M32 headset is an activated electronic communication hearing protector, ideal for tactical use. Manufactured by OPSMEN. Version in white color.
byKey.693be003582cc8870b090b41 Description: The Caiman Hybrid helmet is a new generation of lightweight special forces helmet. A series of modular accessories enhances the package, providing users with lightweight, comfortable and maximum head protection. Manufactured by Galvion. MultiCam Alpine version.
byKey.693be056fd3a5c751e00de04 Name: Galvion Caiman Hybrid Ballistic Mandible Guard (MultiCam Alpine)
byKey.693be056fd3a5c751e00de04 Description: A special additional ballistic protection for the Caiman Hybrid helmet, mounted on the side rails. Manufactured by Galvion. MultiCam Alpine version.
byKey.693be0ee50fafa102607aebd Name: Galvion Caiman Hybrid Ballistic Applique (MultiCam Alpine)
byKey.693be0ee50fafa102607aebd Description: An additional up-armor helmet shell attachment to elevate or enhance ballistic and fragmentation protection of the Caiman Hybrid Helmet. Manufactured by Galvion. MultiCam Alpine version.
byKey.693be8f650fafa102607aed4 Name: HighCom Striker ULACH IIIA helmet (Winter Mesh Spray)
byKey.693be8f650fafa102607aed4 Description: A combat helmet with the ears and back of the head protection, manufactured by HighCom. Spray painted with a winter mesh pattern for better camouflage.
byKey.693bfb50d5c25889e701d444 Description: Despite everything, an empty coffee can remains one of the best containers for storing various small construction hardware.
byKey.693fd0e9deee848f70054999 Description: The widely beloved Jumpable Plate Carrier (JPC) was designed to maximize operator mobility by reducing weight and bulk. Its modular system allows for personalized loadouts and quick gear adjustments depending on the mission. Manufactured by Crye Precision. MultiCam version.
byKey.693fd1200ec97e98040bd3f9 Description: A cheap airsoft knockoff of the Crye Precision JPC plate carrier. Doesn't offer the comfort of the original JPC, but retains extensive customization options. It looks like the previous owner chose not to overload the carrier with pouches to stay as mobile as possible.
byKey.693fd13aa490096a05028cc8 Description: A cheap airsoft knockoff of the Crye Precision JPC plate carrier. Doesn't offer the comfort of the original JPC, but retains extensive customization options. Someone attached an IOTV shoulder pad to this one to act as a groin protector.
byKey.69412e1d0045b2176002e4eb Description: An insulated mask with a fleece lining, designed for extremely low temperatures. The combination of practicality and an intimidating appearance makes it especially appealing to movie villains and to anyone heading out on a mission when it's truly freezing outside.
byKey.69412e5573dcf473e50be464 Description: The M2 vest is created with the use of the best experience of Russian special forces operators. The versatility of the system makes it possible to use this vest both when carrying out urban tasks and when performing tasks on rough terrain. Manufactured by ANA Tactical. MultiCam Alpine version.
byKey.69413241b1ce1e5fbb09ed0a Description: A high-end solution in tactical hearing protection. Custom-made to fit the wearer, so this matching size is a real stroke of luck.
byKey.6943c85be2f21398e70378cc Description: Small Arms Protective Insert (SAPI) is a ballistic plate for front and back pouches of a plate carrier. However, this is a lightweight non-ballistic replica, primarily used by airsofters and cosplayers.
byKey.69774bb0a247161ff1068335 Description: A spreadable meat product made from cooked ingredients, produced by Norvinsk Poultry Plant. No ducks were harmed in the making. Probably.
byKey.697883474afb9f7de10380ba Description: A true lifesaver for poster collectors. No more bent corners!
byKey.697c79b1daf4828686033fcb Description: The Maska-1 bulletproof protective helmet appeared in service in 1991 as a replacement for the "Sphere" helmet, designed for use by the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation armed forces. The Maska-1SCh ("Mask-1 Shield") modification features a bulletproof steel faceshield to ensure maximum protection of the user's face.
byKey.697c7a457c3b0223c30d16e6 Description: A special steel bulletproof faceshield for the Maska-1SCh ("Mask-1 Shield") helmet.
byKey.697cdbfd14e9320980057487 Description: Not everyone can escape Tarkov. But what about Duckov?
byKey.697cddb414e932098005748d Description: A figurine of a duck, ready to face all the challenges of the universe with unwavering resolve.
byKey.6981d72ed009ad83920da43a Description: A modified Saiga-12K smoothbore shotgun specially customized for the Arena champion known by the name JP. The custom build reduces barrel overheating during sustained fire and improves overall weapon reliability.
byKey.6981ee9cf819a414310292fb Description: The Monolit 3 Gen. 2 adapter for mounting telescopic stocks on modern AK-pattern rifles and their civilian variants. Manufactured by Armacon. A special version made for the Arena champion JP’s Saiga shotgun.

byKey.69bb41c03b5fb75517065960 Description: A satellite communication module produced exclusively for internal use at TerraGroup facilities. It outperforms all civilian equivalents in connection strength and stability.
byKey.69bb4203f94327bc0f0230cd Description: The Gigachad cryptoprocessor delivers record-breaking efficiency for complex mathematical computations. Due to its cost and setup complexity, it is typically used only by megacorporations such as TerraGroup at highly critical facilities.
byKey.69bb424e99f3fda8f107247d Description: Server-grade RAM differs from standard memory in bandwidth, long-term stability under continuous operation, and ECC technology capable of automatically correcting minor data errors. byKey.69bb435ff609db77390b0e25 Description: The Aceso Xpress biochemical analyzer is a market leader in medical diagnostics. It can perform analyses of serum, blood plasma, urine, and even cerebrospinal fluid while maintaining full operational autonomy.
byKey.69bb43df99f3fda8f1072483 Description: In small doses, potassium iodide is used to treat thyroid disorders and is widely available. Larger doses of 65 mg and above are rare, typically reserved for nuclear accident response operations. Usually stored at nuclear facilities or held by military and emergency services.
byKey.69bb4499957ebbdeb600393f Description: This Paradigm Shipping folder contains one of the latest directives regarding operations at cargo terminal #3.
byKey.69bb44cbd6c67f6265004ac1 Description: This log has records of every entry into Compartment C-1. Judging by the records, it is the most restricted and classified area aboard the icebreaker "Boreas".
byKey.69bb4558b44453acde02ebe7 Description: In this diary, one of the sailors kept records of the "Boreas" routes and his work for Paradigm Shipping.
byKey.69bb45b89c92ecd910059159 Description: This folder contains printed fragments of information recovered and decrypted by Mechanic from the hard drives found in Compartment C-1 aboard the icebreaker "Boreas".
byKey.6a024f1bd301c5e32972746c: Survivor: So… if I can’t control this, then I must at least continue observation.
byKey.6a02545758e6be929aaa4686: Survivor: I am Grigory Altman, supervisor responsible for sample storage aboard the icebreaker “Boreas”. The vessel was…
byKey.6a025470218d5c1a5bf7143f: Grigory Altman: …was attacked by mercenaries in Tarkov waters. During the assault, sample containers connected to projects TG-Ci and TG-y were damaged.
byKey.6a02548cc8fb634071d20726: Grigory Altman: In accordance with containment protocol, the laboratory was isolated from adjacent compartments.
byKey.6a02549b5ba70587f1d882b1: Grigory Altman: I remained inside and administered protective compounds as a precaution against possible contamination.
byKey.6a0254c11853e610201ab1ef: Grigory Altman: On the fourth day I recorded elevated cortisol levels, coughing, and mild itching. Increased dosage of the injected medication, observing improvement.
byKey.6a0329c11251309f8fd0af9d: Grigory Altman: It is impossible to fully stop the leak or replace the damaged sample containers. I continue daily measurements and it seems…
byKey.6a032b4718888d1ba3298dd8: Grigory Altman: …It seems I managed to arrange evacuation to a secure location where I can isolate the samples and continue observation.
byKey.6a032b8db0f782913ecaa034: Grigory Altman: It’s critical to complete this before I enter the paranoia stage…

byKey.6a317b9692cfdcddcb02a58e Description:
Rumor has it that TerraGroup keeps a personnel file on nearly every PMC operator. Judging by these documents, the rumors are true.

Can be found on: 
- Reserve
- Lighthouse
- Icebreaker
byKey.6a31807f17005505b70d5827 Description:
Financial reports from TerraGroup and its affiliated companies. There's bound to be plenty of inconsistencies and evidence hidden inside, but are you really willing to spend hours of your life reading dry financial paperwork?

Can be found on: 
- Customs
- Streets of Tarkov
- Interchange
byKey.6a3181f178450ec91c0ea1aa Description:
Documentation from Tarkov Infraline. The company officially specialized in road construction, but these blueprints clearly have nothing to do with transportation infrastructure.

Can be found on:
- Factory
- Reserve
- Customs
byKey.6a31824878450ec91c0ea1ae Description:
Blueprints and technical documentation belonging to TerraGroup. For convenience, all of the data has also been backed up onto a disk.

Can be found on: 
- Interchange
- Factory
- The Labyrinth
byKey.6a31828557705071410ca00e Description:
Documents detailing tests of various experimental compounds from TerraGroup-controlled laboratories. It's surprising they've managed to remain in Tarkov at all.

Can be found on: 
- Shoreline
- Woods
- Icebreaker
byKey.6a3182b72fd891345e047eef Description:
Documentation issued to every new TerraGroup employee upon signing. It contains both useful information and the obligatory, mind-numbing office rules like how to chip in for a coworker's birthday gift.

Can be found on:
- Ground Zero
- Streets of Tarkov
- The Lab
byKey.6a3182dc6cd8de21cf0a3a7d Description:
Medical records containing research findings. Many of them are ethically questionable, yet remarkably successful in every other regard. Truth is in the eye of the beholder.

Can be found on: 
- The Lab
- Ground Zero
- The Labyrinth
byKey.6a31830dde69ceafd805afa0 Description:
Operating manuals for TerraGroup equipment. Essential for anyone who'd rather not lose a few fingers or break machinery worth millions of dollars. Or for anyone looking to make a tidy profit.

Can be found on: 
- Shoreline
- Woods
- Lighthouse
byKey.6a3183258f113efdb7093622 Description:
Classified information that somehow survived against all odds. Arguably the most valuable thing left in Tarkov.

A unique document that can be used in place of any other document required for the Battle Pass.

Available from the Expansion Hub.
byKey.6a33c17933cff6b88c08902e Description: A mechanical key that unlocks either a utility room or one of the system administrators' offices.
byKey.6a35322b81d315afe1018ef3 Description: A traditional French baguette baked in full compliance with the 1993 French Bread Decree. Many TerraGroup employees were willing to take quite a detour on their way to work just to pick one up. It's easily recognized by the distinctive "Cocaoo_" stamp the baker marked on every loaf.
byKey.6a3532423ec9d7082a05d430 Description: A special edition, oversized can of GigaBeef, made to a traditional British recipe. Some say a meal of this quality even helps you think more clearly… though results may vary.
byKey.6a3548e72a963bcdd8098649 Description: A military dogtag suspiciously similar to a Dutch design from the Second World War. Perfect for vintage enthusiasts.

byKey.6a566628d1d0c640e6034ebb Description: The Razor electronic ear muffs feature an ultra low-profile design and a rubberized coating for added durability and comfort, also providing optimal hearing protection. Manufactured by Walker's. The carbon fiber is a fake print, by the way.

byKey.6a567ae55cbe811cbe0136a8 Description: The AirFrame ballistic helmet sets the standards in protection, comfort, and modularity. byKey.6a568340263768e2ae0c9696 Description: The Titan Aramid ballistic helmet in the form factor copying the Crye Precision AirFrame helmet. byKey.6a78b7f8c2016eb33e0027cd Description: FN P90, also known as the FN Project 1990, is a compact personal defense weapon (PDW) designed and manufactured by FN Herstal in Belgium. Created in response to NATO requests for a replacement for 9x19mm Parabellum firearms, the P90 was designed as a compact but powerful firearm for vehicle crews, operators of crew-served weapons, support personnel, special forces, and counter-terrorist groups. This particular weapon was customized and tuned to the specifications of Liam "Scourge", one of the Arena Champions, during his time with USEC.
byKey.6a7b44d6609e0bad000de84d Name: Blue Force Gear Ten-Speed SF Chest Rig (Ranger Green)
byKey.6a7b44d6609e0bad000de84d Description: A Blue Force Gear load-bearing chest rig setup designed for reconnaissance missions. The zipper allows the vest to be opened for greater comfort during extended periods spent lying prone. Features a MOLLEminus interface for attaching additional pouches, and this vest comes with plenty of them. Ranger Green version.
byKey.6a7b45c3400bf8420f0e06fe Name: Blue Force Gear PLATEminus V2 Plate Carrier (Wolf Gray)
byKey.6a7b45c3400bf8420f0e06fe Description: The second-generation plate carrier from Blue Force Gear is designed to accommodate SAPI/ESAPI-format plates. byText.Самогонный аппарат позволяет производить: The moonshine still allows you to produce strong drinks directly in your Hideout.
byText.Специально оборудованное место для стрел: A specially equipped place for shooting firearms. For the convenience of evaluating the shooting results, the range is equipped with metal silhouette popper targets for the close range, and paper targets for the long range.
byText.Улучшенное стрельбище с прикрепленными к: An improved range with installed ceiling-mounted target rails with three speed levels.
byText.Продвинутое стрельбище с установленными: An advanced shooting range with installed popper targets and a laptop for configuration. Also allows to start training with random rail targets and poppers, scores are displayed on the laptop monitor.
byText.Особый ящик, куда специально нанятые Дик: A special box where specially hired Scavs drop off various items that they've found.
byText.Круг, нарисованный мелом и заваленный ми: A circle drawn in chalk and cluttered with mysterious symbols. Such circles are used by the cultists for their rituals. One wonders what would happen if you put something in the middle of it...?
byText.Оружейная стойка с манекеном. Позволяет: A mannequin with a weapon rack. Allows you to prepare a set of equipment for the raid.
byText.С двумя манекенами можно не только подго: With two mannequins, you can not only prepare gear for a raid, but also display something cool and rare. Would look great.
byText.Несколько манекенов со стойкой для оружи: Several mannequins with a weapon rack. With a wardrobe like this, it will be easy to store quick access gear for any occasion.
byText.Биткоин ферма базовая на 10 юнитов. С по: Basic bitcoin farm of 10 units. Using the computing power of graphics cards, you can use the system to produce physical bitcoins.
byText.Биткоин ферма улучшенная на 25 юнитов. С: An improved bitcoin farm of 25 units. Using the computing power of graphics cards, you can use the system to produce physical bitcoins.
byText.Биткоин ферма максимальная на 50 юнитов: Maximum size bitcoin farm for 50 units with water cooling. Using the computing power of graphics cards, you can use the system to produce physical bitcoins.
byText.Простая бочка с дровами для поддержания: A simple barrel with firewood to maintain heat. A very basic option for heating. Dangerous because of toxic carbon monoxide.
byText.Буржуйка — металлическая печь для обогре: A potbelly stove is a metal stove for interior heating, popular in the first half of the 20th century. An irreplaceable thing in the Hideout, especially when connected to the ventilation system for the output of combustion products.
byText.Cистема отопления Убежища с электрообогр: Equips the entire Hideout with additional electric heaters. Now, together with the potbelly stove, you won't be afraid of any cold.
byText.Простой топливный генератор, который мож: A simple fuel generator that can provide basic Hideout equipment with electricity. The heart of your shelter. Fuel is needed to maintain the working power grid.
byText.Улучшенный генератор повышенной мощности: A superior high power generator. It allows you to use a wider range of electrical appliances. Provides additional slots for installing fuel cans.
byText.Промышленный генератор для обеспечения а: Industrial generator to ensure the autonomous operation of production facilities. Also provides additional slots for installing fuel cans.
byText.Вентиляционный короб, подвешенный под по: Ventilation duct suspended from the ceiling. The air duct passes through part of the room, providing the natural movement of air flows. It is necessary for the installation of "smoky" zones where the output of combustion products is required.
byText.Базовый вентиляционный короб с дополните: A basic ventilation duct with additional emergency bunker ventilation system of external airflow. Now, besides the removal of combustion products, there will be fresh air in the Hideout.
byText.Вентиляционный короб с электро-вентилят: A ventilation duct fitted with electric fans to increase the airflow rate. A complete air circulation system is needed for advanced production and chemical research.
byText.Базовая входная дверь. Чтобы черти всяки: A basic front door. So that all kinds of fools don't come to pay you a visit. It does not save from drafts and moisture, but it creates the feeling that the Hideout is slowly getting settled.
byText.Усовершенствованная прихожая с армирован: An improved entrance hall with a reinforced door, a clothes hanger, and other household items. Can’t kick such a door down with just a single kick.
byText.Продвинутая система безопасности Убежища: An advanced Hideout security system which includes, in addition to an armored bunker door, a video surveillance camera, an intercom system, fire extinguishers, as well as special ties to increase the structural strength of walls and ceiling.
byText.Возможность починки брони ремонтными ком: Unlocks armor repair via repair kits
byText.Примитивный санузел. Ни о каких удобства: A primitive toilet. Any amenities are out of the question. Just a bucket and a litter box to maintain basic sanitation in the Hideout.
byText.Снижение стоимости починки брони ремонтн: Reduces armor repair cost using repair kits
byText.Базовый санузел с деревянным туалетом ти: A basic bathroom with a wooden outhouse type toilet and a washstand, connected to the water supply system. All this raises the level of cleanliness and hygiene in the Hideout.
byText.Продвинутый санузел с биотуалетом, душем: An advanced bathroom with a dry closet, a shower and a trash can. Everything you need is connected to the water supply system and provides the most affordable level of personal hygiene.
byText.Постоянное наличие медицинских средств з: The continued availability of medication means greater chances of survival after raids. Several medical storage boxes for basic medical care.
byText.Медицинский блок, состоящий из стола для: A medical unit consisting of a table for medicine, a chair and a dropper. The healing process will be faster while you are out of raids.
byText.Полноценная медлаборатория в Убежище. Ес: A full-fledged Hideout medical laboratory. It has everything you need to treat wounds, create medicines and maintain your good health during these difficult times.
byText.Питание в Убежище обеспечивает вас энерг: Food in the Hideout provides you with energy for future raids. A basic nutrition unit with an old fridge and a place to eat allows you to recover your energy faster.
byText.Пищеблок с более современным холодильник: A nutrition unit with a more modern refrigerator, dining accessories, stove and sink, providing better food. Energy is restored faster.
byText.Полноценная кухня с комфорочной плитой,: A full-fledged kitchen with a comfortable stove, an improved sink, an electric kettle, a microwave and everything necessary for fast and high-quality food cooking outside raids. Can’t violate the diet!
byText.Отдых очень важен, особенно в осажденном: Rest is very important, especially in the besieged Tarkov environment. A mattress over pallets is the very basic thing which can help PMCs relax after hard battles.
byText.Место для отдыха, оборудованное нормальн: A place to relax, equipped with a normal bed, bedside table and even an old TV. It creates a feeling of comfort and gives nostalgic memories of a former life.
byText.Зона отдыха с диваном, ЖК телевизором с: A lounge area with a sofa, an LCD TV with a Ployka Station console and a stereo system. It is hard to imagine that such comfort can be organized in an underground bunker when the whole world flies into the abyss.
byText.Возможность починки оружия ремонтными ко: Unlocks weapon repair via repair kits
byText.Каждому необходимо место для работы с ин: Everybody needs a place to work with their tools. A simple workbench allows you to do the basic modifications of your weapon and disassembling various technical parts.
byText.Снижение затраты очков для починки оружи: Reduces weapon repair cost using repair kits
byText.Рабочее место, оборудованное всем необхо: A workplace equipped with everything necessary for the production of simple ammunition and more complex technical tasks required to improve your hideout.
byText.Полноценный стол мастера-оружейника. Поз: A full-fledged table of the gunsmithing master. It allows you to produce more advanced cartridges and engage in high-tech tasks, assembly and disassembly of complex electronic devices and mechanical systems.
byText.Если генератор - это сердце Убежища, то: If the generator is the heart of the Hideout, then the intelligence center is its brain. For now, this is just an old table and chair for analyzing various information that can help you escape from Tarkov.
byText.Улучшенный разведцентр, оборудованный но: An advanced intelligence center equipped with a laptop, which has more working space due to an additional table. Thanks to Mechanic, it is connected to an isolated computer network, which remained intact after the EMP strike and isolation of Tarkov.
byText.Полноценный разведцентр, оборудованный к: A full-fledged intelligence center equipped with computer equipment, radio devices and analytical tools. The escape from Tarkov was never so close.
byText.Базовое освещение парафиновыми свечами,: Basic lighting with paraffin candles, giving a dim and uneven light.
byText.Освещение Убежища лампочками накаливания: Hideout lighting with incandescent bulbs. The illumination is more even and brighter than from the candles.
byText.Освещение Убежища лампами дневного света: Hideout lighting with fluorescent lights provides optimal brightness and uniformity of illumination.
byText.Уголок боевой славы представляет из себя: The Hall of Fame is a special rack where you can put your trophies and collectibles.
byText.Отличный стенд из IDEA, в котором очень: A great rack from IDEA that can very nicely hold all the figurines found in raids and several dogtags taken from PMCs.
byText.Полноценная зона в Убежище, отведенная д: A full-fledged area in the Hideout dedicated to storing items of collectible value.
byText.Система воздушной фильтрации воздуха, по: Air filtration system, connected to the common ventilation system. It provides the air which is as cleanest from harmful impurities as possible.
byText.Солнечно-ветряные батареи, установленные: Surface-mounted solar-wind batteries improve the overall Hideout power generation.
byText.Кусок стены с распухшей краской. Ничего: A piece of a wall with swollen paint. Nothing serious, but it might become a problem soon.
A piece of wall with heavily swollen paint. Water is seeping from the wall. You definitely need to do something about it. Wipe the floor, maybe.
A piece of wall with heavily swollen paint. Part of the paint fell off. Water is seeping from the wall. There seems to be something behind this wall.
byText.Стена со скрытой дверью. Неизвестно, кто: A wall with a hidden door. You don't know who made it and why, but to open it, you will need tools. Also, another wipe wouldn't hurt.
byText.Аварийная часть стены оказалась входом в: The damaged part of the wall turned out to be an entrance to the old hidden room. There is nothing inside but rubbish and a dead body. It will take a lot of effort to put this room in shape.
byText.Приведенный в порядок вход в новое помещ: A tidied up entrance to the new room.
byText.Небольшой оружейный стенд. Облегчает хра: A small weapon rack. Simplifies firearm storage and allows to display weapons in a fancy way.
byText.Оружейный стенд. Облегчает хранение огне: A medium-sized weapon rack. Simplifies firearm storage and allows to display weapons in a fancy way.
byText.Большой оружейный стенд. Облегчает хране: A large weapon rack. Simplifies firearm storage and allows to display weapons in a fancy way.
byText.Водопроводная система базового уровня дл: Basic water system for collecting groundwater. Contains several water filters and containers for water purification. One of the most important systems for maintaining life support in the Hideout.
byText.Усложненная система сбора воды с дополни: A sophisticated water collection system with additional pipes, filters, and larger containers. Installation of pumps allows to improve the pressure in the pipes and, consequently, the pressure of water.
byText.Продвинутая водная система сбора как гру: An advanced water collection system for both groundwater and rainwater. It contains various cleaning filters, an electric pump and an extensive water supply system throughout the Hideout. An additional filtration and enrichment system allows you to get very clean and high-quality water.
byText.Территория и производственные помещения:
The industrial estate and facilities of Chemical Plant No. 16 were rented out illegally to the TerraGroup corporation. During the advent of the Contract Wars, the plant became the scene of numerous firefights between BEAR and USEC that ultimately determined control over the industrial district of Tarkov.

Later on, in the wake of the chaos, the plant facilities became a shelter for the remaining civilians, Scavs, and military operatives, including the scattered remains of the BEAR and USEC contingents.
A facility of one of TerraGroup's contractors, Knossos LLC. According to public sources, they build amusement and theme parks. However, this place looks more like a heavily fortified bunker than a new theme park.
byText.Подземный лабораторный комплекс TerraGro: Secret underground TerraGroup Labs facility hidden right under the center of Tarkov. Officially, this research center does not exist and, based on data scraps, is engaged in research and development as well as testing and simulation of projects in chemistry, physics, biology, and other high technology.
byText.На Финском заливе в кольце блокады Тарко:
In the Gulf of Finland, trapped within the blockade surrounding Tarkov, lies the nuclear-powered icebreaker "Boreas", owned by the logistics corporation Paradigm Shipping. The exact purpose of "Boreas" and the cargo it carries remain unknown. 

It appears that Paradigm Shipping and TerraGroup made special efforts to minimize any mention of the icebreaker in the press and keep its routes and assignments classified.
byText.Приозерская заповедная зона была недавно: The Priozersk Nature Reserve recently became part of the state-protected wildlife reserves of the North-Western Federal District.
byText.Маяк на мысе Дальнем являлся важным стра: The lighthouse at Cape Dalniy was an important strategic object on the way to Tarkov. During Contract Wars, it was the main entry point for USEC units and served as their base of operations. After the conflict, Scavs took a fancy to this place, until the old owners returned, who decided to stay in Tarkov and establish their own order.
byText.Секретная база РосРезерва, по легендам с: The secret Federal State Reserve Agency base that, according to urban legends, contains enough supplies to last for years: food, medications, and other resources, enough to survive an all-out nuclear war.
byText.Дыра в заборе у скал: Hole in the Wall by the Mountains
byText.Деловой центр города Тарков. Именно здес: The business center of Tarkov. This is where TerraGroup was headquartered. This is where it all began.
byText.Центральная часть города Таркова с банка: Downtown Tarkov houses banks, malls, and hotels, as well as all the other amenities a thriving metropolis could have needed.
byText.Большой участок околозаводской территори: A large area of industrial park land situated adjacent to the factory zone. The area houses a customs terminal, fuel storage facilities, offices, and dorms, as well as a variety of other infrastructure and buildings.
byText.Деловой центр города Тарков. Именно здес: The business center of Tarkov. This is where TerraGroup was headquartered. This is where it all began. The area has yet again become a hot zone since the early days of the conflict.
byText.Крупная часть пригорода Таркова, которая:
The Shoreline area makes up a large part of the outskirts of Tarkov and is located next to the Port.

The area houses a partially abandoned village, modern private housing, agricultural fields, long stretches of beach, a boating facility, gas station, weather station, and a cellular tower as well as other commercial facilities.

Shoreline's main point of interest is the Azure Coast health resort which consists of several blocks, exclusively powered by a nearby hydroelectric power plant. The resort had previously been used as temporary accommodation for members of TerraGroup and the corporation's associated divisions in preparation for the evacuation of the Tarkov Port.
byText.Южная транспортная развязка является клю: The South Interchange is a key transport location for the city. This strategic area connects the port and harbor with the industrial outskirts of Tarkov. Located in the center of the interchange is a huge ULTRA shopping mall which was used as the main base of operation for the EMERCOM evacuation.
byText.Южный портовый терминал находится под ко: The southern port Terminal has been under Russian Armed Forces control since the beginning of the Tarkov conflict. After the city was sealed off, the terminal was fortified and became the primary evacuation point, sought by both civilian refugees and PMC units. According to unconfirmed reports, TerraGroup personnel were also evacuated through this port.
byText.Прапорщик на складах тыловой базы снабже: The Warrant officer in charge of supply warehouses on the sustaining base enforcing the Norvinsk region blockade. Secretly supplied the BEAR PMC operators with weapons, ammunition, and various other provisions he had at his disposal during the Contract Wars.
byText.Зав. отделением травматологии центрально: Head of the Trauma Care Department of the Tarkov Central City Hospital.
byText.С самого зарождения конфликта Скупщик уж: The conflict had barely started when Fence began setting up anonymous outlets for buying and selling goods. Keeping incognito, he nevertheless managed to put together a well-organised smuggler network, operating all over the Norvinsk region.
byText.Сотрудник таможенного терминала предпорт: Previously a port zone customs terminal employee, who initially oversaw dealings of the terminal's goods. Over the course of the conflict, he put together a gang of thugs in order to grab everything of value that he could lay his hands on in the vicinity of the terminal.
byText.Cнабженец из контингента ООН. Сидит на о: UN peacekeeping Force supply officer, based in one of the central checkpoints leading to the Tarkov port zone. The blue helmets have been seen poking their heads into small deals from the very beginning of the conflict, buying everything of value in exchange for western weapons, ammo, and all kinds of military equipment.
byText.Бывший мастер Химкомбината. С самого нач: A former chemical plant foreman, who from the very beginning of the conflict took to weapon modification, repairs, and maintenance of complex equipment and technology. He prefers clandestine solo living and operates discreetly, while placing complicated and challenging tasks above all else.
byText.До конфликта работал директором крупного: Previously, he worked as a director in a shopping center located in the suburbs of Tarkov. Now dealing in mostly clothing- and gear-related items, anywhere from sunglasses to body armor.
byText.Работал в лесном охотничьем хозяйстве Пр: Before the conflict, he worked as a hunter in the Priozersk Natural Reserve under the State Hunting Service. A professional hunter and survival specialist. Even now, he still guards the reserve's hunting grounds from various aggressive individuals.
byText.Многофункциональная радиостанция со встр: A multi-function radio station with built-in cryptographic processor.
byText.Раcпорядитель Арены организует гладиатор: The Arena host who organizes pit fights across Tarkov.

A special protected folder for storing important documents. Almost impossible to break open or destroy. It has the number 0031 and a strange symbol on it.

A special protected folder for storing important documents. Almost impossible to break open or destroy. It has the number 0048 and a strange symbol on it.

byText.Специальная защищенная папка для хранени: A special protected folder for storing important documents. Almost impossible to break open or destroy. It has the number 0013 and a strange symbol on it.

A package with correspondence with a "TG" logotype. If unsealed, the value of it is instantly gone.

byText.Ключ от закрытых хозяйственных помещений: A key to the closed premises of the Azure Coast Health Resort.
byText.Армированный кейс с жестким диском с инт: A reinforced case with an SAS hard drive. Used for data storage in military industry.
A laptop in a special protected case. Used by military and private companies in the face of increased danger of damage to the device.
byText.Защищенный флеш накопитель Sliderkey. Та: The Sliderkey secure flash drive. Such USB sticks are frequently used by TerraGroup employees. This ones seems to have been used by the Health Resort workers.
byText.Запоминающее устройство (устройство хран: A random access storage device (information storage device), based on the magnetic recording principle. Serves as the main data drive in most computers.
byText.Специальная защищенная папка для хранени: A special protected folder for storing important documents. Almost impossible to break open or destroy. It has the number 0060 and a strange symbol on it.
byText.Проба крови, найденная на двери автомоби: A blood sample found on the car door. It was hard getting even this much.
byText.Запечатанная посылка. Сильно помятая, но: A package sealed with a large amount of tape. It's quite battered, but the contents appear to be intact.
byText.Грузовые ведомости Гошана, часть порвана: Goshan cargo manifests, partially torn up, but the shipment information can still be read.
byText.Грузовые ведомости OLI, часть порвана, н: OLI cargo manifests, partially torn up, but the shipment information can still be read.
byText.Грузовые ведомости IDEA, часть порвана,: IDEA cargo manifests, partially torn up, but the shipment information can still be read.
byText.Документы с маршрутом груза с аккумулято: Documents describing the route of shipment of batteries for OLI store in Ultra mall.
byText.Книга о конструировании и технологии изг: A book on clothing design and manufacturing technologies with various materials. Part 1
A book on clothing design and manufacturing technologies with various materials. Part 2
byText.Герметичный контейнер для хранения разли: Hermetic container for storing various chemicals.
byText.Настраиваемый контроллер мотора, использ: A configurable motor controller block used on main battle tanks and weapon systems.
byText.Сверхпрочный одноосевой волоконно-оптиче: An extremely durable single-axis fiber optic gyroscope developed for military applications in harsh environments. Used for vehicle navigation and weapon systems.
byText.Помеченный синим символом хирургический: Surgery kit marked with a blue symbol
byText.Видавший лучшие времена хирургический на: A well-worn surgical first aid kit for bullet wounds and other serious injuries and wounds, heavily stained with blood and marked with a strange blue symbol.
byText.Медицинский прибор для диагностического: A medical device for diagnostic eye examination, marked with a strip of tape.
byText.Флеш-накопитель с изолентой: Flash drive marked with blue tape
byText.Флеш-накопитель, помеченный синей изолен: A flash drive marked with blue tape. Such flash drives are often used by TerraGroup staff.
byText.Командирский блок для управления танково: A tank commander control panel for controlling tank artillery. Allows the control of T-90M main cannon.
byText.Папка с военными записями и картами. Оче: A folder with military notes and paper maps. An extremely valuable thing for foreign counterparties.
byText.Журнал с медицинскими записями. Подчерк: A journal with medical notes. The writing is barely readable, but it is of great value to certain third parties.
byText.Центральный блок управления навигационно: The central control block of the GALS-D3 navigational complex for T-72 and T-90 tanks.
byText.Документ, содержащий данные о работе нас: A document containing data about water pumps at the water treatment plant.
byText.Документы, содержащие записи и отчеты о: A document containing operational reports of the pumping station at the water treatment plant.
A body of the DSP transmitter.
byText.Флеш накопитель с неизвестной информацие: A secure flash drive with unknown information. Write-protected and labeled "V3".
byText.Запоминающее устройство (устройство хран: A random access storage device (information storage device), based on the magnetic recording principle. Contains information on aerial movement in the Norvinsk region.
byText.Дневник со всевозможными финансовыми дан: A diary with all sorts of financial data.
byText.Защищенный флеш-накопитель, найденный в: A flash drive found inside the car dealership manager's office.
byText.Заказное письмо Прапора. Вскрывать не ре: A letter from Prapor. Better not open it.
byText.Медиатор с выгравированными символами AG: A guitar pick with the letters "AG" engraved on it.
byText.Журнал в кожаной обложке. Исписан различ: A journal with a leather cover. Covered with various names, addresses and phone numbers.
byText.Запоминающее устройство (устройство хран: A random access storage device (information storage device), based on the magnetic recording principle. Contains CCTV footage from the Concordia residential complex.
A secure flash drive containing various recordings.
byText.Дневник, найденный в убежище информатора: A journal found inside the informant's hideout.
A fake intelligence, forged by Lightkeeper.
An original intelligence, containing dirt on Lightkeeper.
byText.Смартфон фельдшера скорой помощи, содерж: A smartphone with valuable data belonging to the ambulance paramedic.
A journal of someone who really loves everything Soviet.
byText.Дневник с записями шеф-повара из рестора: A diary containing valuable data belonging to a chef from the Beluga restaurant.
byText.Секретный компонент для пищевых добавок: A vial with a secret component used to make the most delicious food. May also make you agree to ridiculous deals and tell all your company secrets.
byText.Бутылка редкого коллекционного французск: A bottle of rare French collector soft wine Le Jean.
byText.Запоминающее устройство (устройство хран: A random access storage device (information storage device), based on the magnetic recording principle. Contains various compromising data on TerraGroup.
byText.Записи кадастрового реестра, содержащие: Cadastral registry records containing data on TerraGroup real estate in Tarkov.
byText.Небольшой ежедневник, который уже давно: A small diary that had been abandoned by its owner a long time ago. The entries are barely legible due to the rough handwriting.
byText.Можно бесконечно доказывать, что разные: You can argue endlessly that different factories of the same company provide comparable quality, but at the critical moment everyone chooses the original.... Perhaps TerraGroup had special arrangements with the American factory to supply a newer model of LEDX.
byText.Выпуск игрового журнала, в котором вперв: An issue of a gaming magazine that first wrote about one world-famous shooter game.
byText.Запоминающее устройство (устройство хран: A random access storage device (information storage device), based on the magnetic recording principle. Contains stolen user data.
byText.В старину символом власти в крупных горо: In the old days, the symbol of power in large cities was a luxurious key the size of a hand. In Tarkov, this tradition was revived, but the key itself was made smaller. Some say that this is the reason why it was lost: someone attached the souvenir to a bunch of keys by mistake and took it away from the town day celebration.
byText.Записи говорят о побочных эффектах после: The records in this journal reveal side effects after interacting with TerraGroup's drugs... The factory workers likely were unaware of this "research".
byText.Бортовой журнал ВС РФ. Неизвестно, как о: A RUAF pilot logbook. It's unclear how it ended up in the cockpit of the foreign AS350 helicopter. Either the USECs ran out of their own logbooks, or the BEARs ran out of helicopters.
byText.Абсолютно непонятно, что было в цистерне: There's no telling what was in the tank container. It looks nasty, and smells even worse. TerraGroup must have used these tanks to store precursors for their research.
byText.Проба крови, взятая с тел рабочих Полихи: A blood sample taken from the body of one of the workers at Chemical Plant No. 16. The bodies are clearly not recent, but the blood has not even dried up. Even the texture is the same as fresh blood.
byText.Кейс, содержащий различные дорогостоящие: A case containing various expensive precision tools.
byText.Посылка, которую мехвод БТР должен был п: A package that the BTR driver was supposed to deliver to Prapor.
byText.Изделие предназначено для подавления кан: The device is designed to suppress UAV guidance systems. Helps to reliably protect any facility from airborne attacks.
byText.Посылка из-за кордона, которую ждёт Прап: A delivery from outside the cordon that Prapor is waiting for. Judging by the weight, it feels like it's half-empty.
byText.Письмо от мехвода БТР. Похоже, информаци: A letter from the BTR driver. Apparently, the information inside could put serious pressure on Skier.
byText.Судя по звукам, кейс заполнен чем-то тяж: From the sounds of it, the case is filled with something heavy like OFZ shells or other munitions.
byText.Пачка документов с данными о перевозках: A stack of documents with data on TerraGroup shipments. Contains reports on completed and planned shipments.
byText.Похоже, что этим журналом пользовалась в: It looks like this journal was used by the entire loading crew to mark all the loads that had already been completed. How could the foreman make any sense of this handwriting?
byText.Коробка запечатана, но судя по звукам вн: The box is sealed, but judging by the sounds inside, it contains the tools Mechanic was looking for.
byText.Сложно поверить, что для Лыжника этот бу: It's hard to believe this wallet is anything special to Skier. It's just an old, shabby wallet. How has it not disintegrated yet?
byText.В ежедневнике отмечены встречи, объекты: Meetings, facilities, and other notes from Knossos senior manager are noted in the diary. If you study them, you can get at least a rough summary of the company's facilities.
byText.Химический контейнер, в котором ещё оста: A chemical container with a thick, murky liquid inside. Only a lunatic like Sanitar would want to study something like this.
byText.Твердотельный накопитель VPX Flash Stora: VPX Flash Storage Module marked Group #3
byText.Высокопроизводительный высокообъемный тв: The VPX Flash Storage Module (FSM) provides high-performance, high-capacity, solid-state SATA storage with AES-256 bit encryption using an Application Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC). Judging by the marking, it contains data on the focus group experiments and research.
byText.Видеокассета со следами крови и надписью: A videotape with traces of blood and the words “Slaughter”. The owner of the tape hardly felt sympathy for his victims.
byText.Ствол для винтовки AK-50 под патрон .50: A 24 inch (612mm) barrel for the AK-50, manufactured by The AK Guy LTD.
byText.Крышка ствольной коробки с интегрированн: A receiver dust cover with integrated Picatinny rail for the AK-50, allowing installation of optics. Manufactured by The AK Guy LTD.
byText.Цевье и газовая трубка M-LOK для AK-50: AK-50 M-LOK handguard with gas tube
byText.Комбинированный кит, состоящий из цевья: A handguard and gas tube for the AK-50. The handguard is equipped with an M-LOK standard interface for attaching additional equipment, and also has Picatinny rail for mounting tactical devices. Manufactured by The AK Guy LTD.
byText.Разбитый в хлам телефон. Ничего особенно: A broken generic phone, nothing out of the ordinary. However it might help to find Mechanic's acquaintance.
byText.Ничем не примечательный блокнот, таких с:
An unremarkable diary, there are hundreds of those in Tarkov. But don't judge a book by its cover: this particular one contains many dangerous secrets.

The first page has a table of contents:
• Update
• Notes 
• Highlights
• Encrypt
• Agenda 
• Ruminates
• Drafts
byText.Простой диск с пометкой от руки, что это: A simple disk with a handwritten note that this is the second version, the final one. Finally you can go through the whole game all the way to the end. Gotta write a review later!
byText.Папка с фотографиями, схемами, банковски: A folder of photos, charts, bank records, e-mail printouts and surveillance diaries of Arena employees.
byText.Коробка не очень тяжёлая, скорее всего в: The box isn't particularly heavy, so it probably contains documents or fragile electronics.
byText.Первый кейс с товаром для контрабандисто: Case with goods for the smugglers #1
byText.Кейс, загруженный бронеплитами для контр: A case loaded with armor plates for the smugglers, which Ragman is planning to deliver to them. How much does this thing weigh?!
byText.Второй кейс с товаром для контрабандисто: Case with goods for the smugglers #2
byText.В журнале контроля ядерной энергетическо: The control log of a nuclear power unit records safety parameters, routine inspection results, and various measurements ensuring the safe operation of the Icebreaker’s nuclear reactor.
byText.Флешка, найденная во внедорожнике предст: A flash drive found at the abandoned high-ranking TerraGroup staff's SUV. Contains something important, though it's unclear what exactly.
A flight recorder found at the plane that crashed in the Priozersk nature reserve. This device is crucial to figuring out what happened to the plane.
byText.Флешка, на которую Электроник успел запи: A flash drive Elektronik used to write the crashed plane crew's conversations. A very valuable piece of intel.
byText.Распечатка стенограммы пилотов сбитого с: A printout of the transcript from the pilots of the downed aircraft.
byText.Загадочный кейс. Внутри, по слухам, нахо: A mysterious briefcase, apparently containing a certain "Ticket" out of Tarkov.
byText.Устройство, разработанное TerraGroup. Сп: A device developed by TerraGroup, capable of suppressing digital signals within a 100 meter radius.
byText.Пропуск, когда-то дававший доступ ко все: A pass card that used to grant access to all doors within the system. Used exclusively inside TerraGroup laboratories. No longer operational.
byText.Устройство, способное шифровать данные R: A device capable of encrypting RFID card data. Features an integrated microcontroller. Commonly used within TerraGroup facilities.
byText.В насосной станции кто-то оставил записк: A note left in the pumping station containing instructions for the maintenance crew.
byText.Защищённый контейнер «Альфа-1» с компром: Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence
byText.Небольшой контейнер, куда поместились вс: A small container holding all the documents and audio tapes containing compromising material on TerraGroup. Now they’re guaranteed to reach Mr. Kerman intact.
byText.На распечатке с планом портового термина: A printout of the port terminal plan marking the locations of the electrical panels.
byText.Похоже, раньше этот патч принадлежал бой: A patch of some special BEAR unit.
byText.Жетон бойца Богатырей, который побывал в: A dogtag belonging to the Bogatyr squad member who has seen hundreds of battles.
byText.Из смятой пули кто-то сделал талисман, т: Someone fashioned a talisman from a crumpled bullet, either as a keepsake or for luck.
byText.На обратной стороне открытки кто-то оста: On the back of the postcard, someone wrote: "Love you, waiting for you".
byText.Старый диктофон, которым судя по всему п: An old voice recorder that, apparently, was used by Voevoda himself.
byText.Личный телефон одного из Богатырей. На н: A personal phone belonging to one of the Bogatyr squad members. Some data may still remain on it.
byText.Жесткий диск из машины А. П. На нем могл: A hard drive taken from A.P.’s car. Important data may still remain on it.
byText.Защищенный флеш-накопитель Sliderkey с о: Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P.
byText.Защищенный флеш накопитель Sliderkey. Та: A Sliderkey secure flash drive. These drives are commonly used by TerraGroup management. This one appears to have been used by someone with the initials "A.P.".
byText.Расшифрованный флеш-накопитель Sliderkey: Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P.
byText.Расшифрованный флеш накопитель с данными: A decrypted flash drive containing data belonging to a certain "A.P.". Includes various technical files. The word "Unheard" appears intermittently in the code, but the code itself doesn’t function or run anything.
byText.Сегмент устройства, по-видимому сработав: A fragment of a device that apparently activated over Tarkov.
byText.Судя по внешнему виду, эта карта долгое: This pass for Station 14-4 KORD is issued to K. Arshavin. It appears to have lain unprotected for a long time and may be damaged.
byText.Флешка с данными, записанными в серверно: A flash drive containing data recorded in the ARRS station server room. It's best to return it to Mechanic.
byText.Записка механика из станции ARRS. В запи: A note from the mechanic at the ARRS station detailing how to roll back the 14-4 KORD station settings to a backup state.
byText.Авиационное гидравлическое масло АМГ-10: Aviation-grade hydraulic oil AMG-10 with excellent viscosity characteristics, designed for use in hydraulic systems of aircraft and ground equipment operating in extreme Arctic conditions. Ensures reliable performance across a wide temperature range from -60°C to +55°C.
byText.Жёсткий диск, который хранился серверной: A hard drive recovered from the server room in compartment C-1 aboard the Boreas icebreaker.
byText.Жёсткий диск, который хранился в зоне ра: A hard drive recovered from the desk area in compartment C-1 aboard the Boreas icebreaker.
byText.Жёсткий диск, который хранился на полках: A hard drive found stored on shelves in compartment C-1 aboard the Boreas icebreaker.

Issue #142
̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


Escalation in Tarkov

The military conflict in Tarkov continues to escalate. Eyewitnesses remaining in the city report increasing clashes between BEAR and USEC units. UN forces and the Russian Armed Forces are cordoning off dangerous areas, but these zones are growing, and according to unconfirmed reports, high-level discussions are already underway regarding a potential full lockdown of the city.

Both PMC groups likely still maintain their supply channels for weapons and personnel, which is why almost no one is willing to make optimistic forecasts. Evacuation of civilians is difficult, and both sides are organizing humanitarian aid drops to help local residents hold out until safe corridors open.

Amid the crisis, local criminal groups are also becoming more active. In some cases, these groups manage to seize weapons and take control of parts of the city. Currently, three such areas are known.

In the city center, the criminal gang of a former entrepreneur, known by the alias "Kaban", has established a fortified base in the former LexOs car dealership. According to recent data, PMC units have unsuccessfully attempted to dislodge the gang several times. An anonymous source told the editorial team that Kaban possesses samples of heavy weaponry that cannot even be obtained on the black market. Some experts suggest a possible connection between Kaban and the nonprofit organization "Forward Movement", which was previously linked in a high-profile case involving deputy minister of economy Yaroslav Shkurenko and the criminal authority nicknamed Chepyga.

Near the customs terminal, the "Zavodskoy" gang, previously involved in petty thefts in the district, has been spotted. Eyewitnesses report ongoing gunfire in that area.

EMERCOM units were forced to abandon evacuation points near the "Ultra" mall due to increased attacks by armed groups that took control of one floor of the mall. EMERCOM tents at the nearby highway interchange are no longer safe.

EMERCOM recommendations remain the same: first, find a secure shelter and wait for evacuation there, provide aid to the wounded if possible, and avoid venturing onto city streets. We hope that UN forces and the Russian Armed Forces will take more decisive measures to cool the conflict in Tarkov and will continue reporting all important developments.

Purpose and characteristics
Item #1156 — an aerosol augmenter of radio-frequency electromagnetic emission (RF-EMI), designed to neutralize enemy electronic equipment over a large area. The item can be used on its own or as the warhead component of delivery systems (tactical, operational-tactical, and medium range).
Weight: 37.080 kg
Dimensions: 2500*800*800
Effect radius: 15 to 40 km depending on medium density
Activation:
1. Remote initiation using a timed/distance fuze (up to 200m) /
2. Remote initiation via radio communication (within the radio’s operational range)


General design
The shock-wave emitter operates by means of spherically symmetric compression of the electromagnetic field. The fuze consists of a magnetic system that directs magnetic poles to the center of a sphere formed by two intersecting magnetic flux rings.

Inside the magnetic flux sphere is a detonation distributor, made from a plastic sphere with 45 channels filled with an initiating high explosive (lead azide was tested). The channel system ensures simultaneous arrival of the detonation wave at the main explosive charge.

At the center of the detonation distributor is the main explosive charge (tested mixtures included trotyl-hexogen combinations, octogen, and tetryl). Embedded in the center of the main charge is a cesium iodide single crystal treated with mixture #3012.


Features
Using spherically symmetric compression of the electromagnetic field together with treatment of the cesium iodide single crystal with mixture #3012 provides a significant increase in pulse efficiency compared to known EMI weapon prototypes. Measurements taken during testing showed retention of 40 to 50% of the explosive energy.

byText.<div style=\"width:70%\">И тогда явятся:
And then the Riders of the Arrival shall appear, and they shall open the door to the New World. All that is old shall die, for only the devoted flock is worthy of transformation and service to The Unheard.

The Wardens shall reap the harvest and carry into the New World the memory of old humanity. The transition to the next stage of evolution is inevitable, and the appearance of the Riders marks the beginning of the division of homo sapiens into two kinds.

They shall no longer be united: each shall be shown their place. Only those among us who follow the path laid out by The Unheard shall be permitted to witness the true flourishing of civilization.

For Their enlightenment is our salvation, and only by Their wisdom can the New World be governed.

̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


In the decisive hour, the Riders of the Arrival shall emerge from the shadows of corporations and states, yet they shall neither seek aid nor call followers. For we must see the great design ourselves, we must bring an end
to the old world so that from its ashes the New may be born.

Before the face of the coming, fear will compel many to submit to the will of new rulers. But the Rider cannot be deceived. The wisest judgment shall separate the wheat from the chaff, and each shall be repaid according to their deeds. The old truths have long lost their meaning. Only one truth and one purpose remain steadfast amid the ashes of dead ideas – to hasten the birth of the New World and prepare everything for the Great Arrival.

The birth of the New World is preceded by the death of the old. And for this death to occur, The Unheard need instruments through which the great purification of the human race will take place.

byText.<div style=\"width:70%\">Для посвящённых:
For those initiated into the plan, The Unheard have prepared a special and singular Path, along which the chosen will be able to enter the New World. Rebirth is ordained for our species, and every new step toward the coming future is marked by the Gift. Each Gift is destined to play its role.

The Blue Fire will become the fire that ignites the entire old world. Dry and dead, the old world must burn to ashes. States will fall, unable to resist the inevitable march of time. The power of rulers will prove to be their curse, for there is no power greater than the power of The Unheard wisdom, and no wisdom higher than the wisdom of The Unheard.

Yet the pinnacle of homo sapien’ history must become the foundation of the New World. All information available to humanity will be sifted through the sieve of the Wardens. Every thought and every action committed by a human will become a cast of the homo sapiens species, for nothing will escape the Eye of the World.

̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲

– According to our information, Cobalt has been facing difficulties integrating into Tarkov’s energy infrastructure. Is that true?

– I wouldn’t put it that way. Yes, innovation requires significant energy resources, and our facilities are no exception. Some of our projects demand power plants that simply don’t exist in the region. But the company’s development strategy already includes the construction of next-generation power stations. And we’ve made progress – just two days ago we, hm, reached an agreement with Yaroslav Grigorievich! (editor’s note: Deputy Minister of Economy Shkurenko Y. G.) In the future, Cobalt will bring light to many citizens of Tarkov, and today’s difficulties have only highlighted a problem in the city that we intend to solve.

– So you see the problem as lying with the city, not the costs of your projects? Our data suggests Tarkov has never suffered from a power shortage.

– Are you asking whether our projects can improve the city’s situation? That’s a great question! And I’ll say this: one of the key reasons for choosing this site was its potential for developing energy infrastructure, and in that regard, Tarkov certainly has room to grow. You have to understand – it’s not about what Tarkov looks like now, it’s about what it will become with us.

– Speaking of innovation. We’ve calculated that even taken together, all of Cobalt’s public projects don’t consume that much electricity. It seems Cobalt is planning to increase the city’s power load several times over for a project the people of Tarkov know nothing about. How do you comment on that?

– We understand the public’s concern and appreciate the interest in our work! But right now, even a small leak could seriously affect the development process. The walls have ears, right? Too much openness could harm not only Cobalt, but also Russia’s position on the international market. But getting back to Tarkov and its energy infrastructure – we’ve already reached a compromise with the local authorities. Until our new plants are operational, we’ll be "staying over" at state-owned facilities. For now, we’ll have to squeeze into city power plant buildings, but once our stations come online, the people of Tarkov will forget about power shortages entirely.

– Well, we’re intrigued by Cobalt’s new project and look forward to hearing more. This has been Yuri Belogorov from Lights of Tarkov, and Nikolay Tretyakov, NGO Cobalt representative in Tarkov.

PURPOSE AND CHARACTERISTICS

Automated Radio Relay Service (ARRS) is a system composed of multiple surveillance and communications agents, designed to prepare and control protocols Fortress, Spark, and Obelisk. The list of permitted protocols may be expanded.

The ARRS system is fully autonomous and can operate without external power sources, including under protocol Twilight. If an ARRS agent is disconnected from the network, each module can continue recording for up to 2 years and retain stored data for up to 10 years.

The system supports expansion with additional ARRS modules and automatic updates.

Each ARRS module is equipped with a unique security system (MOU-73S) capable of completely locking the module. Access to a module is possible only with a unique identifier embedded in the senior operator’s key.



GENERAL DESIGN

The ARRS system has no single control center. Each ARRS module locally stores the following data:
1) Scripts required for the module’s autonomous operation
2) Scripts for verifying user access level and transmitting data according to protocol The Eye (HGL-01E)
3) Archive of recordings for the entire observation history
4) Scripts to initiate protocol Warden (JKL-13R)

Module preparation and assembly are carried out according to the instructions described in Appendix 17 (TUR-09L).

ARRS modules operate on a closed infrastructure. The model, methods, and architectural requirements are described in Appendix 21 (UTE-99Y).

̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


The Will of Chance

Greetings to all survivors. I don’t know what I’d do without being able to talk to you. Sometimes it even feels like the old world never existed, as if everything collapsed into this closed-off city where each of us has just one mission – to make it through to tomorrow.

But today, I want to share a story that gives me hope for a better outcome. Maybe it will help you too.

Yesterday I went to check on a wounded friend and met a gloomy, withdrawn BEAR sitting in Therapist’s recovery room, clutching a USEC patch in his hands. At first glance, it seemed obvious: a trophy from a heavy fight where he lost a comrade. He’d avenged him, sure, but that hadn’t brought him peace. So there he sat, angry at himself for not being able to double-tap that USEC in time. Still, I decided to strike up a conversation, and from his first words, I realized all my guesses were wrong.

This BEAR had been scouting a new route to TerraGroup’s underground lab when his squad discovered an elevator shaft in critical condition. They managed to reach the complex through it and complete their mission, but on the way back, Raiders pinned them down hard.

During the retreat, the shaft collapsed, burying the entire team except for our guy. He himself was pinned against a wall by a support beam. The surface was just a couple hundred meters away, but without help, he had no chance of making it out alive. So he decided to hold on as long as he could.

Two days later, he heard footsteps approaching. He recognized English speech, but by then he couldn’t even hold his pistol, let alone put up a fight. He saw a flashlight beam sweep the tunnel ahead and braced himself for the end.

But instead of a gunshot, he heard a safety click, followed by careful steps. The newcomer wasn’t an enemy, but an ally. The stranger helped him get free, but the effort triggered heavy bleeding that his exhausted body couldn’t handle.

What happened next he remembers only in fragments, drifting in and out of consciousness. All his strength went into holding onto that USEC, and at some point, he accidentally tore the patch off the stranger’s shoulder.

He woke up in Therapist’s care, never finding out who had pulled him from the rubble. All he had left was the patch, which he now keeps with him.

We often convince ourselves that we’re in control, but most things around us are shaped by forces we can’t predict – a lucky weather break during retreat, a weapon jam in the enemy’s hands, or the will of a random passerby.

To everyone reading this: I wish you hope for a better outcome, even when everything seems set against you.

That’s all for now. Stay alive till tomorrow.

Down the Untrodden Paths

I welcome my readers once again. The Contract Wars have forever changed Tarkov’s landscape, and knowing the terrain often means the difference between life and death. Many turn to Jaeger for help, but the forester’s experience is of little use in urban areas or on the outskirts.

Some of you may have heard of the Mushroom Picker who roams across the city, though few have ever met him in person. At one point, both the military and the Scavs were hunting the reclusive old man. It’s said the Mushroom Picker has no ties to TerraGroup and has never even held a weapon. Still, many would pay a fortune to have him on their side.

That’s because the old man knows routes and passages that no one has walked, even in peaceful times. Somehow, the Mushroom Picker manages to avoid army checkpoints, not to mention Scav camps. With knowledge like that, he can seriously affect the balance of power in Tarkov.

Yet no one has ever truly understood his motives or goals. The more devout citizens like to tell stories of his night-time encounters with witnesses of the Arrival. To be honest, I don’t rule anything out anymore.

Despite his murky nature, the Mushroom Picker sometimes appears to those who’ve lost their way. I personally know several people, and they share nothing in common: he’s helped mercenaries from both PMCs, civilians, and even Scavs.

Whatever moral compass guides this eccentric wanderer, his help is not something one can count on. A meeting with the Mushroom Picker only happens when he wills it.

That’s all for now. Stay alive till tomorrow.

000000000 period: 000. 00, 0000 - Mar. 7, 2000

Research goals:
0000000 000 000000000000 00 00000 0000000000000 000000000000 0sing experimental compounds.


During the reporting period 14 groups of test subjects were examined at the site. Each group contained between 5 and 25 people depending on the experimental conditions. Some experiments could not be carried out due to the site’s limited capabilities. Group 9 was redirected to Site Theta because of the risk of contamination and the poor containment of the “Labyrinth” premises. Group 1 had to be neutralized entirely for similar reasons.

However, most experiments proved effective and provided the material and conclusions required by the laboratories and other test sites. Studies were conducted on effects on the human body and on expanding physical capabilities. Work proceeded along three directions:
1) Increasing organism endurance under various conditions.
2) Testing the effects of experimental biological compounds on the human body.
3) Developing compounds capable of affecting the human mental state.



Increasing organism endurance under various conditions.
During the study, subjects were placed in various conditions (food deprivation, prolonged confinement in a restricted space, blood loss exceeding 20/30/40% of total blood volume, burns with ITP from 50 to 95 points, acute and subacute intoxication).

Compounds SJ6, eTG-c, and SJ1 demonstrated significant effectiveness in stabilizing condition and activating the organism’s reserve resources in poisoning of varying severity and intoxication in the presence of open wounds. Compounds SJ15 and M.U.L.E. demonstrated high effectiveness under favorable conditions and increased subjects’ activity periods by 47–60%.

As a result of the studies, eTG-c, SJ6, and SJ15 are recommended for further iteration and development. The lack of professional training among test subjects negatively affected research results, therefore when used on trained combat personnel, the projected effect may reach higher results. Field testing is required.

HIGHLY CLASSIFIED

DESTROY AFTER READING



Testing the effects of experimental biological compounds on the human body.
Extensive testing of already developed combat stimulants was carried out according to the established plan.

Compounds P22 and M.U.L.E. exhibited critical side effects with regular use. Subjects were diagnosed with muscle tissue atrophy and, in isolated cases, paralysis or necrosis of individual muscles (3% of subjects). The research group associates these effects with excessive wear of muscle tissue and the organism’s inability to recover after such pressure. It is recommended to develop an advanced version of these compounds in which, after administration of the functional composition, a restorative mixture is also administered to replace expended physiological resources.

Development of a new formulation of the compound Zagustin continues. Formulations that thinned the blood immediately after the action of the primary mixture were tested, but subjects exhibited symptoms similar to hemophilia. None of these subjects had a genetic predisposition to hemophilia, therefore the search for a more suitable formulation continues. In parallel a Zagustin-based compound with reduced effect on profibrinolysin activators is being developed. At present, Zagustin use is NOT RECOMMENDED due to an increased risk of thrombosis and stroke in the majority of subjects.



Developing compounds capable of affecting the human mental state.
The study did not confirm the possibility of deliberately inducing specific psychoses in subjects. Genetics and personal experience of subjects determined individual risk factors that limit the influence of specific compounds.

Therefore a proposal emerged to develop, instead of receptor-targeted action, a compound that can influence the target’s central nervous system and cause the development of the psychoses to which the target has the greatest predisposition.

Under the supervision of Voronenko N. V., two iterations of a general-purpose compound were tested. At present there is a problem with stabilizing the compound, and tests confirmed subject resistance to the compound. Deeper genomic study of subjects is required to identify

the “protection gene” and to develop a more effective compound formulation.

12.11.
Got out of Stockholm without any trouble. But during the layover the whole place turned into a complete fucking shitshow. Not only did they pull the entire crew off the ship and slow all work onboard to a crawl, they wouldn’t even let us stand nearby. And for what? With paranoia like that no wonder Terragroup rotates crews on the icebreaker so often. Short-ass contracts, all these fucked protocols, all this secrecy bullshit… nobody’d put up with this crap if the pay wasn’t insane.

And I even managed to sneak a look at the loading op. They got people running back and forth nonstop and all they’re loading is crates full of electronics. Even the dockworkers are their own guys. Nobody GIVES A FUCK about your electronics, we’ve carried worse at sea! Arrogant fucking asshole fucks.

20.11
Made it to Tarkov, which means Saint Petersburg’s close now. Just hope we don’t get stuck here too like we did in Stockholm. Almost home.

09.12
Wow what great fucking luck. They delayed the stopover while we were already approaching Tarkov, then canceled the whole thing completely. Heard something serious happened with Terragroup in the city, maybe even a shootout or some shit. If even half of it’s true, we’re gonna be sitting here for a long damn time.

15.01
Knew right away this was going to turn into a disaster… We’re fucked, royally. Orders came down from above to drop anchor and wait for further instructions and meanwhile everything in Tarkov just keeps getting worse. Alex says UN troops’ll enter the city soon and everything’ll calm down. Yeah, sure. Fucking sure it will…

3.06
Still no orders. Comms started acting up too. Usually at least you know when your contract ends, but here you just sit around losing your damn mind. Max’s family in Tarkov saw military vehicles in the streets. Maybe our guys’ll finally get shit under control??

April
Thought I’d never even find this notebook again. And sure as hell never thought I’d end up trapped on this goddamn icebreaker for years. Fucking blockade… And that bastard Altman deserves worse than death!

Yes the boys broke. We should’ve called for evacuation a long damn time ago! Maybe a year back those USECs still could’ve smuggled us across the cordon. Obvious enough command stopped giving a shit about us the second troops rolled into the city.

But no. Altman’s precious materials matter more than actual living people whose brains are already melting in this frozen hell!

At least now there’s maybe some hope they’ll get us outta here. And when we finally make it out I’m burning this fucking diary to ashes.
