byText.Самодельный патрон .366 ТКМ (9.55x39 мм): A .366 TKM (9.55x39mm) AP-M cartridge loaded with an 16 gram armor-piercing bullet from a 9x39mm SP-6 gs cartridge, composed of a hardened carbon steel core with a two-layer semi-jacket, a lead interior and a bimetallic exterior, in a modified steel case. This ingeniously improvised cartridge was created by Mechanic due to the precarious situation of its customers in Tarkov, resulting in a cartridge that can pierce through basic and intermediate ballistic body protection, as well as providing a considerable stopping power effect, however, its own design alters its flight pattern, making it less accurate. Its design also allows it to be used in 7.62x39mm AK magazines without any problem.

byText.Kel-Tec RFB (Rifle, Forward-ejection, Bu: The Kel-Tec RFB (Rifle, Forward-ejection, Bullpup) is a gas-operated bullpup type semi-automatic rifle, manufactured by Kel-Tec. Chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO/.308 Winchester ammunition. The RFB uses metric FAL magazines, which insert straight into the magazine well and do not need to rock into place. The weapon is fully ambidextrous, much in the style of the Belgian F2000 rifle. The RFB is delivered without iron sights. A mil-spec Picatinny rail is provided for mounting a wide range of optics and tactical accessories.

byText.Пистолет MEU (SOC), официально обозначен: The MEU(SOC) pistol, ("Marine Expeditionary Unit"; "Special Operations Capable") officially designated the M45 MEUSOC, is a magazine-fed, recoil-operated, single-action, semiautomatic pistol chambered for the .45 ACP cartridge. It's a variant of the M1911, and has been the standard-issue side arm for the Force Recon Element of the United States Marine Corps' Marine Expeditionary Units since 1985. The improved M45A1 features several changes to the original M1911A1 design. One feature is the dual recoil spring system that spreads out the recoil force of the .45 ACP round by lowering the peak force of the recoil pulse. It also has 3-dot tritium night sights, a 5-inch national match barrel, ambidextrous safety, a picatinny rail, and a desert tan Cerakote finish.

Despite its rudimentary design, this cartridge possesses capabilities of piercing basic and intermediate ballistic body protections, as well as providing a considerable stopping power effect and being capable of causing critical adverse effects on the target after impact. However, due to its design, it has a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces.

This cartridge was designed to increase, in a limited way, the anti-materiel capabilities of the .338 Lapua Magnum caliber rifles, managing to pierce through light armored vehicles not to mention its excellent results against the most modern specialized ballistic body protections as well as having a considerable stopping power effect and be able to inflict devastating adverse effects on the target after impact. However, due to its design, it has a significant probability of bouncing off various surfaces.
A .338 Lapua Magnum (8.6x70mm) TAC-X cartridge with an 18.4 gram expansive bullet made entirely of copper in a brass case. The bullet of this cartridge provides a good impact grouping at long distances and is designed to be used in Big Game Hunting, as it has a superior stopping power effect for its caliber and is capable of causing critical adverse effects on the target after impact, however, despite the high energy of the .338 Lapua Magnum caliber and due to the TAC-X bullet design, it has difficulties of piercing basic ballistic body protections and has a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces.

However, due to its design, it has a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces.

byText.Снимает большую часть известных ядов и т: Removes most of the known poisons and toxins used in the combat industry. Can be used to relieve the effects of natural poisons. Gives immunity to poisoning while the components are in the blood system. Can reduce health status.
Designed for special forces personnel. It makes it possible to reduce the human body temperature for a short time, significantly slowing down the metabolism. The use of SJ9 leads to a significant reduction in the amount of heat released into the environment, while maintaining a safe level of metabolism inside. It is used during night operations, allowing to be hardly visible for thermal imaging devices.

byText.Патрон 5.56x45мм НАТО MK 318 Mod 0 (SOST: A 5.56x45mm NATO MK 318 Mod 0 (SOST) cartridge with a 4 gram open-point bullet with a lead core over a copper base with a copper jacket, in a brass case. The cartridge was specially designed for the United States Marine Corps, under the name SOST (Special Operations Science and Technology) to provide penetration of objects with low structural strength and provide a considerable stopping power effect, even being able of piercing basic ballistic body protections.

byText.Легендарный новейший патрон повышенной к: The newest legendary 5.45x39mm 7N40 cartridge with a 4.2 gram armor-piercing bullet with a pointed hardened carbon steel core over a lead base with a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case. Made as part of the Ratnik program together with 7N39 PPBS "Igolnik". It is capable of piercing through basic and intermediate ballistic body protections, however, due to its design, it has a significant bounce probability on various surfaces.
byText.Патрон ПАБ-9 (Патрон Автоматный Бронебой: A 9x39mm PAB-9 gs special cartridge with a 17.2 gram subsonic armor-piercing bullet with an extended hardened carbon steel core with a two-layer semi-jacket, a lead interior and a bimetallic exterior, in a steel case. The PAB-9 (Patrón Avtomátnyy Bronebóynyy - "Armor-piercing Cartridge for Automatic rifles") is a modified version of the SP-6 cartridge. It has a heavier bullet and a higher muzzle velocity, making it capable of piercing through basic and intermediate ballistic body protections in addition of providing outstanding results against some specialized protection models, and having a considerable stopping power effect, at the cost of deterioration in its accuracy and having a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces. In the ranks of the special forces of the Russian Federation, it is not recommended for use due to the increased negative impact on the resource of the weapon.
byText.Высокоточный специализированный охотничи: A .300 Blackout (7.62x35mm) V-Max cartridge with a 7.1 gram lead core polymer tipped expansive bullet with a copper metal jacket, in a brass case. This bullet features a ballistic tip that improves its accuracy and acts as a wedge on the lead core upon impact, allowing the bullet to expand and cause considerable damage on the target. Despite the peculiarity of its design, it is able to pierce basic ballistic body protections. Its design also allows it to be used in STANAG 5.56x45mm NATO magazines without any problem.
byText.Патрон \"Whisper\" - это легкая сверхско: The Whisper cartridge is a lightweight, hyper velocity design using an aluminum core and pre-stressed jacket. The aluminum core initiates the expansion slightly after contact, pressing back into the pre-stressed jacket and activating a violent, incapacitating energy transfer. The cartridge is ideal for close fire contacts of unarmored and/or lightly armored targets. Not to be mistaken for .300 Blackout, since Whisper was developed almost 20 years before it.
byText.Патрон .300 Blackout M62 с трассирующей: A .300 Blackout (7.62x35mm) M62 Tracer cartridge loaded with a 9.2 gram tracer bullet from a 7.62x51mm NATO M62 cartridge, composed of a lead-antimony alloy core with a bimetallic jacket, in a brass case; intended for target designation and fire adjustment in battle (Trace color: Red). Despite the bullet's own characteristics when used in a full-power cartridge, these are affected when transferred to an intermediate cartridge, still, the bullet continues to have capabilities to pierce basic ballistic body protections as well as some intermediate models. However, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces. Its design also allows it to be used in STANAG 5.56x45mm NATO magazines without any issues.

The COMM 3 main bay is designed for PRC117F or G, PRC119F, 152, or ASIP radios. The Hitchhiker and Daypack lid allows you to carry separate gear if needed. The modular NICE COMM 3 system is ready to adapt to changing tasks. An extremely rare thing, for which a real hunt is conducted in Tarkov.

The design of the vest provides two lightweight covers for plates, adjustable shoulder straps and a light waist jumper. Equipped with a front panel for 4 magazines.
byText.Во втором тысячелетии экипировка военнос: In the second millennium, the equipment of a soldier received serious changes in view of new threats and tasks. A better level of protection was required, so the Russian army needed a reliable and functional body armor. In the mid-2000s, the MVD, which was later reorganized into the Russian Guard, received Bagariy bulletproof vests. Bagariy was used both by ordinary soldiers of the internal troops, and in special forces. Actively was used by PMC BEAR as the main heavy body armor.
byText.Этот новый вариант ECLiPSE RBAV (Releasa: The BAE ECLiPSE RBAV (Releasable Body Armor Vest, Air Force) variant is designed specifically for the Guardian Angel Weapon System (USAF PJ) and contains several new features not found in other versions.

The headset's electronics are contained completely inside the headset housing, eliminating the need for a large, heavy external radio control box. The headband mechanically stabilizes the headset to help relieve issues of earplugs dislodging from cable snags and body movement. Designed for comfortable use with a ballistic helmet.

byText.Glock 19X - австрийский пистолет, создан: The Glock 19X is an Austrian pistol based on the Glock 19 Modular Handgun System developed by Glock. Glock 19X is a hybrid of the Glock 17 and Glock 19 models: bolt and barrel of the 19th model, and the long handle of the very first 17th model. Also, the Glock 19X is devoid of sub-finger recesses, but has a loop for a safety cord. The gun is made in the Coyote color.

byText.Шприц с самодельным препаратом, авторств: A syringe with a homemade drug, developed by Sanitar. A new version of the old classic. Looks like TerraGroup Labs' experiments did not end with the closure of TerraGroup Labs itself.
Developed for the operatives of special units. Slows down some functions of the body and they temporarily start working with energy regeneration. The drug forces the release of vasopressin in the hypothalamus, which leads to a change in the work of the adrenal glands, lowers body temperature and increases perception. After the end of the action, there is usually a jump in temperature to 40-42 degrees as a compensation for the incorrect functioning of the body systems.
byText.Боевой стимулятор. Разработан TerraGroup: A combat stimulant. Developed by TerraGroup Labs, labeled PNB. Allows a short-term activation of the inner muscles, bringing them into a state of hypertonicity, which in turn reduces the received damage. At the same time there is an active synthesis of proteins for accelerated tissue regeneration. Used for the expansion of the organism abilities at the key moment of the combat. Allowed for use by Special Forces. Has some side effects.
byText.Опиоидный синтетический анальгетик, разр: An opioid synthetic analgesic developed for special forces operatives. It has a central and spinal cord action (promotes opening of K+ and Ca2+ channels, causes hyperpolarization of membranes and inhibits conduction of pain impulses). In addition to the analgesic effect, it increases combat characteristics. Overdose leads to exhaustion of the body after the effects wear off.
byText.Кровезаменитель с функцией переноса кисл: A blood substitute with the function of oxygen transfer, used as a powerful antidote capable of relieving toxins, poisons, and radiation damage. It was developed by Soviet scientists in the 1980s. It is a submicron emulsion based on PFO compounds. Once in the blood, it temporarily speeds up the metabolism and regenerates tissues. Negatively affects health in case of overdose or rejection.

byText.СВТ-40 в первые годы ВОВ была единственн: The SVT-40 was the only mass-produced personal weapon in the early years of WW2, before the mass production of submachine guns began. The soldiers affectionately called this rifle "Sveta". When "Sveta" went to the troops, it turned out that not all Red Army soldiers were able to truly master this weapon. The SVT was best used by marine infantry units and snipers. The production of SVT-40 continued until the end of the war, and this semi-automatic rifle made an important contribution to the overall victory.

byText.Баллистическая маска \"CQCM\" от Atomic: Atomic Defense's CQCM ballistic mask provides protection against wide variety of short-mid range weapons including shotguns and assault rifles. This heavyweight reinforced mask covers the wearer's face completely. It features an inner lining and wraps slightly around the sides of the head for added protection. The mask also features five-point adjustable straps to ensure a comfortable and precise fit.
byText.Шлем Diamond Age \"NeoSteel\" (Черный): Diamond Age NeoSteel High Cut helmet (Black)
byText.Шлем Diamond Age NeoSteel обладает уника: The Diamond Age NeoSteel helmet features a unique design that combines high-strength steel with composite materials to provide advanced protection against ballistic and impact threats. It is designed to withstand high velocity impacts and can provide protection against a variety of threats.
byText.Мандибула для шлема Diamond Age \"NeoSte: Diamond Age NeoSteel helmet ballistic mandible
byText.Специальная дополнительная баллистическа: An extra ballistic protection with a special design for the Diamond Age NeoSteel helmet.
The "Death Shadow" airsoft mask, supposedly protecting the face from plastic BBs.
byText.НПП КлАСС Тор-2 — штурмовой защитный шле: NPP KlASS Tor-2 is an assault protective helmet with a removable bullet-resistant visor and an integrated system for installing additional equipment (NVG, headsets, tactical lights, cameras, IR strobe lights, etc.).
byText.Бронезабрало для шлема \"Тор-2\": NPP KlASS Tor-2 helmet face shield
byText.Специальное забрало для бронешлема НПП К: A special visor for the NPP KlASS Tor-2 helmet, made of heavy-duty glass.
A half-mask with a skull print.
A real bandit's attribute - the black leather baseball cap.
byText.Патрон 9х21мм 7Н42 (ПП, Индекс ГРАУ - 7Н: The 9x21mm PP cartridge (GRAU Index - 7N42) with increased penetration bullet is designed to engage armored personnel. The head part of the core is made with a cut edge. This design ensures the tearing of the threads of the fabric base of the body armor and significantly increases the penetration of the bullet. The core protrudes from the jacket, which increases its penetration capability. The bullet head is colored black.
byText.Патрон 9х21мм 7У4 (Индекс ГРАУ - 7У4) с: The 9x21mm 7U4 round (GRAU index - 7U4) with reduced bullet velocity, designed for flameless and low-noise firing. The cartridge features a cut edge on the front end of the core, formed by two flat edges, and increased weight.
byText.Патрон 9x39мм ТПЗ FMJ предназначен для с: The 9x39mm TCW FMJ cartridge is intended for firing from civilian weapons. The cartridge does not lose its qualities when used in various climatic and meteorological conditions, regardless of the time of year.

byText.Левый взвод Вектор \"VR-LPS\" для ПП-19-: PP-19-01 Vityaz Vector VR-LPS left-side charging handle
byText.\"VR-LPS\" - устройство, позволяющее пер: VR-LPS is a device that allows for reloading the weapon with the support hand. Installed in place of the gas tube and enables quick and efficient reloading. Manufactured by Vector 7.62.
byText.Тактическое кукри из серии M48 производс: A 48 series tactical kukri manufactured by United Cutlery. Features a stainless steel blade and rubberized handle. A great addition to every survivalist's arsenal!
byText.Перенастроенный Неизвестными радиопереда: A radio transmitter reconfigured by unknown assailants. It's impossible to determine the modification technology, nor is it likely to figure out what kind of signal it's transmitting. When in the area of low intensity combat zone (PvE), the user of the device becomes visible in Fence's agent network. However, using this device, you have to follow his rules. Fence pays half of the money spent in the raid and coordinates the Scavs when searching for the user's lost equipment. If trusted enough by Fence, the user will not be attacked by Scavs as long as they keep their distance and show no aggression. In return, Fence requires to minimize damage to Scavs, and if the death of a Scav could not be avoided - to reduce the number of interference with his activities in the face of other PMCs in the area of the incident.
byText.Коллиматорный прицел \"Русак\", разработ: A collimator sight manufactured by Kazan Optical-Mechanical Plant in the mid-90s for use on hunting weapons. Installed on the Dovetail type rail, adjustment only possible after full disassembly. Heavy, uncomfortable, foggy sight with horrible parallax - a real product of its time. However, it's still slightly more effective than shooting with iron sights.
byText.Универсальная направляющая для установки: A universal rail for mounting various sights on the Remington Model 700. Manufactured by Badger Ordnance.
byText.Боковой кронштейн RS Regulate \"AK-303M\: RS Regulate AK-303M Full Length Lower dovetail mount
byText.Боковой кронштейн \"AK-303M\" разработан: The AK-303M side platform is designed as a base for mounting RS Regulate top mounts on AK assault rifles and their variants: Saiga, SVD, and others. Manufactured by RS Regulate.
byText.Крепление AKR для бокового кронштейна AK: The AKR 1913 Railed 0 MOA Mount, installed on the AK-303M Lower Mount. Manufactured by RS Regulate.

byText.Ручной пулемет M60E4 (Mk 43 Mod 1) под к: The M60E4 (Mk 43 Mod 1) is a 7.62x51 caliber light machine gun, a modification of the M60E3 with a more reliable trigger mechanism, ability to attach optics, and a number of other improvements. The M60 was nicknamed "The Pig" due to its bulky size and design flaws. Despite its disadvantages, variants of the M60 are still used in some military units. Manufactured by U.S. Ordnance.

byText.Бронебойная пуля для дробовиков калибра: An armor-piercing slug for 20/70 caliber shotguns. Combines decent accuracy with increased penetration. Excellent choice if the target needs to be eliminated, not just intimidated.
byText.Патрон для дробовиков калибра 20/70. Поч: A slug cartridge for 20/70 caliber shotguns. Loses very little velocity over distance, so it is suitable for reliable target engagement at a long range.
byText.Патрон, снаряжённый заточенными флешетта: A shell loaded with razor-sharp flechettes for 20ga shotguns. Far from being the most effective round, but believe us - you definitely don't want to be on the receiving end of the weapon loaded with it.

byText.Следующая разработка TerraGroup после ст: TerraGroup's next development after the 3-(b-TG) stimulant. The goal of the project was to obtain a drug that would give an advantage in reconnaissance and crossing combat zones far away from supply points. At the same time, the drug is required to be manufacturable in handicraft conditions. The obtained substance allows to keep the CNS in tone for a long period of time, which positively affects the fighter's efficiency to assess the environment, and also enhances their ability to carry equipment. The stimulant’s effective duration is accompanied by increased loss of hydration.
byText.Особое устройство, которое использует це: A special device that utilizes a whole network of detectors, communication systems and satellites. Mechanic built it from the blueprints of a certain someone named Mr. Kerman. Although the device doesn't allow you to connect to digital maps of the area, it can warn you of an impending mortar attack.

byText.В такую коробку много не влезет. Зато те: This box can't hold much, but now you can see what's inside.
byText.Неизвестно, что внутри. Но чтобы открыть: The contents are unknown, but you'll need a key to open it.
byText.72.5 мм штурмовая граната термобарическо: A 72.5mm thermobaric assault rocket for the RShG-2 rocket launcher.
byText.Ключ, подходящий для открытия большинств: A key suitable for opening most standard cases.
byText.Тактический рюкзак с комплексной системо: A tactical backpack with a complex modular system. The arrangement of internal compartments and side straps makes the RUSH 100 a highly versatile backpack that can be adapted to any combat situation.
byText.Модель трёхдневного рюкзака в зимнем кам: A medium-size 3-day backpack designed for both military and tourist use. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading. MultiCam Alpine version.
byText.С камуфляжным чехлом «Арктика» привычный: 6B47 is an aramid helmet of Russian origin. As part of the Ratnik program, it is the new standard-issue helmet for most of the Russian Armed Forces. The 6B47 is similar to previous generation helmets such as the 6B7-1M and 6B27. It has equal protection but weighs slightly less, floats in water, and has mounting equipment for lights and night vision devices. The helmet can be fitted with a variety of covers for different environments. Equipped with an arctic EMR camouflage cover.
byText.Разгрузочная нагрудная система Spiritus: Spiritus Systems Bank Robber chest rig (MultiCam Alpine)
byText.Зимний вариант разгрузки Bank Robber вря: An ultra-compact and lightweight chest rig for mobility and comfort. Manufactured by Spiritus Systems. MultiCam Alpine camouflage version, for all your winter LARP needs.
byText.50-зарядный барабанный магазин повышенно: A PP-19-01 Vityaz 9x19 drum magazine with a 50-round capacity. Manufactured by F5 MFG.
byText.Полимерное цевьё для автомата Velocirapt: A polymer handguard for the Velociraptor assault rifle. A modified version of the Tapco AK handguard based on the Galil AR handguard, designed to be installed over the suppressor shroud, preventing possible injury to the shooter's hands during firing.
byText.Автомат Aklys Defense Velociraptor .300: Aklys Defense Velociraptor .300 Blackout assault rifle
byText.Специальная модификация на базе автомата: A special modification based on the AK assault rifle chambered in .300 Blackout caliber, manufactured by Aklys Defense. It replaces the standard barrel assembly with a modified integrally suppressed barrel, which allowed to achieve a significantly reduced sound signature.
byText.Опасен так же, как и рыба, в чью честь н: As dangerous as the fish it's named after.
byText.К Новому году Килла переработал дизайн с: To celebrate Christmas and the New Year, Killa redesigned his body armor. The armor is now more noticeable, but Killa has never been one for cautious reconnaissance.
byText.Комфортный и вместительный для своего об: A comfortable and spacious backpack for its volume, it remained popular even in wartime. Judging by the attached antlers, this backpack used to belong to a hunter.
byText.Кто-то украсил стандартную модель Terraf: Someone has decorated the standard Terraframe model for Christmas. The weight hasn't changed much, but going into a raid has become somehow... more cheerful?
byText.Цевье алюминиевое Chaos \"Titan Quad Rai: SOK-12 Chaos Titan Quad Rail handguard

byText.Крепление, устанавливаемое поверх цевья: A handguard top rail for the Titan Quad Rail System, manufactured by Chaos.
byText.Направляющая поверх ствольной коробки Ch: SOK-12 Chaos Titan receiver top rail
byText.Направляющая \"Titan\" для установки раз: A receiver top rail for the Titan Quad Rail System, manufactured by Chaos.
byText.Целик, выполненный в стиле популярных пр: A rear sight modeled after the popular Heckler & Koch iron sights, manufactured by Chaos.
byText.Мушка, выполненная в стиле популярных пр: A front sight modeled after the popular Heckler & Koch iron sights, manufactured by Chaos.
byText.20-зарядный барабанный магазин от MD Arm: The MD Arms 20-shell drum magazine for SOK-12 and compatible weapons, intended for use with 12/76 or 12/70 shells.
byText.Модификация гладкоствольного дробовика С: A modification of the Saiga-12K smoothbore shotgun, enabling fully automatic fire. Hell of a beast.
byText.Несмотря на то, что эта модель производи: Despite the fact that this model was manufactured in the 80s, the Soviet quality is still evident. The picture might not be as good as gen 2 or gen 3 night vision, but it's definitely worth its price.
AR-15 Magpul B.A.D. Lever bolt release
byText.Рычаг затворной задержки \"B.A.D. Lever\: The Battery Assist Device Lever for the AR-15 platform and compatibles. Allows to release the bolt into battery from the right side of the rifle, making it easier to operate the weapon for left-handed shooters. Manufactured by Magpul.
byText.Банка закрыта то ли несколько месяцев, т: The jar has been sealed either a few months or a few years ago. There's hardly anyone left in the city who would waste time making fresh pickles.
byText.Даже в условиях военного конфликта опытн: Even during a military conflict, experienced warriors strive to celebrate the holiday. Olivier salad is the mainstay of the New Year's Eve table.
byText.В сильный мороз даже бензин может подвес: Even gasoline can fail in extreme cold. That is why you have to use something stronger outdoors.
byText.Средство для продления жизни ёлок. Говор: A special product designed for preserving the cut Christmas trees.
byText.Версия шлема MTEK \"STRIKE\" с расширенн: A version of the MTEK STRIKE helmet with extended modularity. MultiCam Alpine version.
A version of the MTEK STRIKE helmet with extended modularity. Olive Drab version.
byText.Лёгкий и эргономичный шлем с возможность: A lightweight ergonomic helmet manufactured by MTEK. Coyote version.
A lightweight ergonomic helmet manufactured by MTEK. Coyote/MultiCam Arid version.
byText.Защитный шлем «Маска-1» появился на воор: The Maska-1 bulletproof protective helmet appeared in service in 1991 as a replacement for the "Sphere" helmet, designed for use by the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation armed forces. The Maska-1SCh ("Mask-1 Shield") modification features a bulletproof steel faceshield to ensure maximum protection of the user's face. Looks like Killa loves to celebrate Christmas and New Year.
byText.Редкий плакат What You Seek. Только самы: A rare What You Seek poster. Only the most hardcore USEC operators can get it.
byText.Редкий плакат I Bear Loot. Далеко не каж: A rare I Bear Loot poster. Very few BEAR operators can get one of these.
byText.Обычный плакат с девушкой. Идеально подх: A simple poster of a girl. Perfect for a rest area.
byText.Обычный плакат с девушкой, местами потёр: A simple poster of a girl. A little weathered in some spots, but still pleasing to the eye.
byText.Обычный плакат с девушкой. Настолько обы: A simple poster of a girl. So simple that every man in Tarkov had probably seen it at least once.
byText.Обычный плакат с девушкой. Состояние не: A simple poster of a girl. Not perfect condition, but it's doubtful you could find a better one.
byText.Редкий плакат с девушкой. Говорят, что к: A rare poster of a girl. It is said that someone pawned five gold teeth for one of these. Who they used to belong to is not stated.
byText.Плакат, о котором слагали легенды. Такой: A poster that has truly become legendary. Only a few people have one of these.
A blatant advertisement for making money in the Arena. Many Tarkov citizens were tempted by the quick money, despite risking death.
byText.Плакат с рекламой заработка на Арене. Де: A poster advertising making money in the Arena. Sure, you can make some quick cash, but you will most definitely die even quicker.
byText.Плакат с Арены. На нём изображены легенд: A poster from the Arena. It depicts the at the time legendary gladiators. So many Scavs came to see them fight that there weren't enough seats in the stands. Nowadays, nobody even remembers who won.
byText.Плакат с Киллой и Тагиллой в образе аним: A poster with Killa and Tagila as anime girls. If only they were real.
byText.Плакат авангардного композитора Alex Gre: A poster of the avant-garde composer Alex Green. His music is multifaceted and unique, so much so that the world's leading media wrote about him. People used to pay huge sums of money to visit his concerts.
byText.Редкий плакат фильма, который так и не в: A rare poster of the movie which was never released. Director N. Tankovsky said in an interview that the story would be about a young security guard who began to notice mystical strange things going on in Tarkov.
byText.В своё время весь Тарков был наводнён та: At one point, the whole Tarkov was flooded with advertisements like this. But for some reason this particular poster is subtly different.
byText.Редкий плакат. Концерт проходил за грани: A rare poster. The concert was held overseas. Why were these posters put up all over Tarkov? No one knows to this day, but conspiracy theories are rampant.
byText.Обычный постер очередного фильма от режи: A regular poster of yet another movie from the director A. Bambetov.
byText.Обычный постер неизданного фильма Den of: A regular poster for the unreleased movie Den of Wolves. Nothing special, just a wolf.
byText.Неизвестный художник попытался представи: An unknown artist tried to envision what a highway will look like in 2028. What is it: a flight of fancy or a subtle warning?
byText.Постер фильма Hell or Highwater. Большие: A poster for the movie Hell or Highwater. The big screens never ran it, but Tarkov still has enough of these posters left to use as decoration.
byText.Плакат остросюжетного боевика «Бой» от с: A poster for the action thriller Gunfight from the studio Battle Star. Years ago, cinemas used to have massive waiting lines for movie. Now all that's left are the posters. It's a nice reminder of the old days.
byText.Остросюжетный триллер «Крайний рейс» не: The thriller Last Flight did not win any awards, but the box office collected a decent amount of cash. The director of the movie, Yulin Kontorsky, must have been overjoyed.
byText.Студия Bubble Step неплохо поработала на: The studio Bubble Step did a pretty good job on their debut horror film Spooky Movie. Too bad they didn't have enough imagination for the title.
byText.Фильм «Василий» от легендарного режиссёр: The movie Vasily from the legendary director Nikita Bayanov. It held the box office lead for 28 weeks, owing in no small part to its deep and unusual plot.
The poster is not wordy, but straightforward. It'll look great at the front door. Or the exit door?
byText.Фильм Sharpshooter так и не вышел. Жаль,: The movie Sharpshooter never came out. A real shame. The poster's kinda stylish.
byText.Постер фильма The Ambush. Правда, кроме: A poster of the movie The Ambush. Although, in the end, the audience didn't see anything other than posters.
byText.Постер неизданного фильма The Hunted. Чт: A poster for the unreleased movie The Hunted. Something about this style reminds of... A sequel to another unreleased project?
byText.Постер неизданного фильма USEC. Кажется,: A poster of the unreleased movie USEC. It seems that this is how they wanted to fill the ranks of PMC operatives.
byText.Кто-то от руки набросал схему периметра: Someone had sketched a hand-drawn diagram of the perimeter of the Federal Reserve military base in its northwestern part. According to the notes, there is a gap in the minefield that could be used for a safe exfil.
byText.Кто-то готовился к штурму очистных недал: Someone was preparing to assault the water treatment plant and had marked out the optimal routes to bypass the minefields. One of the routes goes toward the bay. Looks like there's a safe exfil route from the coast.
byText.Кто-то от руки набросал схему минного по: Someone has hand-drawn a diagram of the minefield next to the railroad in the nature reserve area. Apparently, you can safely exfil from Priozersk near the railroad bridge.
byText.Судя по всему, \"Ворон\" - это какой-то: It seems that "Voron" is some kind of cipher or code. If someone has manipulated the exfils from Customs, they must have left access only for their own. The question is, where are these exits?
byText.\"Оникс\". Если это не случайная записка: “Onyx”. If it's not a random scribble, then it's some kind of code. Perhaps one of the Scavs has found a new exfil route out of the city, but only allows access to their own. In a densely built environment, a reliable escape route must be underground.
byText.На записке есть только одно слово: \"Ада: There's only one word on the note: “Adaptation”. Looks like a code word. If someone found a new exfil route out of the TerraGroup HQ area, they must have placed their men nearby to keep anyone from the outside from getting to the new exit. In that case, the code would help distinguish friend from foe.
byText.Надпись \"Ковчег\" вряд ли стоит восприн: The word “Ark” hardly needs to be taken literally. It's more like a code word. There are quite a few locked doors under the Polikhim Factory, leading deeper into the catacombs. Perhaps someone will open the door for you if you know the code word.
byText.Кто-то написал на оторванном листе бумаг: Someone wrote the word “Heartbeat” on a torn piece of paper. Sounds like one of Sanitar's weird pranks. Or perhaps a code word? If his men have their own exfil routes off Shoreline, they must be using a system of key phrases or signals. Maybe this note will make you look like one of their own.
byText.Обычно шапки громко звенят при каждом дв: Usually these hats ring loudly with each head movement. Looks like someone got all the bells out of it beforehand.
byText.Новогодняя кепка с рогами. От пули не за: A Christmas hat with deer antlers. It won't protect you from gunshots, but it can distract your opponent for a split second. Sometimes that's all that matters.
byText.В обычных условиях эта балаклава была бы: In normal conditions, this balaclava would be too visible. But in winter it becomes essential, especially in rough terrain.
byText.Особый армейский жетон с резиновыми борт: A special army dogtag with rubber sides serving the purpose of quickly identifying the wounded and deceased in combat. An indicator of the PMC operative's status.
byText.Особый армейский жетон из нержавеющей ст: A special stainless steel army dogtag serving the purpose of quickly identifying the wounded and deceased in combat. Available only to the most experienced PMC operatives.
byText.Засекреченная разработка компании TerraG: A secret TerraGroup invention that has fallen into the hands of the cultists.
byText.Кейс для хранения бронеплит. Вместительн: A spacious case for storing ballistic plates.

byText.Крышка ствольной коробки для СОК-12, мод: A receiver dust cover for the SOK-12 shotgun, modernized by Kiba Arms.
A children's mask stylized as a rooster. In the realities of Tarkov, it probably looks intimidating. Or not. As if there weren't enough mercs with cringy plastic skull masks already.
byText.Похоже, эту маску забрали со склада с ре: It looks like this mask was taken from a warehouse with props for a play based on a G. Rodari story.
byText.Маска одного из лучших врачей всех времё: A mask depicting one of the best doctors of all time.
byText.На детских утренниках нередко можно увид: These kinds of masks are often seen at kids' parties. But this one also fits an adult.
byText.Маска персонажа, который ненавидит празд: A mask of someone who hates Christmas.
byText.Привычная многим заячья маска. Непонятно: A common hare mask. It is unclear just who and why made a copy of this mask to fit an adult.
byText.Маска звездочёта с колпаком, который нос: A stargazer mask with a cap worn by astronomers from children's fairy tales.

byText.Повязка поможет продемонстрировать свой: This armband will help demonstrate your status in Tarkov.
byText.Такие повязки доступны только лучшим из: These armbands are only for the best of the best.
byText.Прицел Mark 5HD 5-25x56 славится как бол: The Mark 5HD 5-25x56 riflescope is known for being a lighter and more efficient optic than other scopes in its class. Featuring optical glass, full multi-coated lenses and an advanced light management system, the scope offers low-glare, high-contrast imaging. Installed on 35mm ring mounts. Manufactured by Leupold. Flat Dark Earth version.
byText.Крепление 35мм Leupold \"Mark IMS\" для: Leupold Mark IMS 35mm ring scope mount
byText.Mark IMS - кольца для установки прицелов: A 35mm scope mount for installation on Picatinny rails. Manufactured by Leupold.
byText.Крепление, позволяющее устанавливать сош: A mount allows installation of Harris bipods on standard Picatinny handguards. Manufactured by Knight's Armament Company.

byText.Труба приклада с адаптером для АКМС. Поз: A buttstock adapter for the AKMS automatic rifle. Allows to install Com-Spec and Mil-Spec buttstocks on the weapon. Made of durable anodized aluminum. Manufactured by FAB Defense.
byText.Барабанный 100-зарядный магазин для плат: A 100-round double drum magazine for the AR-15 platform weapons. Manufactured by Beta Company.
byText.Барабанный 100-зарядный магазин для пист: A 100-round double drum magazine for the UZI submachine gun. The magazine modification is equipped with a transparent plastic cover that allows to check the ammo count. Manufactured by Beta Company.
byText.30-зарядный магазин для пистолетов Beret: A 30-round 9x19 magazine for the Beretta M9A3 pistol.
byText.Штурмовая винтовка FN SCAR-H (Special Op: The FN SCAR-H (Special Operations Forces Combat Assault Rifle - Heavy) assault rifle chambered in 7.62x51 NATO rounds, was adopted by the US SOCOM as the Mk 17. Features a side-folding polymer stock and a free-floating, cold hammer-forged Mil-Spec barrel with hardchromed bore. Fully-ambidextrous operating controls instantly adapt the SCAR to any user or any shooting position. The receiver-integrated optical rail plus three accessory rails enable mounting of a wide variety of scopes, electronic sights, tactical lights and lasers. The X-17 lower receiver allows the installation of AR-10 magazines. Manufactured by Fabrique Nationale Herstal and X Products.
byText.Магазин барабанный X Products \"X-25\" н: AR-10 7.62x51 X Products X-25 50-round drum magazine
byText.50-зарядный барабанный магазин X-25, под: A 50-round 7.62x51 drum magazine for the AR-10 platform weapons. Manufactured by X Products.
byText.Направляющая RFB 3\" Quad Rail позволяет: A 3 inch quad rail mount for the RFB rifle, allowing the installation of additional tactical equipment. Manufactured by Kel-Tec.
byText.Приклад DoubleStar \"ACE ARFX Skeleton S: AR-15 DoubleStar ACE ARFX Skeleton Stock
byText.Легкий приклад ACE ARFX Skeleton Stock о: The lightweight ACE ARFX Skeleton Stock provides comfort, balance and aesthetics. Fits both the Mil-Spec and civilian M/AR platform. Manufactured by DoubleStar.
byText.Полимерный телескопический приклад АК-ЭВ: A new polymer buttstock for the modern AK platform folding weapons. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Concern.
byText.Кронштейн Tactical Barrel Clamp предназн: The Tactical Barrel Clamp is designed for mounting on tubular magazines and barrels with a diameter of 20-27 millimeters. Features a rail for attaching additional equipment. Manufactured by Toni System.
byText.Цевье и газовая трубка SAG \"MK1 M-LOK\": PP-19-01 Vityaz SAG MK1 M-LOK handguard with gas tube
byText.Комбинированный кит, состоящий из цевья: A combined kit consisting of a handguard and a milled gas tube designed to improve the performance of the PP-19-01 Vityaz and the Saiga-9 civilian carbine. The handguard is equipped with an M-LOK interface for installing additional equipment, and the gas tube has a picatinny rail for mounting sights and tactical units. Manufactured by Sureshot Armament Group.
byText.Ключ от комнаты в старом доме где-то на: A key to one of the rooms in an old house somewhere on the edge of the Priozersk forest. It is said that a person nicknamed Ogryzok used to trade in these parts. He used to sell rare goods including even a steady supply of tank batteries. Yet nothing had long been heard of Ogryzok, and no one knows where he had disappeared to.
byText.Вероятно, таким ключом могли запереть од: This key must have been used to lock one of the company offices located in the customs terminal area.

byText.Пачка патронов 20/70 TSS Armor Piercing: A box of 20/70 TSS Armor Piercing Slug cartridges, 25 pieces.

Designed as a replacement for the M80 cartridge to improve the armor penetration and ballistics of the cartridge as part of a program to eliminate the use of lead in small arms ammunition in the U.S. Army.

A case with some epic goodies.

byText.Судя по этой маске, Лабиринт серьёзно по: Judging by this mask, the Labyrinth had severely affected Tagilla's mental state, making him even more unhinged and bloodthirsty. Who thought he could be any more crazy?
byText.Массивная рукоятка, снятая с какого-то к: A massive handwheel removed from some kind of valve. It must have been used to regulate the water or gas supply in the Knossos underground facilities.
byText.Из хватки Минотавра не выбраться. Остаёт: There's no escape from the Minotaur's grasp. The only thing left to do is to take the last deep breath and hold on as long as possible.
byText.Глядя на этот плакат, понимаешь, какое о: Looking at this poster, you realize the sheer terror that the Minotaur's victims felt before they died.
This poster embodies the nature of the Minotaur. Brutality, thirst for murder, and blood. Rivers of blood.
byText.На плакате изображён Минотавр, сражённый: This poster shows the Minotaur being slain by a warrior from the Labyrinth. Very few people have witnessed such a scene with their own eyes.
byText.Затёртый ключ от офисной двери с пометко: A worn office door key marked "Knossos LLC". Probably used to open utility rooms or other premises belonging to Knossos.
byText.Ключ-карта от одного из объектов компани: A keycard to one of Knossos facilities. The design references the Minotaur mythos, but it's somewhat strange there are no Minotaur theme parks in Tarkov.
byText.Документы явно зашифрованы, но судя по в: The documents are encrypted, but appear to contain research notes on some kind of technology or weapon. The records mention the name “Item 1156”.
byText.Лимитированная фигурка Tarko. Непонятно,: A limited edition Tarko figurine. What's more strange: the pale skin or the nails stuck in his head? It looks like this poor guy has experienced the full spectrum of human pain.
byText.Лимитированная фигурка Tarko. Жутковатый: A limited edition Tarko figurine. A creepy dude with a disfigured face and blades on his arm. Doing Obdolbos would give you nightmares.
byText.Лимитированная фигурка Tarko. Граф Крово: A limited edition Tarko figurine. Count Bloodsucker wouldn't have lasted more than a couple days in Tarkov. Sucking blood is cool and all, but does it work against flashbangs and .308?
byText.Лимитированная фигурка Tarko. Похоже на: A limited edition Tarko figurine. Looks like a monster with a disproportionately elongated head and a double mouth. Totally "Alien" (good one) to the Tarko universe.
byText.Лимитированная фигурка Tarko. На голову: A limited edition Tarko figurine. This funny little character is wearing something like a pyramid on his head. A character like this could only exist in a fictional world, along with zombies and other monsters.
byText.Лабрис сделан из сточного люка... С таки: A two-handed axe made out of a sewer hatch... With that weight, a single blow is enough to split a skull, whether the blade is sharp or not.
byText.Старый ключ, гравировку на нём не разобр: An old key, the markings are unreadable. Could be useful for surviving the Labyrinth.
byText.Этот ключ скорее всего открывает какой-т: This key probably opens some kind of an old lock. The number engraving has been practically scratched off. Could be useful for surviving the Labyrinth.
byText.Гравировка с цифрой едва различима на по: The number engraving is barely recognizable on the weathered metal. Could be useful for surviving the Labyrinth.
byText.Гравировку на этом ключе едва можно разо: The engraving on this key is barely readable: it's either the number 4 or the Russian letter Ч. Could be useful for surviving the Labyrinth.
byText.Ключ, открывающий одно из рабочих помеще: A key that opens one of the personnel workstation rooms in the Labyrinth. That room may have something to do with the research that took place in the Labyrinth.
byText.Старый ключ, который подойдёт скорее для: An old key that would be more suitable for a shabby lock on a grate or fence than a modern door.
byText.Старый ключ, от которого идёт стойкий тр: An old key that has a strong odor of death. Probably opens a morgue or a room where bodies were kept.
byText.Ключ, который открывает какую-то комнату: A key that opens a certain room in the Labyrinth. There's no telling what might be inside.

byText.Чехол под бронеплиты фирмы Hexatac. Мини: A plate carrier by Hexatac. A minimalistic version designed to be used with chest rigs. MultiCam version.
byText.Бронежилет \"Кираса N\" поверхностного н: The "Kirasa N" body armor is designed for the army and police special forces of the Russian Federation. The bulletproof vest provides circular protection of the human torso. Elements of the damper provide ventilation of the under armor space and reduce the blunt damage. Green version.
byText.\"Редут М\" – модифицированный вариант з: “Redut-M” is a modified version of the well-proven Redut body armor, which is in service of special units of the FSB. The vest is based on advanced technologies in the field of individual armor. Due to the optimized form of armor elements and the outer cover with a special damping-ventilation system, the Redut M armored vest has excellent functional qualities, which facilitates active actions, including those associated with the use of vehicles and in confined spaces. SK Woodland version.
byText.Бронежилет фирмы Highcom, популярный сре: A plate armor vest by HighCom, popular among USEC PMCs. Coyote version.
byText.Портативный резак с ограниченным запасом: A portable torch with a limited gas supply. This bad boy is unlikely to burn a hole in the wall, but will do the job on a small metal target.
byText.Разгрузочный жилет \"Альфа\" полностью о: "Alpha" is a high-quality chest rig that fully meets the military standards for reliability and functionality. The combination of integrated pouches and MOLLE straps provides the means of carrying a large number of necessary equipment. The vest is designed as a classic chest rig. In this type of vest, all the gear is located in the front and side parts, while the back part is comprised of adjustment belts and straps. Manufactured by ANA Tactical. MultiCam camouflage version.
byText.Производимая вручную в ограниченном коли: A custom-made chest rig for wearing on top of body armor in urban operations. Sturdy and versatile, it features both MOLLE and ALICE attachment systems. Khaki version.
byText.Разгрузочная система Crye Precision \"AV: The Crye Precision AVS plate carrier equipped with Groin Protector and pouches in assault configuration. MultiCam camouflage version.
byText.Разгрузочный жилет с набором подсумков д: A plate carrier with a set of pouches for use with assault rifles. Manufactured by 5.11 Tactical. Storm color version.

This version is personally modified by Partisan and has a shortened fuze, intended for explosive tripwires.

byText.Награда за открытие уровней Боевого Проп: A reward for progress in BattlePass Season 0. It contains various equipment to help you survive and kill in the harsh world of Tarkov. But first, you need to find a way to open this box.

A reward for progress in BattlePass Season 0. It contains various equipment to help you survive and kill in the harsh world of Tarkov. The lock has been crudely broken, which means there are no more obstacles between you and the contents of the box.
byText.Полуавтоматическая крупнокалиберная винт: The AK-50 semi-automatic anti-materiel rifle is an experimental first-of-a-kind project that adapts the Kalashnikov platform to use the .50 BMG cartridge. The AK-50 has outstanding penetration and range, making it a very powerful sniper rifle. This prototype was developed by a firearms manufacturer and YouTube blogger Brandon Herrera and co. as part of The AK Guy LTD.
byText.Этот кейс — ультимативное решение пробле: This case is the ultimate solution to the problem of hoarding various keys in the stash, helping to store them in one place.
byText.Дульный тормоз-компенсатор предназначен: A muzzle brake for the AK-50. Reduces recoil and muzzle rise. Manufactured by The AK Guy LTD.
byText.Десятизарядный магазин для винтовки M82A: A 10-round .50 BMG magazine for the M82A1 sniper rifle, manufactured by Barrett Firearms.
A .50 BMG (12.7x99mm NATO) hollow point cartridge, developed in the USA. The cartridge has significant stopping power and is capable of inflicting devastating damage to the target upon impact, however the hollow point bullet design does not allow it to penetrate armor effectively.
byText.Патрон .50 BMG с повышенной яркостью тра: A .50 BMG (12.7x99mm NATO) M21 "headlight" high-visibility tracer cartridge, developed in the USA and adopted in 1923 for Browning M2 machine guns, primarily designed to destroy light armored vehicles and neutralize enemy personnel behind light cover. The cartridge has significant stopping power and is capable of inflicting devastating damage to the target upon impact.
byText.Патрон .50 BMG (M33) - крупнокалиберный: A .50 BMG (12.7x99mm NATO) M33 Ball cartridge, developed in the USA and adopted in 1923 for Browning M2 machine guns, primarily designed to destroy light armored vehicles and neutralize enemy personnel behind light cover. The cartridge has significant stopping power and is capable of inflicting devastating damage to the target upon impact.
byText.Патрон M903 SLAP (Saboted Light Armor Pe: A .50 BMG (12.7x99mm NATO) M903 SLAP (Saboted Light Armor Penetrator) cartridge. Created by placing a 7.62 armor-piercing bullet in a polymer container that separates after leaving the barrel. The cartridge has significant stopping power and is capable of inflicting devastating damage to the target upon impact.
byText.Кто-то сделал на этом ключе еле заметную: Someone had made a barely visible mark on this key, resembling a ball of thread. Although, it could have simply been left by careless storage.
byText.Судя по этой маске, Лабиринт серьёзно по: Judging by this mask, the Labyrinth had severely affected Tagilla's mental state, making him even more unhinged and bloodthirsty. Who thought he could be any more crazy? It seems that this is merely a replica and cannot be worn. The mask was probably created as a souvenir, intended to remind survivors of their encounter with a ruthless killer.
byText.Ключ, найденный в номере А.П. Должно быт: A key found in A.P.'s room. It likely opens one of TerraGroup’s corporate apartments.
byText.Фирменная балаклава известного хип-хоп и: A signature balaclava of the famous Tarkov hip-hop artist with the Arena Cup Series tournament insignia. The artist hasn't performed in Tarkov for quite a while, but their merch has found a new life.
byText.На плакате изображена фанатка Киллы. Нес: This poster shows a Killa fangirl. Despite the scratches on the paper and folding marks, you can tell that the previous owner treasured this poster very much.
byText.Обычно в ряды BEAR и USEC не допускают ж: Women are not usually allowed to join BEAR or USEC. But even though the poster is damaged and the paper is sticky in places, it is obvious that this photo is authentic.
byText.Вряд ли в нынешнем Таркове можно найти п: It seems unlikely that similar pieces of equipment are available in present-day Tarkov. Judging by the condition of the poster, it was obviously made during peacetime.

byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Друзья! Кто там ещё? Дмитри: A.P.: Friends! Who’s still out there? Dmitry Sergeevich, come in and close the door, please. Thank you. Are all departments represented? I see they are. Let us begin, then.
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Все уже заметили, что средс: A.P.: By now, everyone’s noticed that communications have been down since this morning and many divisions are in lockdown. I’d like to say this is just another drill, but this time it’s very serious.
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Сегодня поступило распоряже: A.P.: We received an order from New York today. We’re evacuating.
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Тише, коллеги! Я понимаю ва: A.P.: Quiet, colleagues! I understand your concern, but we have to stay focused. I initiated the protocol a few hours ago. The specialists are already working on data destruction and sealing the premises.
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Все проекты в Таркове свора: A.P.: All projects in Tarkov are being shut down, including affiliated enterprises. From now on, contact with them will be handled only through… hmm… Gennady Viktorovich, I don’t see you, raise your hand, please. There, that’s the man you’ll need.
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Я думаю, что никаких пробле: A.P.: I believe there shouldn’t be any issues. Those drills we ran weren’t for nothing…
byText.<b>Вопрос из зала:</b> У меня половина о: Question from the audience: Half of my samples aren’t ready yet. What’s going to happen to them?
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Петр Алексеевич, пожалуйста: A.P.: Pyotr Alekseevich, please, hold your questions…
byText.<b>Вопрос из зала:</b> Извините, а что с: Question from the audience: Excuse me, what about the large equipment?
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Центрифугу разобрали уже, б: A.P.: The centrifuge has already been disassembled, literally an hour ago. Enough! Time is precious right now!
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Все вопросы зададите в конц: A.P.: You’ll be able to ask your questions at the end, but for now, let’s stay on topic. Key personnel will be evacuated to the Health Resort — many of you have already vacationed there before.
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Теперь это промежуточная ба: A.P.: It’s now being used as an interim evacuation site. Logistics, escort, and security are handled by United Security personnel.
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Но будьте внимательны! Наше: A.P.: But be careful! Our cooperation with them ends immediately after arrival at the Health Resort!
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> После этого момента на связ: A.P.: After that point, a new contractor will make contact, and management strongly advises against approaching USEC operatives.

byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Запись №1. Сейч: Cult Victim: Tape #1. Time is… time is 14:09.
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Меня зовут Игор: Cult Victim: My name’s Igor. I feel like some secret agent doing this.
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Пришлось даже п: Cult Victim: I even had to switch to analog recordings. You know, with a tape recorder. At least that way any of those freaks can’t hack it.
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Вчера мне подки: Cult Victim: Yesterday someone slipped a book under my door. Creepy as hell, covered in those same symbols that started showing up around the city…
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Я сначала подум: Cult Victim: At first I thought it was some prank. Like, you know, that old TV show, Naked and Funny. That one sure is an oldie…
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> В общем, книга!: Cult Victim: Anyway, the book! I read it. Spent the whole evening on it. And it’s full of… of some serious weirdness.
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Не в плане идио: Cult Victim: Not nonsense, no. More like… I don’t know, like someone knows things they really shouldn’t know.
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Наш Кобальт вед: Cult Victim: Well, our Cobalt is connected to TerraGroup, and over the years I’ve learned a few things.
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Так вот «Дары»,: Cult Victim: So these… these "Gifts" mentioned in the book sound an awful lot like some of TerraGroup’s projects. The secret type.
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Меня точно пыта: Cult Victim: I’m sure they tried to recruit me. Like, into some cult. Only these guys are way more sophisticated than your average Peoples Temple types.
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Они думают, что: Cult Victim: They think I have access to some "Eye of the World". That’s why they need me. And they’re not gonna stop at just sending a book.
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Надо бежать. Да: Cult Victim: I have to run. Yes… yes, I need to disappear. Lay low, maybe even in Bruges.
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Они следили за: Cult Victim: They’ve been watching me. This whole time. And I thought it was just paranoia. Even talked about it with my therapist, for fuck’s sake!
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Надо было довер: Cult Victim: I should’ve trusted my gut. Maybe I wouldn’t have to drop everything and run now. I…

byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Я понимаю ваши переживания!: A.P.: I understand your concerns! I don’t have all the information myself, but I’m confident that our new partners will be just as reliable as USEC personnel.
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> TerraGroup всегда держали б: A.P.: TerraGroup has always prioritized security and will entrust our evacuation only to true professionals.
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Кстати, об эвакуации… Через: A.P.: Speaking of the evacuation… In 13 hours and 47 minutes, all TerraGroup facilities must be vacated. Yes, this is the first time we’re working under such a rush, but there’s no other way.
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Я получил коды, и «Браун»,: A.P.: I’ve received the codes, "Braun" and "Chernigov" included… Also from Lisbon. So by the time the timer runs out, no one should be left here!
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Я эвакуируюсь последним. Ну: A.P.: I’ll be evacuating last. Well, not just me. Korneev, are you here?
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Хорошо. После того, как всё: A.P.: Good. Once everything is sealed, we’ll head to the Health Resort.
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Понимаю вас, коллеги. Тяжел: A.P.: I understand, colleagues. It’s hard to realize that all production must be shut down. We won’t be able to take microbiology at all, just the data and parameters…
byText.<b>Выкрик из зала:</b>Как это всё остави: Shout from the audience: How are we supposed to leave all this? We spent a year setting up the lab!
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Галина Петровна, держите се: A.P.: Galina Petrovna, calm down! Everything will be fine at the new location.
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Так, ещё кое-что, это важно: A.P.: Alright, one more thing, this is important! Ahem, excuse me, I have to take this…
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Алло? Да, «Шлисс 14»… Уже…: A.P.: Hello? Yes, "Schliss 14"… Already… Yes… Wait, right now? Understood… Give me two minutes, I’ll find a spot.
byText.<b>А.П.:</b> Друзья! Крайне срочный разг: A.P.: Friends! It's an extremely urgent call, I need to step away. My apologies. I’ll be back soon.
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Прошлая кассета: Cult Victim: The last tape ran out. I didn’t think it would happen this fast. Alright, I’ll make this quick.
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Короче, эти пар: Cult Victim: Anyway, those guys… those guys in hoods… They’re watching me. I just found a note stuck in my door.
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Ну, между дверь: Cult Victim: You know, between the door and the frame—whatever! It said something about the "Eye of the World", that I look through it and it looks back at me… The Priests called me the chosen one!
byText.<b>Жертва сектантов:</b> Мне надо бежать: Cult Victim: I need to run. I’m recording this on my way to the train station. I have to get out of here, doesn’t matter where or how anymore!
byText.Аудиокассета, найденная среди личных вещ: An audio tape found among the personal belongings of the victim in the cultists' torture chamber. It seems the owner was chosen deliberately.
byText.<b>Автоответчик:</b> Здравствуйте, вы по: Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.
byText.<b>Курьер:</b> Курьер Одинцов. Личный но: Courier: This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909.
byText.<b>Курьер:</b> Я должен был доставить ср: Courier: I was supposed to deliver urgent mail to Norvinsk, but the roads are fu- busy, so I’m going to be delayed.
byText.Одна из аудиокассет, на которых Почта Ру: One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the first call from May 11.
byText.<b>Курьер:</b> Курьер Одинцов. Номер 229: Courier: This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909.
byText.<b>Курьер:</b> Все куда хуже, чем я дума: Courier: Things are way worse than I thought. Half the roads are blocked. I have no idea if I’ll make it out of Tarkov today.
byText.<b>Курьер:</b> Предупредите получателя,: Courier: Let the recipient know not to hang up on the call center.
byText.Одна из аудиокассет, на которых Почта Ру: One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the second call from May 11.
byText.<b>Курьер:</b> Да тут полная жопа! На КП: Courier: This is a complete clusterfuck! They're stopping everyone at the checkpoint, the line's already kilometers long.
byText.<b>Курьер:</b> Водитель фуры впереди мен: Courier: The truck driver in front of me started arguing with them, and they fucking shot him! Are you fucking hearing this?!
byText.<b>Курьер:</b> Мне в тачку шальная пуля: Courier: A stray bullet hit my car! I almost fucking died! You know what, I don't get paid for this. I’m getting outta here on foot to my family.
byText.<b>Курьер:</b> Машину оставляю, все посы: Courier: I’m leaving the car, all the parcels are inside. Life’s more important. If you send someone - the key… the key is under the wheel.
byText.Одна из аудиокассет, на которых Почта Ру: One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the third call from May 11.
byText.<b>Жрец:</b> Новые хозяева мира уже здес: Priest: The new masters of the world are already here, and the process has begun… The New World has started to take shape, and the Wardens have already been chosen.
byText.<b>Жрец:</b> Знай, что уже давно за тобо: Priest: Know that the Eye of the World has been watching you for a long time, and all… all your deeds are imprinted in the memory that the Wardens will carry from the old world into the new. Soon, it will be the only thing of value.
byText.<b>Жрец:</b> Я знал, что ты придёшь сюда: Priest: I knew you would come here. It was all foretold. We awaited the Blind One who would help us prepare everything for the Riders of the Arrival. And in you… we found him.
byText.<b>Жрец:</b> Узри силу Неизвестных, пока: Priest: Behold the power of The Unheard before it is too late…
byText.Аудиокассета, непонятным образом оказавш: An audio tape that somehow ended up in the safe at station 14-4 KORD. Either someone slipped it in unnoticed when the server room’s cooling system was activated, or they already knew what would happen.
byText.Кронштейн Addley Precision \"Smith-less: SVT-40 Addley Precision Smith-less Scope Mount
byText.Кронштейн для установки прицелов на СВТ-: A scope mount designed for the SVT-40. Manufactured by Addley Precision.
Voevoda: To the commander of the Gnezdo base. Reporting. After the combat task was completed, someone detonated an explosive.
byText.<b>Воевода:</b> Есть потери личного сост: Voevoda: We have casualties among USEC operators and civilians. One of ours is critically wounded, the rest have light injuries. Assistance required. I repeat, assistance required!
byText.На аудиокассете записаны переговоры бойц: An audio tape recording the conversations between the Gnezdo outpost fighters and the Bogatyr squad.
byText.<b>Воевода:</b> Кхм… Я никогда не вёл дн: Voevoda: Ahem… I never kept a diary. Thought it was a stupid idea. But now I feel like I should share my thoughts with someone.
byText.<b>Воевода:</b> Богатыри попали в жёстку: Voevoda: The Bogatyr squad got into a bad mess. Some of my boys are dead, others wounded. Maybe that is why I keep thinking this is not an accident.
byText.<b>Воевода:</b> Это ведь происходит не т: Voevoda: This is not only happening here. Tarkov, conflicts in the Middle East, hunger, poverty, global warming…
byText.<b>Воевода:</b> Люди как будто сходят с: Voevoda: People seem to be going mad! But strangely, it’s very sudden. A decent family man turns and shoots his little girls.
byText.<b>Воевода:</b> И здесь то же самое. Гор: Voevoda: It's the same here. Tarkov used to be a prosperous city. People came here on purpose. Then… the sore burst and it spilled out…
byText.<b>Воевода:</b> Что, если сама Земля хоч: Voevoda: What if it’s the Earth itself trying to rid itself of the filth, this humanity virus? People only harm this planet. Maybe this is the end for all of us?
byText.<b>Воевода:</b> Я не знаю. Но почему-то: Voevoda: I do not know. But those thoughts just keep coming. End transmission.
byText.Похоже, на эту аудиозапись попало одно и: This recording seems to capture one of Voevoda’s reflections on the causes of the Tarkov conflict.
byText.<b>Ученый TerraGroup:</b> Говорит Никола: TerraGroup Scientist: This is Nikolay Voronenko speaking. The Labyrinth is the worst technically equipped TerraGroup facility, we have already lost contact with headquarters. Perhaps one of the test subjects cut the cable…
byText.<b>Ученый TerraGroup:</b> Объект был взя: TerraGroup Scientist: The facility was stormed by BEAR mercenaries. To defend the Labyrinth I had to release the test subjects from groups 3 and 12.
byText.<b>Ученый TerraGroup:</b> Судя по звукам: TerraGroup Scientist: Judging by the sounds, only the test subjects are left outside now, I can’t hear any of the BEARs.
byText.<b>Ученый TerraGroup:</b> Проведённые в: TerraGroup Scientist: The experiments carried out in the Labyrinth are too important and too dangerous to lose the results. So I gathered all the facility documentation into a folder and threw it into the drain.
byText.<b>Ученый TerraGroup:</b> Не знаю, дотян: TerraGroup Scientist: I don’t know if I’ll make it to the evacuation point… but during the chase I managed to grab a pistol from one of the BEARs. It will be a last resort.
byText.Последняя запись учёного TerraGroup, кот: The final recording of a TerraGroup scientist who locked himself in the Labyrinth observation room.
byText.<b>Замминистра Шкуренко:</b> …так вот. Т: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: …so. There are no exact dates yet. We think everything will start in about… three months. You and your, um, team should move in right after our signal.
byText.<b>Чепыга:</b> А с ментами чё? Я своих п: Chepyga: And the cops? I’m not sending my boys to their deaths for nothing.
byText.<b>Замминистра Шкуренко:</b> Мэр в курсе: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: The mayor is aware and will take care of it. The pay is good, considering all your risks. Sponsors pay in foreign currency, just the way we like it.
byText.<b>Замминистра Шкуренко:</b> Только в эт: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: Only this time you'll be able to take control of the whole city. Once the dust settles, obviously.
byText.<b>Чепыга:</b> Делюга серьёзная. Жмуров: Chepyga: Shit's getting serious. There'll be a lots of bodies.
byText.<b>Замминистра Шкуренко:</b> Крови проль: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: There will be a lot of blood spilled, but not yours and not ours, assuming we act together.
byText.<b>Замминистра Шкуренко:</b> Снаряжение,: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: Equipment, weapons, medical supplies — everything will be provided. Your tasks are tough, we won’t leave you without support.
byText.<b>Чепыга:</b> Ещё люди нужны. И пару ме: Chepyga: We’ll need more people. And waste a couple of local big shots beforehand so they don’t start nosing around. It’ll be harder if we don't do it soon enough.
byText.<b>Замминистра Шкуренко:</b> Если сделае: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: If you handle it cleanly, I’ll help cover it up. After things heat up, we won’t have trouble finding volunteers.
byText.<b>Чепыга:</b> Добро. Когда волыны забир: Chepyga: Aight. When do we get the guns?
byText.<b>Чепыга:</b> Э! Мужик, ты чё здесь заб: Chepyga: Hey you! The fuck you doing here?! Come here!
byText.Аудиокассета, которую Козлов приготовил: An audio tape prepared by Kozlov for Anastasia. According to Kozlov’s letters, it contains irrefutable proof of the city administration’s ties to the local criminal underworld.
byText.<b>Командир отряда:</b> После взрыва эле: Squad Leader: The explosion knocked out all our electronics.
byText.<b>Командир отряда:</b> Повторяю. Связи: Squad Leader: I repeat. Our comms are out!
byText.<b>Командир отряда:</b> Операция отменяе: Squad Leader: Operation is canceled! Fall back to the evacuation points on your own!
byText.Аудиокассета от командира BEAR с надпись: BEAR commander's audio tape labeled "For the BEARs"
byText.Аудиокассета, на которой командир нашего: An audio tape containing important instructions left by our squad’s commander.
byText.<b>Командир отряда:</b> Всем бойцам USEC: Squad Leader: To all USEC... To all USEC units! Blast killed all...
byText.<b>Командир отряда:</b> Взрыв вырубил эл: Squad Leader: Blast killed all our electronics — no comm with HQ.
byText.<b>Командир отряда:</b> Объект больше не: Squad Leader: We have lost control of the facility. Evacuate through Exfil Three towards the port... Exfil Three!
byText.<b>Командир отряда:</b> Возможен контакт: Squad Leader: Expect enemy contact, proceed with caution. Any non-USEC individuals are to be considered hostile!
Squad Leader: Defend yourselves. Use sound judgment.
byText.Аудиокассета от командира USEC с надпись: USEC commander's audio tape labeled "For the USEC"
byText.<b>Боец USEC:</b> Командир! Как считаете: USEC Operative: Commander! How much... How much longer do you reckon we'll be stuck here?
byText.<b>Командир отряда USEC:</b> Сколько ска: USEC Squad Leader: For as long as they tell us to. TerraGroup still has a fuckload of unclosed facilities in Tarkov.
byText.<b>Боец USEC:</b> Думаете, у них получит: USEC Operative: You think they’ll manage to pull everything out on time? Even with their resources, it sounds impossible.
byText.<b>Командир отряда USEC:</b> Их ресурсы: USEC Squad Leader: Let them set their priorities themselves. We’ve already got our hands full babysitting HVIs and hauling out TerraGroup’s docs.
byText.<b>Боец USEC:</b> Но всё равно, даже есл: USEC Operative: But still, even if everything is moved out, there will be hundreds of digital drives left behind… There’s no way to evacuate something like that in war conditions.
byText.<b>Командир отряда USEC:</b> Всё они выв: USEC Squad Leader: They're not gonna extract everything, okay? I heard TerraGroup has some kind of weapon that wipes data from the systems. All of it.
byText.<b>Боец USEC:</b> Вроде ЭМИ? Они же пред: USEC Operative: Like an EMP? Surely they’re gonna give us a heads-up, right? It would screw all our coordination.
byText.<b>Командир отряда USEC:</b> А смысл от: USEC Squad Leader: Why would they hide this from us? Even if they do end up using this thing, it'll only be after we're evacuated.
byText.<b>Командир отряда USEC:</b> Без поддерж: USEC Squad Leader: Without our PMC support, they wouldn't last long — they have no one but us.
byText.<b>Боец USEC:</b> А эти “контрактники”,: USEC Operative: What about those “contractors” we transferred the HVIs to? They looked quite serious. No, shady too. No insignias, no patches… Who are they anyway?
byText.<b>Командир отряда USEC:</b> Сверху ника: USEC Squad Leader: There is no info on them from the HQ, so clearly we shouldn't get involved in that shit. They might be linked to that specialist guy over at the lighthouse.
byText.<b>Командир отряда USEC:</b> А может, пр: USEC Squad Leader: Or perhaps they're just an escort crew from outside the border — our guys are stretched thin here. Either way, we can't trust them.
byText.<b>Боец USEC:</b> Да, интересно, как быс: USEC Operative: Makes you wonder how fast TerraGroup would’ve been screwed up without us involved…
byText.<b>Боец USEC:</b> Тем более теперь, когд: USEC Operative: Especially now, when even some of our own commanders are straying away from their orders…
byText.<b>Командир отряда USEC:</b> Следи за ба: USEC Squad Leader: Listen, watch your mouth! Any other situation, and I'd have you deployed somewhere far worse!
byText.<b>Командир отряда USEC:</b> Так что зат: USEC Squad Leader: So shut up. SHUT UP!
byText.Личная аудиокассета, на которую боец USE: A personal audio tape on which a USEC operative recorded a conversation with their commander during a rest stop.

byText.Американская штурмовая винтовка под патр: An American-made 5.56x45mm assault rifle developed by Colt in the late 1960s as an improved variant of the original AR-15/M16 design. The M16A1 became the standard service rifle of the US military during the Vietnam War, featuring a forward assist and other refinements for reliability in harsh conditions. Though considered outdated by modern standards, it remains a durable and accurate weapon prized by collectors and shooters alike.
byText.Дальнейшая модификация 5.56x45мм автомат: A later evolution of the M16 platform, the M16A2 introduced a burst-fire mechanism, improved iron sights, handguard and buttstock for greater control and durability. Chambered for 5.56x45mm NATO ammunition, it served as the primary service rifle for the U.S. military throughout the 1980s and 1990s. Known for its precision and dependability, the M16A2 remains a benchmark for modern assault rifle design.

byText.Записка Прапора, предназначенная бойцам: A note from Prapor padded with cash, intended for the soldiers at the port. Hm, Prapor has received far more money than he put into this letter…
byText.Финка НКВД - реплика советского боевого: A replica of a Soviet combat knife made by Norvinsk craftsmen, modeled after Finnish and Swedish knives. The knife could be used as an auxiliary tool or, when necessary, in combat. This particular specimen looks more like a souvenir.
A poster depicting the trio who hold Tarkov in a grip of fear.
byText.Плакат с загадочным ритуалом. Кажется, с: A poster depicting a strange ritual. Its creator seems to know the subject from personal experience.
byText.Ходят слухи, что именно так выглядят три: Rumor has it this is what the three most powerful cultists look like.
byText.Плакат, демонстрирующий как важно держат: A poster emphasizing the importance of staying in control. Especially when you’re in Tarkov, fighting to survive.
byText.Этот плакат явно создан под впечатлением: This poster was clearly created under the impression of a truly difficult raid in Tarkov.
byText.Плакат с вокзалом Таркова в его нынешнем: A poster depicting the Tarkov train station as it looks in the current days.
byText.Эксклюзивная повязка на плечо для тех, к: An exclusive armband for those who waited long enough.
An exclusive armband for those who have come almost all the way.
byText.Эта лимитированная фигурка Tarko демонст: This limited Tarko figurine shows Prapor in his best mood.
This limited Tarko figurine depicts Therapist, ready to save a few unfortunate souls. Or take your money for questionable medical services.
byText.Лимитированная фигурка Tarko загадочна,: The limited Tarko figurine is as mysterious as Fence himself.
byText.Создатель этой лимитированной фигурки Ta: The creator of this limited Tarko figurine clearly knows Skier well. Otherwise, how could they capture his character so perfectly?
byText.Даже в виде лимитированной фигурки Tarko: Even as a limited Tarko figurine, Peacekeeper seems ready to help and… no, nevermind, he's still just earning money for himself.
byText.Механик и в виде лимитированной фигурки: Even in a Tarko figurine depiction, Mechanic remains a true weapons specialist.
byText.Барахольщик даже в виде лимитированной ф: Even as a Tarko figurine, Ragman looks every bit the true businessman.
byText.Создатель этой лимитированной фигурки Ta: The creator of this figurine captured Jaeger with incredible precision, even conveying the depth of emotion in his eyes.
byText.Эта лимитированная фигурка Tarko показыв: This limited Tarko figurine shows Tarkov’s Gray Cardinal. Some people know what Lightkeeper looks like only thanks to this figurine.
byText.Лимитированная фигурка Tarko. Виниловый: The figurine Ref looks just like the real one, always on the lookout for new fighters for the Arena.
byText.Коллекционная фигурка от неизвестного ав: A collectible figurine from an unknown creator, showcasing the best means of transportation in all of Tarkov.
byText.Этот кот был обязан оказаться в коллекци: This cat was destined to become part of the Tarko figurine collection.
byText.Эта фигурка Tarko изображает бойца, уком: A Tarko collectible figurine depicting an operative in a special loadout based on the advice from knowledgeable people. Please do not try this loadout at home.
byText.Эта фигурка Tarko демонстрирует оператор: A Tarko collectible figurine depicting a PMC operative who went through fire, water and copper pipes.
byText.Эта фигурка Tarko изображает Мастехина,: A limited Tarko figurine depicting a Tarkov resident.
byText.Наплечная повязка-оберег, изготовленная: A prayer armband made by Gribnik to protect the owner from a stray bullet. It seems that in desperate situations, the fighters don't refuse even "help" like this.
A prayer armband made by Gribnik. It is said to help keep your hard earned trophies during raids for gear and supplies.
byText.Наплечная повязка-оберег, которую Грибни: A prayer armband made by Gribnik to protect the owner from a special mosquito subspecies, observed only in the Norvinsk region. Back during Contract Wars, the news posted articles on the Hazardous Environment Combat Special mosquito (abbreviated "SBEU" in Russian), but only a small fraction of the data provided had been scientifically verified.
byText.Защищённый контейнер \"Гамма\", попавший: An old secure container Gamma that ended up in Tarkov during the Contract Wars. Despite the battle-scarred appearance, you can damn be sure it will last for many years to come.
byText.Армейский жетон BEAR. Судя по символам,: A BEAR PMC dogtag. Judging by the symbols on it, the owner gave up trying to escape from Tarkov and instead has become one of the true believers.
byText.Армейский жетон BEAR, владелец которого: A BEAR PMC dogtag, the owner of which knows firsthand what Tarkov is all about. The notches mark the moments when the fighter lost all he had, but still kept looking for a way to escape from Tarkov.
byText.Армейский жетон USEC. Судя по символам,: A USEC PMC dogtag. Judging by the symbols on it, the owner gave up trying to escape from Tarkov and instead has become one of the true believers.

byText.План всех подземных коммуникаций, необхо: A detailed map of the interchange's underground utilities, used for laying new lines. The mark on the map clearly indicates a spot that could serve as an exit point from the area. Or maybe it's a pirate treasure.
byText.Создатель этой фигурки Tarko изобразил к: The creator of this Tarko figurine depicted someone from the past, when life in Tarkov was calmer. It seems the person was an artist, but that's not certain.
