byText.Knight's Armament SR-25 - самозарядная с: The SR-25 Precision Rifle is the latest evolution of the precision 7.62mm NATO semi-automatic rifle. An ambidextrous bolt release, selector, and magazine release offers the left-handed user the ergonomic advantages inherent to AR-15 based controls, as well as giving right-handed users alternate methods of manipulation to increase efficiency of movement. The Drop-In 2-Stage Trigger serves as an aid to long range precision marksmanship. The E2 bolt and gas system provides superior reliability in function whether suppressed or unsuppressed. Coated in cerakote Taupe color.

byText.Устанавливается взамен штатной муфты газ: A gas block for AR-10 series rifles which adds a Picatinny rail for installation of various tactical devices. Manufactured by Knight's Armament Company. Coated in cerakote Taupe color.
byText.Винтовочный глушитель, специально разраб: A rifle caliber sound suppressor designed for SR-25 pattern rifles, manufactured by Knight's Armament Company. Can only be installed on the compatible gas block system. Coated in cerakote Taupe color.
byText.Бандана, намотанная на нижнюю часть лица: A bandana wrapped around the lower part of the face. Most commonly seen on street bandits. For those who want to combine a festive mood and "badass skulls".
byText.Качественная балаклава из особого технол: A quality balaclava with a special technological material. MultiCam Alpine version.
byText.Баллистическая маска Atomic Defense \"CQ: Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Blasted Ice)
byText.Баллистическая маска \"CQCM\" от Atomic: Atomic Defense's CQCM ballistic mask provides protection against short-range weapons including pistols, shotguns and knives. The cracks are painted, don't worry.
byText.Эта жетонница поможет сохранять жетоны б: This case is meant to store dogtags of fighters with special distinctions. Don’t put ordinary mercs’ tags in it.
byText.Очень редкая модель кошелька от знаменит: A very rare wallet model from the famous brand. Suitable for truly valuable items: cash and rare keycards.
byText.Термосумка-мерч, созданная Hot Rod в рам: A promotional cooler bag made by Hot Rod for the "Juice Time" campaign. The fabric honeycomb inside keeps drinks upright but makes the bag unsuitable for storing food.
byText.Иногда нет ничего важнее, чем иметь в бы: Sometimes nothing is more important than having a fracture splint within easy reach. The founder of Tigzresq knows this firsthand.
byText.Лучше мандарина может быть только ящик м: Only a crate of tangerines could be better. But in Tarkov, few are likely to have one.
byText.Гантель из лимитированной серии «человек: A dumbbell from the limited "Man-Machine" series by the renowned sports equipment manufacturer. They say this series was inspired by a famous athlete from Kazakhstan.
byText.Белая ушанка из запасов Барахольщика, ко: A white ushanka from Ragman's reserves, opened for New Year. Warms not only the body but also the soul.
byText.Ушанка с эмблемой, которую изредка можно: A ushanka with an emblem occasionally spotted on the streets of Tarkov. Domontovich used to take part in the urban battles himself — until he disappeared. Some say Lightkeeper had something to do with it.
byText.Кажется, эта балаклава странно пахнет. П: This balaclava seems to have a strange smell. Its previous owner apparently wore it without ever taking it off.
byText.Изношенный ключ от сортира в старом доме: A worn-out key to the outhouse in an old house somewhere on the edge of the Priozersk nature reserve. It feels like it's been used many times. Why the outhouse was locked and what treasures it might hide is a mystery.
byText.Активные наушники с функцией связи, идеа: The EARMOR M32 headset is an activated electronic communication hearing protector, ideal for tactical use. Manufactured by OPSMEN. Version in white color.
byText.Баллистический шлем Caiman Hybrid - это: The Caiman Hybrid helmet is a new generation of lightweight special forces helmet. A series of modular accessories enhances the package, providing users with lightweight, comfortable and maximum head protection. Manufactured by Galvion. MultiCam Alpine version.
byText.Баллистическая мандибула для шлема Galvi: Galvion Caiman Hybrid Ballistic Mandible Guard (MultiCam Alpine)
byText.Специальная дополнительная баллистическа: A special additional ballistic protection for the Caiman Hybrid helmet, mounted on the side rails. Manufactured by Galvion. MultiCam Alpine version.
byText.Дополнительное бронирование для шлема Ga: Galvion Caiman Hybrid Ballistic Applique (MultiCam Alpine)
byText.Дополнительная закрепляемая панель для п: An additional up-armor helmet shell attachment to elevate or enhance ballistic and fragmentation protection of the Caiman Hybrid Helmet. Manufactured by Galvion. MultiCam Alpine version.
byText.Шлем HighCom \"Striker ULACH IIIA\" (Зим: HighCom Striker ULACH IIIA helmet (Winter Mesh Spray)
byText.Боевой шлем от компании HighCom с защито: A combat helmet with the ears and back of the head protection, manufactured by HighCom. Spray painted with a winter mesh pattern for better camouflage.
byText.Несмотря ни на что, банка из-под кофе ос: Despite everything, an empty coffee can remains one of the best containers for storing various small construction hardware.
byText.Jumpable Plate Carrier (JPC) представляе: The widely beloved Jumpable Plate Carrier (JPC) was designed to maximize operator mobility by reducing weight and bulk. Its modular system allows for personalized loadouts and quick gear adjustments depending on the mission. Manufactured by Crye Precision. MultiCam version.
byText.Эта реплика не даст комфорта оригинально: A cheap airsoft knockoff of the Crye Precision JPC plate carrier. Doesn't offer the comfort of the original JPC, but retains extensive customization options. It looks like the previous owner chose not to overload the carrier with pouches to stay as mobile as possible.

A cheap airsoft knockoff of the Crye Precision JPC plate carrier. Doesn't offer the comfort of the original JPC, but retains extensive customization options. Someone attached an IOTV shoulder pad to this one to act as a groin protector.
byText.Утепляющая маска с подкладкой из флиса,: An insulated mask with a fleece lining, designed for extremely low temperatures. The combination of practicality and an intimidating appearance makes it especially appealing to movie villains and to anyone heading out on a mission when it's truly freezing outside.
byText.Чехол для бронеплит ANA Tactical \"M2\": ANA Tactical M2 plate carrier (MultiCam Alpine)
byText.Разгрузочный жилет \"M2\", созданный с и: The M2 vest is created with the use of the best experience of Russian special forces operators. The versatility of the system makes it possible to use this vest both when carrying out urban tasks and when performing tasks on rough terrain. Manufactured by ANA Tactical. MultiCam Alpine version.
byText.Hi-End решение в области тактического зв: A high-end solution in tactical hearing protection. Custom-made to fit the wearer, so this matching size is a real stroke of luck.
byText.Бронеплита Tac-Kek SAPI level III+ (Репл: Tac-Kek SAPI Level III+ ballistic plate (Replica)
byText.Small Arms Protective Insert (SAPI) - бр: Small Arms Protective Insert (SAPI) is a ballistic plate for front and back pouches of a plate carrier. However, this is a lightweight non-ballistic replica, primarily used by airsofters and cosplayers.
byText.Мясной продукт мажущей консистенции из т: A spreadable meat product made from cooked ingredients, produced by Norvinsk Poultry Plant. No ducks were harmed in the making. Probably.
byText.Настоящее спасение для коллекционеров пл: A true lifesaver for poster collectors. No more bent corners!
byText.Защитный шлем «Маска-1» появился на воор: The Maska-1 bulletproof protective helmet appeared in service in 1991 as a replacement for the "Sphere" helmet, designed for use by the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation armed forces. The Maska-1SCh ("Mask-1 Shield") modification features a bulletproof steel faceshield to ensure maximum protection of the user's face.
byText.Сбежать из Таркова может далеко не кажды: Not everyone can escape Tarkov. But what about Duckov?
byText.Фигурка утки, готовой стойко противостоя: A figurine of a duck, ready to face all the challenges of the universe with unwavering resolve.
byText.Модификация гладкоствольного дробовика С: A modified Saiga-12K smoothbore shotgun specially customized for the Arena champion known by the name JP. The custom build reduces barrel overheating during sustained fire and improves overall weapon reliability.

A lightweight aluminum tactical foregrip manufactured by IRBIS-GUN.

byText.Облегченный приклад \"Ravage\". Производ: A lightweight buttstock for AR patter weapons. Manufactured by Lead Star Arms. Red version.

byText.Плакат посвящён то ли слиянию, то ли пок: A poster seemingly related to either a merger or acquisition involving TerraGroup. The acquired company, Paradigm, appears to be connected to maritime transport.
byText.Оперативная бронесистема TV-115 со встав: The TV-115 Operational armor system in a minimalist setup. Manufactured by WARTECH. Black version.
byText.Оперативный комплект ФОРТ ОК \"Дефендер-: The FORT OK "Defender-2" operational kit is a modification of the popular body armor FORT "Defender" designed for both VIP and for employees of operational combat units. Flecktarn camouflage version.
byText.Разгрузочная нагрудная система Direct Ac: Direct Action Thunderbolt compact chest rig (Ranger Green)
byText.Фиксированная разгрузочная система от ко: The Thunderbolt fixed chest rig, containing all the basic utility pouches you'd need. Manufactured by Direct Action. Ranger Green version.
byText.Разгрузочная система предназначенная для: A tactical load-bearing system designed to carry magazines, grenades, and special equipment, while using low-profile body armor. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading. Desert Night Camouflage version.
byText.Ключ-карта Paradigm Shipping с доступом: A Paradigm Shipping keycard granting access to technical areas of the Icebreaker. It may help reach the engine room.
A Paradigm Shipping keycard granting access to the crew cabins aboard the Boreas icebreaker.
byText.Ключ-карта без какого-либо дизайна, прин: A plain keycard belonging to the captain. Someone has handwritten “C-1 Boreas” on it with a marker.
byText.Ключ-карта Paradigm Shipping с отметкой: A Paradigm Shipping keycard marked Compartment-3. It likely opens one of the restricted compartments aboard the Boreas icebreaker.
byText.Модуль спутниковой связи, производится т: A satellite communication module produced exclusively for internal use at TerraGroup facilities. It outperforms all civilian equivalents in connection strength and stability.
byText.Криптопроцессор Gigachad обеспечивает ре: The Gigachad cryptoprocessor delivers record-breaking efficiency for complex mathematical computations. Due to its cost and setup complexity, it is typically used only by megacorporations such as TerraGroup at highly critical facilities.
byText.Серверная оперативная память отличается: Server-grade RAM differs from standard memory in bandwidth, long-term stability under continuous operation, and ECC technology capable of automatically correcting minor data errors. These features are unnecessary for personal use but essential in data centers to ensure uninterrupted performance.
byText.Биохимический анализатор Aceso Xpress яв: The Aceso Xpress biochemical analyzer is a market leader in medical diagnostics. It can perform analyses of serum, blood plasma, urine, and even cerebrospinal fluid while maintaining full operational autonomy.
byText.В малых дозировках йодид калия применяет: In small doses, potassium iodide is used to treat thyroid disorders and is widely available. Larger doses of 65 mg and above are rare, typically reserved for nuclear accident response operations. Usually stored at nuclear facilities or held by military and emergency services.
byText.В папке Paradigm Shipping лежит одно из: This Paradigm Shipping folder contains one of the latest directives regarding operations at cargo terminal #3.
byText.В таблице отмечено каждое проникновение: This log has records of every entry into Compartment C-1. Judging by the records, it is the most restricted and classified area aboard the icebreaker "Boreas".
byText.В дневнике один из матросов вёл записи о: In this diary, one of the sailors kept records of the "Boreas" routes and his work for Paradigm Shipping.
byText.В папке лежат распечатанные Механиком об: This folder contains printed fragments of information recovered and decrypted by Mechanic from the hard drives found in Compartment C-1 aboard the icebreaker "Boreas".
byText.<b>Выживший:</b> Так… Если я не могу это: Survivor: So… if I can’t control this, then I must at least continue observation.
byText.<b>Выживший:</b> Я – Григорий Альтман, о: Survivor: I am Grigory Altman, supervisor responsible for sample storage aboard the icebreaker “Boreas”. The vessel was…
byText.<b>Григорий Альтман:</b> ...было атакова: Grigory Altman: …was attacked by mercenaries in Tarkov waters. During the assault, sample containers connected to projects TG-Ci and TG-y were damaged.
byText.<b>Григорий Альтман:</b> Согласно проток: Grigory Altman: In accordance with containment protocol, the laboratory was isolated from adjacent compartments.
byText.<b>Григорий Альтман:</b> Я остался внутр: Grigory Altman: I remained inside and administered protective compounds as a precaution against possible contamination.
byText.<b>Григорий Альтман:</b> На четвёртые су: Grigory Altman: On the fourth day I recorded elevated cortisol levels, coughing, and mild itching. Increased dosage of the injected medication, observing improvement.
byText.<b>Григорий Альтман:</b> Полностью устра: Grigory Altman: It is impossible to fully stop the leak or replace the damaged sample containers. I continue daily measurements and it seems…
byText.<b>Григорий Альтман:</b> ...кажется, смо: Grigory Altman: …It seems I managed to arrange evacuation to a secure location where I can isolate the samples and continue observation.
byText.<b>Григорий Альтман:</b> Главное, успеть: Grigory Altman: It’s critical to complete this before I enter the paranoia stage…

byText.Судя по пометке, приклеенной к внешне об: Judging by the label attached to this otherwise ordinary SSD, its contents have yet to be examined by Black Division operatives. Once evaluated and sorted, storage devices like this are assigned to one of the evacuation categories.

The Mechanic warns: use of suspicious ammunition can be extremely dangerous. There was one case in Kentucky...

byText.FN P90 представляет собой компактное ору: FN P90, also known as the FN Project 1990, is a compact personal defense weapon (PDW) designed and manufactured by FN Herstal in Belgium. Created in response to NATO requests for a replacement for 9x19mm Parabellum firearms, the P90 was designed as a compact but powerful firearm for vehicle crews, operators of crew-served weapons, support personnel, special forces, and counter-terrorist groups. This particular weapon was customized and tuned to the specifications of Liam "Scourge", one of the Arena Champions, during his time with USEC.

byText.Шанс перелома конечностей увеличен на 15: Limb fracture chance and fall damage increased by 15%
byText.Выносливость рук и ног восстанавливается: Arm and leg stamina regenerates 15% slower and is reduced by 10
byText.Аптечки расходуют на 25% больше ресурса: Medical kits consume 25% more use points
byText.Все навыки прокачиваются на 25% медленне: All skills level 25% slower, except Bolt-action Rifles. Maximum skill level is 30, except Crafting
Charisma cannot level up. All trader goods cost 20% more
byText.Полученный статус «Свежая рана» нельзя с: A Fresh Wound cannot be removed until the raid ends
byText.Аллергия на 2 случайных предмета из кате: Allergic to two random items from Provisions or Medical supplies
byText.В защищённый контейнер можно класть толь: Only money, keys, dogtags, special equipment and certain containers can be put in the secure container
byText.Торговля с игроками на Барахолке недосту: Player trading on the flea market is unavailable
byText.Скорость передвижения снижена на 1%. Пок: Movement speed reduced by 1%. Therapist's items cost 5% less
byText.Вы начали сезон позже остальных, но спис: You started the season late, but you are still in the game. Gain 4 additional modifier points.
byText.На свет. Доверяй, но проверяй: To the Light - Trust but Verify
